items.content: Walmart will soon let AI agents shop on its website for you. Next month, the retail giant will allow you to connect your own AI agent to the site, with systems in place to let you approve and review purchases and set spending limits.The embrace of AI agents stands in stark contrast to Amazon, which blocked Perplexity’s shopping agent and Meta’s Muse AI assistant. But Walmart is opening its doors to AI shoppers — as long as they follow the retailer’s rules. It has outlined a set of terms for agents, saying that “agents must not take actions beyond what the shopper intends” and cannot change a customer’s payment method. Agents also can only access information needed to complete their task. Walmart says it will block agents that don’t follow these terms.Your AI agent will get its own profile within your Walmart account. Image: WalmartRelatedWebsites are closing their doors to AI agentsAgents will connect to new “Agent Profiles” within Walmart. By default, Walmart will require approval for all AI agent purchases, but you can also let it shop within a certain budget, such as up to $100. You’ll also be able to review your agent’s purchases separately from your own in Agent Profiles, as well as turn off the agent at any time.The retailer has built an “Agent Gateway” that connects AI agents through the Model Context Protocol, an open standard that allows AI agents to plug into different services on the web. Walmart says this not only enables AI agents to shop without running into hiccups that they might encounter when navigating a browser, but also prevents them from accessing your shopping history and personal information.“For example, if a customer tends to buy sourdough bread or a particular brand of milk, Walmart will help the agent find those usual items for the customer without sharing the customer’s broader shopping history with the agent,” Walmart says. The company will let users shop with AI agents on Sam’s Club as well.

items.titleZh: 沃尔玛邀请AI智能体替你购物
items.descriptionZh:
沃尔玛计划于下个月向第三方AI购物代理开放其网站，允许用户将自己的人工智能代理接入沃尔玛账户，代为完成购物。这一举措与亚马逊形成鲜明对比：亚马逊此前阻止了Perplexity的购物代理和Meta的Muse AI助手，而沃尔玛选择在设定明确规则的前提下向AI代理开放。当前，不少网站正在收紧对AI代理的访问，沃尔玛则试图通过可控机制率先探索“代理式电商”。

在机制上，沃尔玛为AI代理设置了独立的“代理档案”（Agent Profiles），与用户本人的购物行为分开管理。默认情况下，AI代理的所有购买都需要用户批准；用户也可以为代理设置预算上限，例如最高100美元，并单独审查代理完成的订单，还可随时关闭代理功能。沃尔玛还规定，代理不得执行超出购物者意图的操作，不得更改客户的支付方式，只能访问完成任务所需的信息；违反规则的代理将被平台阻止。

技术层面，沃尔玛构建了“代理网关”（Agent Gateway），通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）连接AI代理。MCP是一种开放标准，可让AI代理接入网络上的不同服务。沃尔玛表示，这一方式不仅能减少AI代理在浏览器中操作时可能遇到的障碍，还能防止代理访问用户的购物历史和个人信息。例如，如果客户经常购买酸面包或某个特定品牌的牛奶，沃尔玛可以帮助代理找到这些常购商品，但不会向代理分享客户更广泛的购物历史。

从影响和应用场景看，沃尔玛的方案试图在自动化便利、用户控制和隐私保护之间取得平衡。AI代理可代表用户完成重复性、常规性采购，同时通过审批、预算和权限隔离降低误购和隐私泄露风险。该服务也将扩展至沃尔玛旗下的Sam’s Club。整体来看，沃尔玛没有像部分平台那样简单封堵AI代理，而是尝试建立一套可审核、可限制、可追溯的代理接入规则，为AI代理参与电商购物提供了一种受控落地路径。

items.content: After introducing its Gemini AI assistant to Android Auto last year, Google is now bringing it to Apple CarPlay users. The conversational Gemini in navigation is available today for US drivers, with “rollout happening globally too,” according to Google (we’ve asked for specific regional availability details).It’s taken almost 12 months for Google to bring this to CarPlay users, but now they can talk to the voice assistant in Google Maps to get some hands-free help while driving. That includes asking it multi-step questions, such as recommendations on places to visit and then prompting it to direct you there while avoiding toll roads. Users can activate the feature by tapping the Gemini icon in Google Maps on their Car’s infotainment display.Google describes this CarPlay support update as a conversational way to report traffic disruptions and find information about stops and places on-the-go. There’s no mention of any of the Personal Intelligence features that were announced yesterday for Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in, however, which enable the voice assistant to access user information from Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search. We’ve asked Google if CarPlay users will also receive the personalization update and will update if we hear back.

items.titleZh: 对话式 Gemini 导航登陆 Apple CarPlay
items.descriptionZh:
Google 去年已把 Gemini AI 助手引入 Android Auto，如今又将这一能力扩展到 Apple CarPlay 用户。根据 Google 的说法，面向导航场景的对话式 Gemini 已于当天面向美国司机开放，并且“全球推广也在进行中”；不过，Google 尚未公布具体的区域可用性细节，相关询问仍在等待回复。这意味着 CarPlay 用户经过近 12 个月等待后，终于可以在 Google Maps 中通过语音与助手交互，在驾驶过程中获得免手操作帮助。

从功能看，用户可在车载信息娱乐显示屏的 Google Maps 中点击 Gemini 图标激活该助手，并以自然语言提出多步骤问题。例如，先询问目的地推荐，再要求助手把用户导航到该地点并避开收费道路。Google 将此次 CarPlay 支持更新描述为一种“对话式”方式，用于报告交通中断、查找途中停靠点和地点信息。其核心创新在于把对话式 AI 与地图导航任务串联起来，使驾驶场景下的信息查询和路线操作更连贯，减少手动操作。

原文没有给出量化性能参数或直接对比数据，因此无法评估响应速度、识别准确率等指标。可确认的对比信息主要是平台与功能范围：该功能先落地 Android Auto，近 12 个月后才进入 CarPlay；美国市场先行，全球推广正在进行但区域细节未明。同时，Google 此次未提及前一天为 Android Auto 以及内置 Google 的汽车 announced 的 Personal Intelligence 功能。该功能允许语音助手访问用户在 Gmail、Calendar、Maps、Photos、YouTube 和 Search 等 Google 应用中的个人信息，从而实现个性化服务。CarPlay 用户是否会同步获得这一个性化更新尚不确定，Google 表示收到回复后会更新。

应用场景上，该功能主要面向驾驶中的免手交互，包括途中寻找停靠点、获取地点信息、报告路况异常、规划避开收费道路的路线等。对 CarPlay 用户而言，这提升了 Google Maps 在车载场景中的语音助手能力；但当前版本更偏向导航与地点信息对话，尚未确认具备 Android Auto 和内置 Google 汽车上宣布的跨应用个人化能力。

items.title: Trump announces mandate forcing AI data centers to pay energy dividends to the local community
items.description: Trump's latest post on Truth Social announces his plans to make data centers more popular among local communities.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter President Donald Trump has issued a call for data center builders and AI hyperscalers to pay communities a dividend in order to overcome energy-related price hikes, or even to reduce prices, in order to make data centers more palatable to local communities. In a post on Truth Social post, he warned that data centers would be mandated not only to make their own electricity, as he has previously stated, but also to give or sell excess energy back to the local community.Local communities all over the United States have protested against AI data centers, often owing to their outsized impact on local communities. Rising electricity costs, noise pollution, water shortages, air pollution, deforestation, and more are the things that small communities have to deal with because of these companies.To ease the pain of local communities, Trump is demanding that these large companies provide the communities they affect with something that will hopefully make their presence more acceptable. The Trump Administration is keen to stay ahead of China in the AI arms race and is looking for solutions to win back some favor by making the data centers pay something back to the affected communities; how that will practically transpire is yet to be seen. Considering the electricity-focused post, the dividend might be in the form of partially paying rising electricity costs to alleviate a pain point that directly affects many homes within the vicinity of data centers. The Trump Administration had ordered these companies to make their own electricity, as we’ve covered previously. Excess electricity from their generation could be used to further lower the electricity cost for the locals, including a recently passed act that orders data centers to shoulder the cost for grid upgrades to avoid taking it from the taxes of local communities.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: “Data Centers that were highly unpopular in a certain area have become extremely popular when a financial deal is struck.” Trump further says in his post, aiming to have more data centers built, “MAKE DEALS, and get them built!!!," the President said in closing.Whether the dividends will be enough to win over communities is yet to be known, as the economic aspect is only one facet of the problem. There are still plenty of problems to face; enormous water consumption, ecological damage, and pollution are still major challenges that make AI data centers a hard sell anywhere they’re located. items.titleZh: 特朗普宣布强制令，要求AI数据中心向当地社区支付能源红利
items.descriptionZh: 美国总统特朗普近日在Truth Social上发文，要求数据中心建设商和AI超大规模云厂商向受影响的社区支付“股息”或回馈，以缓解数据中心带来的能源价格上涨，甚至降低当地电价，从而提升数据中心在地方社区中的可接受度。特朗普警告称，数据中心不仅将被要求像此前所说的那样自行发电，还必须将多余电力赠送或出售给当地社区。这一表态的背景是，美国多地社区持续抗议AI数据中心，原因包括电价上涨、噪音污染、水资源短缺、空气污染和森林砍伐等。小型社区尤其承受着这些大型设施带来的外部成本，因此特朗普要求相关大公司向受影响社区提供回报，希望以此换取社区对数据中心建设的支持。特朗普政府希望在对华AI竞赛中保持领先，同时寻找办法为数据中心争取地方支持；但“社区股息”具体如何实施、金额和形式如何，目前尚不明确。从特朗普以电力为重点的表述看，股息可能表现为部分承担上涨的电费，从而直接缓解数据中心周边家庭的能源成本压力。此前，特朗普政府已要求这类公司自行发电；其多余发电量可用于进一步降低当地居民电价。文章还提到，近期通过的一项法案要求数据中心承担电网升级成本，避免将相关费用转嫁给当地社区税收。特朗普在帖文中称，“在某些地区极不受欢迎的数据中心，一旦达成财务协议，就会变得极受欢迎”，并呼吁“达成协议，把它们建起来”。不过，经济补偿能否真正赢得社区支持仍不确定，因为电价只是问题的一个方面。巨大的水资源消耗、生态破坏和污染仍是AI数据中心在各地选址和运营面临的主要挑战。文章关联报道还显示，弗吉尼亚州在AI数据中心导致电价严重上涨76%后，已要求企业承担所有专用上游电力基础设施费用；特朗普政府也将AI数据中心“费率payer保护承诺”扩展至州长和公用事业公司。总体来看，这一政策设想的核心创新在于把数据中心从单纯的电力消费者和社区成本来源，转变为自发电、余电回馈、电网升级成本分担和社区财务补偿的参与者，以“社会许可”换取建设空间。其潜在影响涉及AI数据中心选址、电力基础设施投资、地方电价和社区关系，但实际效果取决于补偿机制能否覆盖电力之外的水资源、生态和污染等外部性。目前尚无具体股息比例、执行时间表或强制性立法细节，政策落地仍待观察。

items.title: Qualcomm to cut jobs globally in "performance-based" layoffs, as company pivots to AI data center and edge computing markets
items.description: Qualcomm will begin performance-based layoffs worldwide in November as the chipmaker reallocates resources toward AI infrastructure, data centers, automotive, PCs, and edge computing, amid weaker consumer electronics demand.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Qualcomm has told employees it will cut jobs worldwide after its annual performance reviews, and it expects to begin informing affected employees in November. According to a Reuters report, CEO Cristiano Amon framed the move as a “performance-focused reduction” intended to build a “stronger performance culture,” stating that the company will consider organizational needs, business priorities, and employees’ skills and expertise when determining affected positions.“The reduction will address employees who have consistently fallen short of expectations,” said Amon. The memo did not specify which departments would be affected or how many jobs would be cut. The company had roughly 52,000 employees at the end of its 2025 fiscal year, typically in late September.Qualcomm, one of the world’s largest smartphone chip manufacturers with customers including Apple, Xiaomi, and Samsung, has been hit by an industry-wide decline in consumer electronics sales as rising memory costs reduce demand. Its shares have risen just 1.5% in 2026, compared to gains of almost 60% for the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: As a result, Qualcomm is strategically pivoting to AI infrastructure and edge computing, following a broadening trend across the semiconductor industry. The company unveiled its AI200 and AI250 AI inference accelerators in October 2025. After its latest earnings report projected lower quarterly profits than initially estimated, the company said that growth in its data center business would offset any lost revenue by fiscal year 2027.Qualcomm’s layoff decision comes as it tries to position itself for future growth. While mobile chips remain its core business, its best future opportunities might lie in data center silicon, automotive platforms, personal computing, and edge computing, and all those fields require specialized engineering talent. A performance-based reduction could let the company retain its most valuable employees in those fields while cutting duplicated roles, lower-performing teams, and positions that no longer fit its strategy. "We must have the right ​people in the right roles so they can perform at their best and the company can continue ​to succeed." The move comes on the back of Q3 2026 financial results that included a 4% year-on-year decline in revenue and 25% lower net income. The core handset business recorded a 20% decline in revenue on the year, too. The company reportedly recorded $97 million in severance-related restructuring charges in the first nine months of its fiscal year.Qualcomm’s move is part of a larger industry transition, largely driven by AI. After several years of aggressive hiring, many tech companies are now trimming their workforce to fund AI ambitions. Meta announced plans to cut 8,000 jobs to fund AI infrastructure. Even as companies are cutting jobs that don’t fit their AI roadmap, they're fiercely competing for process engineers, chip designers, and AI software developers. items.titleZh: 高通将在全球裁员，实施“基于绩效”的裁员，公司转向AI数据中心与边缘计算市场
items.descriptionZh:
高通已向员工表示，将在年度绩效评估后启动全球裁员，并预计从11月开始通知受影响员工。CEO克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙将此举定性为“以绩效为重点的缩减”，目的是建立“更强的绩效文化”。公司称，在确定受影响岗位时会综合考虑组织需求、业务优先级以及员工的技能和专长，裁员主要针对“长期未达到预期”的员工。不过，内部备忘录没有披露哪些部门会受影响，也没有说明具体裁员人数。截至2025财年末（通常在9月底），高通约有5.2万名员工。

高通是全球最大的智能手机芯片制造商之一，客户包括苹果、小米和三星。当前，消费电子行业整体销售下滑，内存成本上升又进一步抑制需求，高通业务受到冲击。2026年以来，高通股价仅上涨1.5%，而费城半导体指数同期涨幅接近60%。财务表现方面，高通2026财年第三季度收入同比下降4%，净利润下降25%；核心手机业务收入同比下滑20%。公司还披露，本财年前九个月录得9700万美元与遣散相关的重组费用。最新财报预计季度利润低于最初估计后，高通表示，到2027财年，数据中心业务的增长将抵消可能损失的收入。

在此背景下，高通正战略转向AI基础设施和边缘计算，这与半导体行业更广泛的趋势一致。2025年10月，高通发布了AI200和AI250 AI推理加速器，面向数据中心AI推理负载。原文未披露这两款产品的具体架构、制程、算力或能效参数，因此无法展开更细的技术原理；但从产品定位看，这标志着高通试图把在移动SoC、低功耗计算和终端侧AI上的积累，延伸到数据中心推理加速和边缘AI场景。AI推理是指运行已经训练好的模型来完成预测、生成或决策任务，随着大模型应用落地，推理需求快速增长；边缘计算则强调在终端或靠近数据源的位置处理AI任务，以降低延迟、节省带宽并提升隐私性。对高通而言，这些领域与其手机、PC、汽车和物联网业务存在协同空间。

此次裁员也反映出高通为未来增长重新配置人才的意图。移动芯片仍是其核心业务，但公司认为未来更好的机会可能来自数据中心芯片、汽车平台、个人计算和边缘计算，而这些领域都需要专业工程人才。以绩效为基础的缩减，可以帮助高通保留上述关键领域的高价值员工，同时削减重复岗位、低绩效团队以及不再符合公司战略的职位。阿蒙在备忘录中写道：“随着我们扩展业务，我们所需的能力和技能也在扩展。我们必须把合适的人放在合适的岗位上，让他们发挥最佳水平，公司才能继续成功。”

高通的调整也是AI驱动下科技行业转型的一部分。在多年积极招聘后，许多科技公司正在削减人力，为AI雄心提供资金。Meta已宣布计划裁减8000个岗位，以资助AI基础设施。与此同时，企业虽然裁撤不符合AI路线图的岗位，却在激烈争夺工艺工程师、芯片设计师和AI软件开发者。麦肯锡和SEMI基金会估计，到2030年，美国可能面临多达15.7万名半导体工人短缺，73%的芯片公司报告难以填补工程岗位。对高通来说，此次全球裁员既是应对手机芯片需求疲软和财务压力的短期措施，也是其向AI推理、数据中心、汽车、PC和边缘计算等新增长引擎转型的人才重组步骤。

items.title: AMD and Intel will work together to create a single PyTorch code path for AI inference on CPUs
items.description: AMD and Intel are working together to bring CPU inference optimizations for PyTorch under the unified oneDNN library.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel and AMD are integrating their CPU optimizations for PyTorch into a unified library, offering tuning for both AMD and Intel chips through the oneDNN library. AMD has maintained a downstream version of oneDNN called ZenDNN, which is now moving into the open-source oneDNN, published by the UXL Foundation and driven by Intel. AMD also announced it's joining the UXL Foundation as a "steering member," which "influences the future of the UXL Foundation" in exchange for a contribution of $20,000 per year.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleAMD says the move to unify these efforts under oneDNN was recommended by the x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group (EAG), which is a joint initiative that primarily exists between Intel and AMD and was established in 2024. The two companies have collaborated through the EAG previously, such as with the ACE extensions for x86 that we learned about earlier this year.The oneDNN backend is used for CPU inference, and it's built to accelerate that workload for the latest Intel (and now AMD) chips in frameworks like PyTorch. It also features optimized instructions for common AI and machine learning operations, such as matrix multiplication and convolution.For developers, the move simplifies working with PyTorch across different systems, ensuring a single backend provides the proper optimizations for whatever hardware you're running. Although the news here is focused on the x86 guard, oneDNN is a cross-platform library that works on Arm and RISC-V architectures as well. items.titleZh: AMD 与英特尔将合作打造统一的 PyTorch 代码路径，用于 CPU 上的 AI 推理
items.descriptionZh:
Intel与AMD正在把各自面向PyTorch的CPU优化整合到统一的oneDNN库中，使同一套oneDNN后端能够同时为AMD和Intel处理器提供调优支持。此前，AMD维护着oneDNN的下游定制版本ZenDNN；现在，ZenDNN的相关工作将并入由UXL基金会发布、Intel主导的开源oneDNN主线。AMD同时宣布以“指导成员”（steering member）身份加入UXL基金会，从而获得影响该基金会未来方向的权利，对应每年2万美元的会费贡献。

这一整合的背景是数据中心CPU需求上升，AI代理等负载推动CPU在AI推理中的重要性提升；同时，AMD称将相关努力统一到oneDNN，是由x86生态系统咨询小组（EAG）建议的。EAG是Intel与AMD主导的联合机制，成立于2024年，两家公司此前已通过该机制合作，例如今年早些时候公布的x86 ACE扩展。oneDNN最初由Intel开发，建立在更早的深度学习库之上，后来被纳入UXL基金会；Intel也是UXL基金会的创始成员之一，其他创始成员还包括Arm、高通、Google Cloud等。

从技术原理看，oneDNN是面向CPU推理的加速后端，目标是在PyTorch等框架中为最新Intel以及现在的AMD芯片加速相关负载。其GitHub说明显示，该库会在运行时检测硬件特性，据此生成针对当前平台优化的内核，并提供低精度数据类型；同时，它针对矩阵乘法、卷积等常见AI和机器学习操作提供优化指令。对开发者而言，这次整合简化了跨不同系统使用PyTorch的流程：不再需要为不同厂商CPU分别选择后端，单一oneDNN后端即可根据实际运行硬件提供相应优化。虽然此次新闻主要聚焦x86阵营，但oneDNN本身是跨平台库，也可在Arm和RISC-V架构上工作。

性能方面，文章回顾了oneDNN在2023年底作为PyTorch后端加入时的数据：Float32数据类型下带来1.24倍提升，BFloat16数据类型下带来2.21倍提升。这些数据说明，统一后端能够在CPU推理路径上带来实际加速，尤其低精度格式对AI推理更重要。此次AMD将ZenDNN并入oneDNN主线，核心创新不在于单一硬件参数，而在于软件栈和生态层面的收敛：减少AMD与Intel在PyTorch CPU优化上的重复建设和碎片化，把AMD的调优经验带入上游开源项目，并借助UXL基金会的治理机制形成更统一的x86及跨架构AI软件基础。

影响和应用场景上，这一举措将主要利好使用PyTorch进行CPU推理的开发者和数据中心用户，包括需要在一混合Intel/AMD服务器环境中部署AI模型的场景，以及矩阵运算、卷积等常见深度学习负载。对AMD而言，从下游维护ZenDNN转向参与上游oneDNN，有助于降低长期维护成本并提升软件栈可见度；对Intel和UXL基金会而言，则扩大了oneDNN作为统一CPU AI加速库的覆盖范围。更广泛地看，这也反映出AI推理需求上升后，CPU厂商正从各自优化转向在开源框架和标准组织内协同，以改善跨平台开发体验和部署效率。

items.title: Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading Chinese factories to produce advanced RAM chips as AI data center competition ramps up
items.description: Samsung and SK Hynix are reportedly upgrading their factories to produce more advanced RAM chips designed for AI data centers in an attempt to fend off competition from Chinese companies.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The two biggest NAND flash memory manufacturers on the planet, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, are reportedly working to upgrade their Chinese factories to produce more advanced chips for use in AI data centers, Reuters reports. The move comes as the two companies continue to fight off competition from the fast-growing Chinese memory makers like CXMT. Fierce competition in the lucrative AI RAM market has already seen manufacturers slash consumer-focused production to allow them to increase production capacity for the more advanced — and money-spinning — components.Go deeper with TH Premium: Memory (Image credit: SK Hynix)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplySamsung debuts three next-generation memory technologies for AI data centersThe future of DRAM: From DDR5 to future ICsHigh-bandwidth memory roadmapInside the history of DRAM price-fixing lawsuitsCiting four people familiar with the companies' plans, the report claims that Samsung Electronics aims to switch its Xian plant to the production of 286-layer flash chips by the end of the year. SK Hynix has its sights set a little lower, targeting chips with 240 or more layers at its Dalian facility. That factory was taken over back in 2021, but a timescale for the new upgrades isn't clear.However, while Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are well placed to deal with the growing threat from Chinese chipmakers, both are faced with additional complications in the form of U.S. regulations. Export controls on chipmaking equipment were applied in 2022, with the aim of slowing China's technological progress. Both companies, based in South Korea, must now get licenses in order to install U.S.-built hardware in Chinese factories. The report points to this as a reason for the recent growth of Chinese firms like Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. (YMTC). The company told investors at a recent IPO preparation meeting that it aims to become the world's largest NAND flash producer by the end of 2027.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While both Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix say that they are working in consultation with the U.S. authorities, there's little doubt that this extra step has hampered the companies' ability to upgrade their factories to better meet the new AI memory demand.It's impossible to overstate just how key Samsung and SK Hynix are to NAND supply. Samsung's Xian factory produces around 40% of the company's global output. It currently produces chips that have around 200 layers, but Samsung's plans aim to boost that to 286 layers for V9 NAND chips. For its part, SK Hynix's Dalian plant currently produces chips with 192 layers, with the company's aim for 240-layer chips reportedly confirmed by three people familiar with the plans. A report from September 2026 noted that it was eyeing production of 3D NAND memory for use in solid-state storage (SSD) products. The country's largest DRAM producer, CXMT, posted $22.41 billion in revenue and $11.57 billion in net profit in the first half of 2026 after years of losing money. But despite this purple patch, the company is still much smaller than the likes of Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron. items.titleZh: 三星与SK海力士正升级其在中国的工厂以生产先进的内存芯片，随着AI数据中心竞争加剧。
items.descriptionZh:
据路透社报道，全球最大的两家NAND闪存制造商三星电子和SK海力士正在升级其中国工厂，以生产更先进的闪存芯片，供应AI数据中心。此举一方面是为了抓住AI带来的高利润存储需求，另一方面也是为应对中国存储厂商快速崛起带来的竞争压力。当前，AI数据中心正大量消耗全球内存与存储供应，厂商纷纷削减消费级产品产能，把资源转向更先进、利润更高的组件。

从具体计划看，三星电子计划在年底前将其西安工厂切换为生产286层闪存芯片。西安工厂约占三星全球NAND产量的40%，目前主要生产约200层芯片，升级后将用于V9 NAND产品。SK海力士则计划在其大连工厂生产240层或更高层数的芯片；该工厂于2021年接手，目前生产192层芯片，但新升级的时间表尚不明确。就层数对比而言，三星从约200层提升至286层，SK海力士从192层提升至240层以上，均体现3D NAND通过垂直堆叠更多层数来提高存储密度和单芯片容量的技术路线。层数增加有助于在相同或更小面积内提供更高容量，并面向AI数据中心所需的大容量、高密度企业级SSD等应用。

不过，两家韩国公司在中国工厂推进先进制程仍面临美国出口管制带来的复杂因素。2022年美国对芯片制造设备实施出口管制，旨在减缓中国技术进步。三星和SK海力士若要在中国工厂安装美国制造的设备，需要获得许可证。报道认为，这一限制也是中国长江存储等企业近期增长的原因之一。长江存储在此前IPO准备会议上曾向投资者表示，目标是到2027年底成为全球最大NAND闪存生产商。三星和SK海力士均表示正与美国当局协商，但这一额外审批环节无疑影响了它们升级工厂、更好满足AI存储需求的能力。

与此同时，中国厂商也在扩展产品线。中国主要芯片制造商CXMT正寻求从DRAM生产向3D NAND延伸，2026年9月的报道称其考虑生产用于固态硬盘的3D NAND。作为中国最大DRAM生产商，CXMT在经历多年亏损后，2026年上半年实现224.1亿美元营收和115.7亿美元净利润，但规模仍远小于三星、SK海力士和美光。整体来看，三星和SK海力士升级中国工厂，是在AI数据中心存储需求激增、中国厂商加速追赶以及美国设备出口管制多重因素交织下作出的产能与技术布局调整，其进展将影响全球NAND供应格局和AI存储组件的产能分配。

items.content: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing its full lineup of local AI hardware. RTX Spark, which launched last week, powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December. Announcements include: Underdog Desktop Agent now available for RTX Spark DGX Spark 64GB available on Friday, Oct. 23 NVIDIA Sync to support eight DGX Sparks and add Model Launcher this month October DGX Spark software update adds Wi-Fi Assistant and updates DGX Spark Skills DGX Station improves manageability with seven new integrations DGX Station for Windows launches in December with support for many manufacturing apps and agent harnesses Three new open source reference workflows for robotics on DGX Station NVIDIA Cloud Functions is coming in early access to DGX Station Recursive Flint, a new local coding model, is now available for NVIDIA local hardware Day-0 support for new Nemotron, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax and FLUX.3 AI models New accelerations for llama.cpp and vLLM inference engines and a new collection of checkpoints optimized for local AI hardware. Learn more about these local AI announcements below, and check out the demos and sessions at GTC Berlin. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements RTX Spark Brings Personal Agents to the Windows PC RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — running personal agents, accelerated content creation and 1440p 100 frames-per-second gaming with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. Here’s what early reviewers are saying about the platform since its October 16 release: “A dream machine for serious creators … ” — CGMag “Designed for the future of AI … ” — The Verge “An extremely capable, surprisingly portable and efficient machine … ” — PCMag Underdog, a new desktop agent app built for fully local, private AI, is also bringing its experience to RTX Spark. Powered by its Husky model-specific inference engine, Underdog runs models entirely on device, so personal agents can get work done without user data ever leaving the PC. Underdog is available now for download. To better enable developers and enthusiasts to build and customize local agents, many RTX Spark laptops come with an unlocked bootloader. During the GTC keynote, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang showed off how AI agents running on RTX Spark can be used to train Hugging Face’s Microduck robot using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Hermes Agent and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B. ASUS, Dell Technologies, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI laptops are available today, with Acer coming soon. Learn more about RTX Spark, and get started with the latest RTX Spark playbooks. DGX Spark Gives Developers Room to Build New DGX Spark 64GB systems — that can run models including Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B 24GB, Qwen3.8 27B and Gemma 4 26B-A4B — start rolling out from partners on Friday, Oct. 23. When workloads require more capacity, developers can connect multiple DGX Spark systems via built-in NVIDIA ConnectX-7 networking and NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant. This allows users to run advanced coding models like Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, DeepSeek v4 Flash 0731 and GLM 5.3 Flash. Now, DGX Spark supports clusters of up to eight units in manual configuration, enabling larger models, longer contexts, concurrent agents and distributed development. Ideal for small teams sharing a single cluster as a backend, with each developer running concurrent sessions against the same model, it delivers 1TB of unified memory — enough to run frontier-class models like GLM 5.3. Get started with the DGX Spark cluster playbook. NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher will also be available later this month. It simplifies access to local AI on a single DGX Spark or a cluster. With a few clicks, Model Launcher downloads a model and container suited to the configuration and connects the model to OpenCode. It automatically loads DGX Spark Skills for troubleshooting, device maintenance, access to official documentation and other workflow guidance. The October DGX Spark software update brings a new Wi-Fi Assistant that lets users switch networks when DGX Spark is running in appliance mode. Plus, DGX Spark Skills provide workflow-focused guidance in troubleshooting and device maintenance directly into NVIDIA Sync via OpenCode. DGX Spark systems are available directly from Acer, ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, Lenovo, MSI and NVIDIA. DGX Station Puts Frontier Intelligence at the Desk For larger teams, DGX Station offers 748GB of coherent memory and up to 20 petaflops of AI performance, enabling developers to run advanced models like GLM 5.3 and serve 30+ users at speeds comparable to those provided by cloud models. Adding scale, NVIDIA Sync now supports DGX Station, simplifying connections between two Linux-based systems. New integrations with Absolute Security, Splunk by Cisco, Fleet Device Management, Microsoft Intune, Perforce Puppet, Progress Software Chef and Tanium let IT teams manage DGX Station systems through enterprise setup, management and conformity processes, helping accelerate approvals and reduce deployment risk while minimizing time to first token. With the upcoming Windows-based systems, developers can build workflows that harness professional applications, run on NVIDIA RTX PRO GPUs and operate from agents that run their large language models (LLMs) on NVIDIA GB300 systems — all in one machine. DGX Station for Windows, expected from system manufacturer partners in December, extends local AI into the applications and operating environment enterprises already use. Engineers can run local models and agents in Windows-native software with access to AI models, tools and agents on the same system. DGX Station for Windows will feature support for manufacturing applications from nTop, Dassault Systèmes, Keysight Technologies, MathWorks, Rockwell Automation, Siemens, Synopsys, Unity and Altera for AI-guided design, simulation, validation and engineering automation. Users will be able to run agents using Hermes Agent, Perplexity or Aible on premises for agentic control in enterprise environments. The same local, controlled computing model extends to robotics. DGX Station gives robotics teams dedicated compute for post-training, simulation and evaluation, shortening iteration cycles without waiting for shared infrastructure. NVIDIA released three open source reference workflows that bring GPT-6 Astra, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Lab-Arena and Cosmos to NVIDIA DGX Station. Developers can use them to refine GR00T 1.7 models with reinforcement learning, train dexterous manipulation skills and post-train Cosmos world models for synthetic data generation. NVIDIA Cloud Functions is coming in early access to Linux-based DGX Station. Teams can register local model endpoints in a shared catalog and access them through one OpenAI-compatible entry point. Developers can upgrade the model behind an endpoint without changing application code, while teammates can use shared models without direct machine access. This turns a DGX Station into a locally controlled inference service for a team. DGX Station brings local iteration to AI factory development. On the show floor at GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is previewing DSX OS running on DGX Station to simulate AI factory operations before full infrastructure is available. Another demo will showcase DGX Station systems powering a local token factory for more than 30 software developers. DGX Station systems are shipping today from ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, MSI, Supermicro and Exxact. DGX Station for Windows systems are expected to begin shipping later this year from ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, MSI and Supermicro. Introducing Recursive Flint — A New Local Coding Model Optimized for RTX Spark Today, frontier AI lab Recursive Superintelligence released Recursive Flint, a local LLM built for fast, accurate coding. A 40-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 2.5 billion active parameters, Recursive Flint delivers fast inference and performs well in agentic coding benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro v2, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench verified. Recursive Flint was built using Recursive’s Eureka Machine, a system for large-scale automated AI research. It automates the full research loop: proposes ideas, implements them, runs experiments to validate ideas and uses the results to decide what to try next — creating specialized kernels that boosted Flint’s generation speed on RTX Spark by 55% without changing the model’s weights. Developers can download the open weights on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license and run the model on RTX Spark and DGX Spark systems, as well as GeForce RTX and RTX PRO GPUs. Developers can also post-train the model with NeMo Automodel for supervised fine-tuning and low-rank adaptation, or LoRa, as well as NeMo RL for group relative policy optimization. New Models With Day-Zero Support NVIDIA is also adding day-zero model support for NVIDIA Nemotron Bolt E4B 4B, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, Liquid AI’s LFM2.5-24B-A2B, plus the FLUX.3 Klein diffusion model. Nemotron Bolt E4B 4GB packs natural conversation and multi-turn agentic skills into as little as 4GB of memory, powering fast local voice assistants, interactive game characters and embedded interfaces on NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs, NVIDIA Jetson devices, and RTX and DGX Spark. Bolt E4B 4GB releases on Friday, Oct. 23. Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6-billion-parameter open weights image model for generation and editing. NVIDIA-optimized builds let it run on GeForce RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM and create a 1-megapixel image in about four seconds on an RTX 5090 GPU. MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a new open model built for NVIDIA DGX Station and DGX Spark, bringing long-context AI to the desktop. Liquid AI’s LFM2.5-24B-A2B is an open weights reasoning model that activates just 2 billion of its 24 billion parameters per token, making it fast enough to run private, tool-calling AI agents directly on PCs. Plus, NVIDIA has released a new collection of model checkpoints optimized for RAM efficiency on local AI hardware, enabling frontier-class open models to run with sufficient memory left over for KV cache. Each checkpoint is quantized while staying close to full-precision accuracy, starting with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local on a single DGX Spark 128GB or RTX PRO 6000 and GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local on two systems. Developers can post-train on day zero with NeMo AutoModel on both DGX Spark and RTX Spark, with example recipes for Nemotron Bolt E4B, Flux 3 Image Klein and more. Accelerated AI Inference NVIDIA continues to work with the llama.cpp and vLLM open source communities to accelerate agentic workloads on local hardware. In llama.cpp, new speculative decoding support with MTP for Qwen 3.8 Flash Next makes end-to-end agentic tasks up to 1.4x faster on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. In vLLM, faster speculative decoding and new FlashInfer prefill kernels for Qwen’s linear-attention layers make agentic tasks with Qwen3.8 27B up to 1.3x faster on DGX Spark. On DGX Station, GLM 5.3 Flash gets up to 1.2x higher throughput. Check out NVIDIA’s local AI inference recipes to try these latest optimizations. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. items.descriptionZh:
在柏林GTC大会上，NVIDIA展示了其完整的本地AI硬件产品线，包括面向Windows PC个人代理的RTX Spark、面向Linux开发者的DGX Spark，以及面向企业团队运行前沿工作负载的DGX Station（Windows版本将于12月推出）。

RTX Spark于10月16日发布，配备最高128GB统一内存和1 petaflop AI算力，可运行个人代理、加速内容创作，并支持1440p 100帧/秒游戏。早期评测将其称为“面向严肃创作者的梦想机器”（CGMag）、“为AI未来而设计”（The Verge）以及“性能极强、便携性出人意料且高效的机器”（PCMag）。专为完全本地、私密AI打造的新桌面代理应用Underdog同步登陆RTX Spark，其基于Husky模型专用推理引擎，所有模型均在设备端运行，用户数据不会离开PC。许多RTX Spark笔记本还提供解锁的bootloader，方便开发者构建和定制本地代理。在GTC主题演讲中，黄仁勋演示了RTX Spark上的AI代理如何使用NVIDIA Isaac Lab、Hermes Agent和Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B训练Hugging Face的Microduck机器人。华硕、戴尔、惠普、联想、微软和微星笔记本现已上市，宏碁即将跟进。

DGX Spark 64GB系统将于10月23日（周五）起通过合作伙伴陆续推出，可运行Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B 24GB、Qwen3.8 27B和Gemma 4 26B-A4B等模型。当工作负载需要更大容量时，开发者可通过内置NVIDIA ConnectX-7网络和NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant连接多台DGX Spark，运行Qwen 3.8 Flash Next、DeepSeek v4 Flash 0731和GLM 5.3 Flash等高级编码模型。目前DGX Spark支持手动配置最多8台集群，提供1TB统一内存，足以运行GLM 5.3等前沿级模型，适合小团队共享单一集群作为后端、每位开发者对同一模型运行并发会话。NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher将于本月晚些时候推出，简化单台或集群DGX Spark上本地AI的访问——只需几次点击即可下载适配配置的模型和容器并连接至OpenCode，同时自动加载DGX Spark Skills用于故障排除、设备维护和官方文档访问。10月DGX Spark软件更新新增Wi-Fi Assistant，支持设备在设备模式下切换网络。DGX Spark系统可直接从宏碁、华硕、戴尔、技嘉、惠普、联想、微星和NVIDIA购买。

面向更大团队的DGX Station提供748GB一致内存和最高20 petaflops AI性能，可运行GLM 5.3等高级模型并以媲美云模型的速度服务30名以上用户。NVIDIA Sync现已支持DGX Station，简化两台Linux系统之间的连接。与Absolute Security、Cisco旗下Splunk、Fleet Device Management、Microsoft Intune、Perforce Puppet、Progress Software Chef和Tanium的新集成，使IT团队能够通过企业级设置、管理和合规流程管理DGX Station系统，加速审批并降低部署风险。即将推出的Windows版DGX Station预计12月由系统制造商合作伙伴推出，将本地AI扩展至企业已在使用的应用和操作系统环境。工程师可在Windows原生软件中运行本地模型和代理，同时访问同一系统上的AI模型、工具和代理。该版本将支持nTop、达索系统、是德科技、MathWorks、罗克韦尔自动化、西门子、新思科技、Unity和Altera的制造应用，用于AI引导的设计、仿真、验证和工程自动化；用户还可使用Hermes Agent、Perplexity或Aible在本地运行代理，实现企业环境中的代理控制。

同样的本地受控计算模式也延伸至机器人领域。DGX Station为机器人团队提供专用算力用于后训练、仿真和评估，缩短迭代周期而无需等待共享基础设施。NVIDIA发布了三个开源参考工作流，将GPT-6 Astra、NVIDIA Isaac Lab、Isaac Lab-Arena和Cosmos引入DGX Station，开发者可用其通过强化学习精炼GR00T 1.7模型、训练灵巧操作技能，以及后训练Cosmos世界模型用于合成数据生成。NVIDIA Cloud Functions即将以早期访问形式登陆Linux版DGX Station，团队可在共享目录中注册本地模型端点，并通过一个OpenAI兼容入口访问；开发者可在不更改应用代码的情况下升级端点背后的模型，队友无需直接访问机器即可使用共享模型，从而将DGX Station转变为团队本地控制的推理服务。在柏林GTC展台上，NVIDIA还预览了在DGX Station上运行DSX OS以在完整基础设施可用前模拟AI工厂运营，另一演示展示了DGX Station系统为30多名软件开发者提供本地令牌工厂支持。DGX Station系统现由华硕、戴尔、技嘉、惠普、微星、Supermicro和Exxact发货；Windows版预计今年晚些时候由华硕、戴尔、技嘉、惠普、微星和Supermicro开始发货。

前沿AI实验室Recursive Superintelligence发布了Recursive Flint，这是一款为快速、准确编码而构建的本地大语言模型。该模型为400亿参数混合专家模型，每token激活25亿参数，推理速度快，在SWE-Bench Pro v2、Terminal-Bench 2.1和SWE-bench verified等代理编码基准中表现良好。Recursive Flint使用Recursive的Eureka Machine构建——这是一个大规模自动化AI研究系统，可自动完成提出想法、实现、运行实验验证并据此决定下一步的完整研究循环，其创建的专业内核在不改变模型权重的情况下将Flint在RTX Spark上的生成速度提升了55%。开发者可在Hugging Face上以Apache 2.0许可证下载开放权重，并在RTX Spark、DGX Spark以及GeForce RTX和RTX PRO GPU上运行该模型，还可使用NeMo Automodel进行监督微调和LoRA后训练，或使用NeMo RL进行组相对策略优化。

NVIDIA还新增了对多款模型的day-zero支持，包括NVIDIA Nemotron Bolt E4B 4B、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、MiniMax、Liquid AI的LFM2.5-24B-A2B，以及FLUX.3 Klein扩散模型。Nemotron Bolt E4B 4GB仅需4GB内存即可提供自然对话和多轮代理技能，在GeForce RTX GPU、NVIDIA Jetson设备以及RTX和DGX Spark上驱动快速本地语音助手、互动游戏角色和嵌入式界面，将于10月23日发布。Black Forest Labs的FLUX 3 Image Klein是56亿参数开放权重图像生成与编辑模型，NVIDIA优化版本可在仅8GB显存的GeForce RTX GPU上运行，在RTX 5090上约4秒生成100万像素图像。MiniMax M3.1 Flash是为DGX Station和DGX Spark构建的新开放模型，将长上下文AI带入桌面。Liquid AI的LFM2.5-24B-A2B是开放权重推理模型，每token仅激活240亿参数中的20亿，速度足以在PC上直接运行私密工具调用AI代理。此外，NVIDIA发布了针对本地AI硬件RAM效率优化的新模型检查点集合，使前沿级开放模型运行时留有足够内存用于KV缓存；每个检查点在量化的同时保持接近全精度准确率，首批包括可在单台DGX Spark 128GB或RTX PRO 6000上运行的Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local，以及需两台系统的GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local。开发者可在DGX Spark和RTX Spark上使用NeMo AutoModel进行day-zero后训练，并获得Nemotron Bolt E4B、Flux 3 Image Klein等模型的示例配方。

在推理加速方面，NVIDIA持续与llama.cpp和vLLM开源社区合作加速本地硬件上的代理工作负载。在llama.cpp中，针对Qwen 3.8 Flash Next的新MTP推测解码支持使NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell上的端到端代理任务提速最高1.4倍。在vLLM中，更快的推测解码和针对Qwen线性注意力层的新FlashInfer预填充内核使DGX Spark上Qwen3.8 27B的代理任务提速最高1.3倍；在DGX Station上，GLM 5.3 Flash吞吐量提升最高1.2倍。

items.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
items.description: General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding […]
items.content: General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence, a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Learning through interaction requires a continuous cycle of generating experience, evaluating outcomes and updating models, requiring infrastructure that can support the entire process at scale. A5X brings Vera Rubin into Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer as an integrated system, combining compute, networking and storage to support experience-driven learning at scale. “We’re building superlearners that continually improve through their own experience,” said David Silver, founder and CEO of Ineffable Intelligence. “That demands both substantial compute and a tight connection between generating experience and training on it, so each improvement in the agent can quickly shape its next experience. Vera Rubin’s combination of compute performance and high-bandwidth connectivity, between the Vera CPU and Rubin GPUs and between the Rubin GPUs within the rack, allow us to push the scale and ambition of our reinforcement learning research further.” WPP, a London-based marketing and communications company, has also demonstrated its creative agent reference architecture on NVIDIA Vera Rubin-based A5X instances using NVIDIA Nemotron models and NVIDIA OpenShell, part of the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for safe AI agents. The agents turn conversational requests into multistep creative workflows, such as video generation, upscaling and restyling, with human approval before execution. OpenShell provides governed sandboxes for agent execution, helping control access to sensitive brand assets and creative tools. In WPP’s initial tests, workloads that typically required a multi-node cluster ran on a single A5X instance. As organizations deploy agentic systems, they need to protect the proprietary models and sensitive data that power these systems — even when running on infrastructure they don’t own. Google Cloud will be among the first cloud providers to offer NVIDIA Confidential Computing at rack scale on bare metal instances such as A4X Max instances powered by NVIDIA GB300 NVL72. Additionally, Google Cloud is making Confidential Computing generally available on G4 VMs powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, offering a flexible platform for confidential inference and fine-tuning. Customers including Vertebrae, Polaris Cloud and Confidential Core AI are using Confidential G4 for conversational privacy, verifiable agent execution and policy-governed enterprise intelligence. To support energy-efficient deployment at scale, Google Cloud and NVIDIA are exploring NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS capabilities for Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to help optimize performance per watt and expand capacity within available data-center power budgets. Learn more about NVIDIA Vera Rubin and Google Cloud A5X instances. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

items.titleZh: 谷歌云与英伟达宣布 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 基础设施正式可用
items.descriptionZh:
Google Cloud 宣布，基于 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 的 A5X 实例将于下月正式可用，并计划把可用范围扩展到欧洲，为云客户提供集训练、推理和大规模强化学习于一体的集成平台。A5X 将 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72、NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs、Google Cloud Virgo 网络以及 Google Cloud 第四代先进液冷技术整合在一起，面向大规模智能体推理和强化学习等 demanding 工作负载。Google Cloud 还计划把基于 Vera Rubin 的基础设施跨多个站点扩展到最多 96 万块 Rubin GPU，体现出其面向大规模 AI 训练与经验驱动学习的部署规模。

从技术架构看，A5X 并非单一算力实例，而是把计算、网络和存储整合进 Google Cloud 的 AI Hypercomputer，以支持“生成经验—评估结果—更新模型”的持续循环。强化学习和智能体系统需要不断通过交互产生新经验，并快速把经验用于训练和模型更新，因此对算力规模以及经验生成与训练之间的连接效率提出很高要求。Vera Rubin 平台提供 Vera CPU 与 Rubin GPU 之间、以及机架内 Rubin GPU 之间的高带宽连接，旨在缩短这一闭环链路，使智能体的一次改进能够更快影响下一次经验生成。NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs 和 Google Cloud Virgo 网络则承担高速网络互连，第四代液冷技术用于支撑高密度部署和能效管理。

首批客户方面，由 AlphaGo 创造者 David Silver 创立的伦敦技术公司 Ineffable Intelligence 成为首家访问 A5X 的客户，正在利用该平台推进大规模强化学习和“超学习器”系统。所谓超学习器，是能够持续从自身经验中学习并不断改进的系统。David Silver 表示，这类系统既需要大量算力，也需要在经验生成与基于经验训练之间建立紧密连接，使智能体的每次改进都能快速塑造其下一次经验；Vera Rubin 的计算性能和高带宽连接能力，使其能够进一步扩大强化学习研究的规模和目标。

应用层面，伦敦营销与传播公司 WPP 已在基于 Vera Rubin 的 A5X 实例上演示其创意智能体参考架构，使用 NVIDIA Nemotron 模型和 NVIDIA OpenShell。该架构可把对话式请求转化为多步骤创意工作流，例如视频生成、图像放大和风格重塑，并在执行前引入人工批准。OpenShell 为智能体执行提供受治理的沙箱，帮助控制对敏感品牌资产和创意工具的访问。在 WPP 的初期测试中，过去通常需要多节点集群运行的工作负载，可以在单个 A5X 实例上运行，显示出集成平台在特定创意智能体工作负载上的资源集约能力。

安全和隐私也是该新闻的重点。随着企业部署智能体系统，即使运行在非自有基础设施上，也需要保护专有模型和敏感数据。Google Cloud 将成为首批在裸金属实例上提供机架级 NVIDIA Confidential Computing 的云提供商之一，例如基于 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 的 A4X Max 实例。同时，Google Cloud 正在基于 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU 的 G4 VM 上正式提供 Confidential Computing，为机密推理和微调提供更灵活的平台。Vertebrae、Polaris Cloud 和 Confidential Core AI 等客户正使用 Confidential G4 支持对话隐私、可验证的智能体执行以及受策略治理的企业智能。为支持规模化且节能的部署，Google Cloud 与 NVIDIA 还在探索 NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS 能力在 Vera Rubin 基础设施上的应用，以优化每瓦性能，并在可用数据中心功耗预算内扩展容量。总体来看，A5X 的核心意义在于把训练、推理和大规模强化学习所需算力、网络、存储、液冷与安全能力整合为云上系统，服务持续学习型智能体和复杂创意工作流等新一代 AI 应用。

items.title: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents
items.description: Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design.  NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for […]
items.content: Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign: AI Clouds Building European AI Infrastructure Europe is home to world-class research, engineering talent, industrial expertise, data, the next generation of models and applications that requires large-scale computing close to where that knowledge resides. Regional AI clouds provide the infrastructure foundation on which model builders, enterprises and entire industries can grow. As AI factories scale, power becomes a constraint which makes it critical for every watt to produce more intelligence. Nscale is using the NVIDIA DSX Platform to coordinate power allocation with workload requirements. In tests using NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems, Nscale demonstrated that NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS enabled 37% more GPUs and nearly 50% higher aggregate inference throughput within the same provisioned power budget. Nscale also plans to deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure for frontier-model training and production workloads to support leading model and application builders using its full-stack, vertically integrated platform with expansion across five European markets. Crusoe is developing Spark, its liquid-cooled modular AI factories designed for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, to bring Crusoe Cloud capacity closer to users for low-latency AI inference. Crusoe Cloud serves leading model and application builders across EMEA, including Base44, Gradium, LTX and Wonderful. Aleria, Cassava Technologies, Firebird, G42, Radiant, SWI Compute and Vultr are also developing and expanding NVIDIA-powered AI infrastructure across Europe, the Nordics, Africa and Central Asia. Regional capacity from AI clouds combines the full-stack NVIDIA DSX AI Factory platform, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin, NVIDIA BlueField and NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, giving customers greater choice and control over where workloads and data reside while advancing sovereign computing services and economic growth. Open: Models and Libraries, From Training to Inference Across the ecosystem, AI clouds are expanding NVIDIA-powered infrastructure and services for developers to build applications with open models and libraries. This new capacity supports model training, fine-tuning for specialized tasks and inference at scale, including applications deployed at the edge. For production inference, Nebius has adopted NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX, using Spectrum-X Ethernet networking to integrate it with Vera Rubin NVL72 on Nebius Token Factory. The combination will bring faster token generation to latency-sensitive applications and agentic systems through the platform’s managed serverless and dedicated endpoints and familiar application programming interfaces. For robotics and physical AI, Nebius offers a purpose-built AI cloud solution that includes its full-stack Physical AI Workbench. Robotics companies including Rhoda AI, RoboForce and Sereact are building on the platform. The company also launched three NVIDIA retail agent blueprints — covering inventory, store operations, and fine-tuning —- into early access on Nebius infrastructure. Nebius is expanding its cloud services widely across the continent with its Physical AI Living Lab, and in Germany as a computer supplier for the Next Frontier Challenge of SPRIND, the Federal Agency for Breakthrough Innovation. Baseten has developed a specialized model for code-review routing with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning used by CodeRabbit. Through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, CodeRabbit improved routing agreement from 75.8% to 80.7% while reducing estimated inference costs by 50% for the evaluated workload. The results demonstrate how AI developers can customize NVIDIA open models for specialized tasks while improving accuracy and inference efficiency. Fireworks and Era4 are partnering to bring open models to enterprises across the U.K. and Europe. The collaboration combines Fireworks’ model training and inference platform with direct liquid-cooled capacity powered by NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs at Era4’s Chesterfield facility, supporting plans for enterprise AI solutions in financial services, insurance and life sciences. Mistral is expanding its NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure to support model training, customization and inference. The expansion includes NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure planned for delivery in 2027. Trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral-operated European data centers, Mistral Large 4 is the company’s latest frontier multimodal model, advancing capabilities across coding, agentic workflows and multimodal understanding. Verda plans to deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin, continuing to promote open weight models with NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Cosmos already in production, and using the NVIDIA Dynamo open source framework for inference optimization. Safe: Secure Boundaries for AI Agents, From Silicon to Software As developers connect models to tools and business systems, they also need controls over what agents can access and do. Announced at GTC Berlin, the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture with support from AI cloud ecosystem partners. Built on the foundation of NVIDIA OpenShell secure runtime software, the architecture is designed to give organizations full-stack control to deploy AI agents with clear boundaries around what agents can access and do. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 for model inference, NVIDIA Vera CPUs with OpenShell for agent harnesses and tool use, and NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs running NVIDIA Sentry for in-silicon enforcement. Each play a distinct role in delivering that control, working together so agents can achieve what they’re meant to do without moving beyond the boundaries people set for them. Partners including Aleria, Baseten, Cassava, CoreWeave, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, Firebird, Fireworks, Firmus, G42, GMI Cloud, IREN, Lambda, Lightning AI, Nebius, Nscale, Radiant Verda and Vultr are supporting the OpenShell Reference Architecture to enable secure agentic deployments for their customers. Together, European AI clouds are connecting regional infrastructure investment with the work of building and deploying AI. Expanded capacity gives builders more places to run workloads. Model and inference services help them put that capacity to use. Agent controls address what applications are allowed to do as they move into production. Explore NVIDIA Cloud Partners for infrastructure and services, and the OpenShell Reference Architecture for agent deployment controls. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

items.titleZh: NVIDIA 云合作伙伴在欧洲规模化扩张——主权、开放，专为安全的 AI 智能体打造
items.descriptionZh:
在欧洲，AI原生企业和开发者对算力的需求正加速推动区域AI云生态发展。开发者希望获得更靠近数据源的算力、可定制并能大规模服务的开放模型，以及从设计之初就强调安全的全栈基础设施。在此背景下，NVIDIA Cloud Partners正在欧洲、北欧、非洲和中亚扩展面向模型训练与推理的区域算力，帮助开发者构建智能体AI（agentic AI）和物理AI应用，并为智能体可访问和可执行的范围建立边界。这一生态正把欧洲的能源、数据、研究和工业专长转化为“生产性智能”，支持新模型、新应用、新组织和新岗位，同时让用户对AI开发与部署的地点和方式拥有更多控制权。

在主权AI云和基础设施方面，区域AI云被视为模型构建者、企业和行业增长的基础设施底座。随着AI工厂规模扩大，电力成为关键约束，提高每瓦所产出的智能变得尤为重要。Nscale使用NVIDIA DSX平台协调电力分配与工作负载需求；在基于NVIDIA GB300 NVL72系统的测试中，DSX MaxLPS使同一供电预算内可部署的GPU数量增加37%，聚合推理吞吐提高近50%。Nscale还计划部署NVIDIA Vera Rubin基础设施，用于前沿模型训练和生产负载，并通过其全栈垂直整合平台扩展至五个欧洲市场。Crusoe正在开发面向Vera Rubin平台的液冷模块化AI工厂Spark，以把Crusoe Cloud容量更靠近用户，支持低延迟AI推理；其Crusoe Cloud服务EMEA地区的模型和应用构建者，包括Base44、Gradium、LTX和Wonderful。Aleria、Cassava Technologies、Firebird、G42、Radiant、SWI Compute和Vultr也在欧洲、北欧、非洲和中亚扩展NVIDIA驱动的AI基础设施。区域AI云能力结合NVIDIA DSX AI Factory全栈平台，包括Vera Rubin、BlueField和Spectrum-X以太网网络，使客户能更好地选择和控制工作负载与数据所在位置，并推进主权计算服务和经济增长。

在开放模型、库和推理服务方面，AI云正在扩展NVIDIA驱动的基础设施和服务，支持开发者使用开放模型和库构建应用。新增容量覆盖模型训练、面向专门任务的微调和大规模推理，包括边缘部署应用。Nebius在生产推理中采用NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX，并通过Spectrum-X以太网将其与Vera Rubin NVL72集成到Nebius Token Factory，借助托管无服务器和专用端点及熟悉的API，为延迟敏感应用和智能体系统带来更快的token生成。面向机器人和物理AI，Nebius提供包含全栈Physical AI Workbench的专用AI云方案，Rhoda AI、RoboForce和Sereact等机器人公司正在该平台构建应用；Nebius还将三个NVIDIA零售智能体蓝图（库存、门店运营和微调）引入其基础设施的早期访问，并通过Physical AI Living Lab扩展欧洲云服务，同时在德国作为SPRIND“Next Frontier Challenge”的计算机供应商。Baseten使用Nemotron 3.5 Lightning开发了代码审查路由专用模型，CodeRabbit采用后通过监督微调和强化学习，将路由一致性从75.8%提升至80.7%，并在评估工作负载中把估计推理成本降低50%，展示了企业如何针对专门任务定制NVIDIA开放模型，同时提升准确性和推理效率。Fireworks与Era4合作，将开放模型带给英国和欧洲企业，结合Fireworks的模型训练与推理平台和Era4 Chesterfield设施中由NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU驱动的直接液冷容量，支持金融服务、保险和生命科学领域的企业AI方案。Mistral正在扩展NVIDIA加速计算基础设施，以支持模型训练、定制和推理，其中包括计划于2027年交付的Vera Rubin基础设施；其最新前沿多模态模型Mistral Large 4在Mistral运营的欧洲数据中心使用3800块NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU训练，提升了编码、智能体工作流和多模态理解能力。Verda计划部署Vera Rubin，并继续推广开放权重模型，NVIDIA Nemotron和NVIDIA Cosmos已投入生产，同时使用NVIDIA Dynamo开源框架优化推理。

在智能体安全边界方面，随着开发者把模型连接到工具和业务系统，他们需要控制智能体可访问和可执行的内容。NVIDIA在GTC Berlin发布NVIDIA OpenShell参考架构，并获得AI云生态伙伴支持。该架构基于OpenShell安全运行时软件，旨在让组织获得全栈控制能力，在部署AI智能体时明确其访问和行动边界。其中，NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72用于模型推理，NVIDIA Vera CPU配合OpenShell用于智能体运行框架和工具使用，NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU运行NVIDIA Sentry实现芯片级执行。三者协同，使智能体能够完成预期任务，同时不越过人类设定的边界。Aleria、Baseten、Cassava、CoreWeave、Crusoe、DigitalOcean、Firebird、Fireworks、Firmus、G42、GMI Cloud、IREN、Lambda、Lightning AI、Nebius、Nscale、Radiant、Verda和Vultr等伙伴正在支持该参考架构，为客户提供安全的智能体部署能力。

总体来看，欧洲AI云正把区域基础设施投资与AI构建和部署连接起来：扩展的容量为开发者提供更多运行工作负载的地点，模型和推理服务帮助利用这些容量，智能体控制则解决应用进入生产后可执行行为的边界问题。这一生态有望提升欧洲在主权计算、数据驻留、能效和行业AI应用方面的能力，并推动金融、保险、生命科学、零售、机器人、代码开发和多模态应用等场景落地。

items.title: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA
items.description: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries, as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle.  Bringing those capabilities together on the factory floor, the NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) is now available in […]
items.content: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries, as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle. Bringing those capabilities together on the factory floor, the NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) is now available in early access on GitHub, providing a path for developers to build and deploy always-on factory manager agents that coordinate work across machines, and specialist agents focused on use cases such as visual inspection, root cause analysis, report generation and fleet management. These agents can connect to frontier models, including NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron, and foundational knowledge including computer-aided design, product lifecycle management, simulation software, and IT and operational technology systems. Building on the FOX blueprint enables the ecosystem to build industrial agents that monitor factory operations in real time, correlate visual findings and machine logs to investigate problems, and coordinate responses. With Cosmos in-context learning, these agents can adapt using examples and documentation, without fine-tuning. Siemens is integrating agents built using FOX into Intelligence Center X, its agentic enterprise system, to help identify root causes and coordinate factory operations, for estimated cost savings of 20%. Siemens’ Process Preparation X agents use NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory tools and skills to generate defect images for circuit-board inspection. At its Erlangen electronics factory, Siemens used this approach to reduce calibration time of inspection processes by 40%. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Accelerating Engineering From the First Design NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries accelerate simulation, giving engineers faster feedback to explore design alternatives before committing to physical prototypes. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is releasing cuDSS for general availability, accelerating the demanding calculations behind the complex simulations of structural stress, fluid flow, electromagnetic fields and semiconductor device behavior. Mercedes-Benz uses Siemens’ Simcenter STAR-CCM+ running on NVIDIA GPUs to compare vehicle designs through faster aerodynamic simulations. In factories, the company applies NVIDIA Cosmos 3 and the Metropolis VSS blueprint to build agents for vehicle inspection and windshield assembly verification, detecting deviations and ensuring consistently high quality. Cadence is benchmarking automotive fluid-dynamics workloads on NVIDIA GPUs to assess opportunities for faster design iteration, while Autodesk brings the NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo and Warp frameworks into NavPack, integrated with Autodesk Alias, to help designers like those at Bentley’s predict vehicle performance and iterate faster using simulation-trained AI. imec and Infineon are accelerating semiconductor simulation with Synopsys software and NVIDIA accelerated computing. Benchmarks of S-Litho on imec’s model show up to 40x speedup, while Infineon uses Sentaurus Device with NVIDIA CUDA libraries to achieve a 12x speedup in 3D breakdown simulation for next-generation power devices. Leonardo is working with Neural Concept on AI-driven aircraft design, tapping NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to bring aircraft geometry and aerodynamic simulation results together. Video courtesy of Neural Concept and Leonardo. Car manufacturers use Dassault Systèmes’ LEO & AURA Virtual Companions, powered by NVIDIA Nemotron, and orchestrating CATIA AI Agents & SIMULIA AI Agents with SIMULIA solvers, accelerated by NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, to rapidly design and virtually test vehicle doors before building physical prototypes. UniversalAGI is working with Saab to protect sailors from life-threatending wave impacts at sea, using UniversalAGI’s Latent Interaction Field Transformer physics AI foundation models with accelerated processing by NVIDIA Warp to evaluate thousands of wave conditions and headings in real time instead of days. These capabilities enable vessels to anticipate dangerous motion and autonomously select safer routes to avoid putting sailors at risk, while NVIDIA Omniverse libraries help visualize vessel behavior at sea. PhysicsX is working with GB1, Britain’s America’s Cup team, on AI-powered yacht design, using NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to visualize hull geometry and pressure fields, while Fermioniq’s Sofia agent helps Deltares and Dutch ministries model river flow by translating natural-language requests into simulation solvers built on NVIDIA Warp. Mistral plans to use CUDA-X, Warp and Omniverse libraries to accelerate physics simulation and generate training data for engineering AI models. Testing Factories and Robots Virtually NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac libraries enable digital twins and robotics simulation, helping manufacturers evaluate production systems and robot behavior before making changes on the factory floor. Video courtesy of Agile Robots, Audi and Dassault Systèmes. Audi uses a battery-production digital twin built with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to test production concepts before physical equipment is available. The company is also working with Dassault Systèmes and Agile Robots to simulate and validate mobile humanoid robots and logistics processes in DELMIA virtual twins built with Omniverse libraries. Schaeffler is integrating digital twins of its humanoid actuators — components that move robot joints — with NVIDIA Isaac simulation frameworks, helping its robotics partners evaluate component behavior in simulation and reduce physical testing. At Volkswagen Sachsen’s Transparent Factory, Wandelbots uses NOVA with Isaac Sim, built on Omniverse and OpenUSD, to validate assembly workflows digitally and prepare applications for physical robots. Falkor, a KONGSBERG company, is integrating agents and NVIDIA Omniverse libraries into its platform. With Microsoft Azure NCv6 virtual machines powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, agents with spatial intelligence combine engineering data, operating information and 3D equipment geometry to see, simulate and reason over industrial facilities, supporting inspection and maintenance use cases across the process and energy industries. Video courtesy of Falkor, a KONGSBERG company. The same simulation approach extends to AI infrastructure. Schneider Electric, together with AVEVA, is developing an AI factory digital twin built for Nscale with Omniverse libraries to help engineers compare power, cooling and equipment configurations before making physical changes. 在欧洲工业界，NVIDIA正以CUDA-X、Omniverse、Cosmos和Nemotron开放模型为核心，推动工程设计与制造全生命周期的智能化。其目标是提高生产率、加速创新并创造新的经济增长机会。NVIDIA在GTC Berlin期间集中展示了这些能力在欧洲汽车、半导体、航空、能源、机器人和工业软件企业中的落地进展，并推出NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint（FOX）的GitHub早期访问版本。FOX为开发者提供构建和部署“常驻工厂经理智能体”的路径，这类智能体可协调机器之间的工作，也可衍生出视觉检测、根因分析、报告生成和车队管理等专用智能体。它们能连接Cosmos、Nemotron等前沿模型，并接入计算机辅助设计、产品生命周期管理、仿真软件以及IT和运营技术系统等基础知识源。借助Cosmos的上下文学习能力，智能体可通过示例和文档适配新任务，而无需微调。生态伙伴可基于FOX构建工业智能体，实时监控工厂运营，将视觉发现与机器日志关联以调查问题，并协调响应。

西门子正将基于FOX构建的智能体集成到其智能体化企业系统Intelligence Center X中，用于识别根因和协调工厂运营，预计可节省20%成本。西门子Process Preparation X智能体利用NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory工具与技能生成电路板检测所需的缺陷图像；在埃尔朗根电子工厂，这一方法将检测流程的校准时间缩短了40%。在工程设计中，CUDA-X库加速仿真，使工程师在投入物理原型前更快获得反馈并探索设计方案。NVIDIA在GTC Berlin宣布cuDSS正式可用，可加速结构应力、流体流动、电磁场和半导体器件行为等复杂仿真背后的高要求计算。梅赛德斯-奔驰使用运行在NVIDIA GPU上的西门子Simcenter STAR-CCM+，通过更快的空气动力学仿真比较车辆设计；在工厂中则应用NVIDIA Cosmos 3和Metropolis VSS蓝图构建车辆检测与挡风玻璃装配验证智能体，检测偏差并确保质量稳定。Cadence正在NVIDIA GPU上对汽车流体动力学工作负载进行基准测试，评估加快设计迭代的机会；Autodesk将NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo和Warp框架引入NavPack并与Autodesk Alias集成，帮助宾利等设计师利用仿真训练的人工智能预测车辆性能并更快迭代。imec和英飞凌使用新思科技软件与NVIDIA加速计算加速半导体仿真：S-Litho在imec模型上的基准显示最高40倍加速；英飞凌使用Sentaurus Device与NVIDIA CUDA库，在下一代功率器件的3D击穿仿真中实现12倍加速。莱昂纳多与Neural Concept合作开展AI驱动飞机设计，利用Omniverse库整合飞机几何与气动仿真结果。汽车制造商还使用达索系统由Nemotron驱动的LEO & AURA虚拟伴侣，编排CATIA AI Agents、SIMULIA AI Agents与SIMULIA求解器，并通过CUDA-X库加速，在制造物理原型前快速设计和虚拟测试车门。

在更广泛的工程与安全应用中，UniversalAGI与萨博合作，利用Latent Interaction Field Transformer物理AI基础模型和NVIDIA Warp加速处理，实时评估数千种海浪条件和航向，而非耗时数天，从而帮助船舶预测危险运动并自主选择更安全航线，Omniverse库则用于可视化船舶海上行为。PhysicsX与英国美洲杯船队GB1合作开展AI驱动游艇设计，使用Omniverse库可视化船体几何和压力场；Fermioniq的Sofia智能体帮助Deltares和荷兰政府部门进行河流流动建模，将自然语言请求转换为基于NVIDIA Warp的仿真求解器。Mistral计划使用CUDA-X、Warp和Omniverse库加速物理仿真，并为工程AI模型生成训练数据。在工厂和机器人虚拟测试方面，Omniverse与Isaac库支持数字孪生和机器人仿真，帮助制造商在改变工厂现场之前评估生产系统和机器人行为。奥迪使用基于Omniverse库构建的电池生产数字孪生，在物理设备到位前测试生产概念；还与达索系统和Agile Robots合作，在基于Omniverse的DELMIA虚拟孪生中模拟和验证移动人形机器人及物流流程。舍弗勒将人形执行器——即驱动机器人关节的部件——的数字孪生与NVIDIA Isaac仿真框架集成，帮助机器人合作伙伴在仿真中评估部件行为并减少物理测试。在大众萨克森透明工厂，Wandelbots使用基于Omniverse和OpenUSD的NOVA与Isaac Sim，数字化验证装配工作流并为物理机器人准备应用。KONGSBERG旗下Falkor将智能体和Omniverse库集成到其平台；借助由NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU驱动的Microsoft Azure NCv6虚拟机，具备空间智能的智能体结合工程数据、运营信息和3D设备几何，对工业设施进行观察、仿真和推理，支持流程与能源行业的巡检和维护。施耐德电气与AVEVA正为Nscale开发基于Omniverse库的AI工厂数字孪生，帮助工程师在物理变更前比较电力、冷却和设备配置。整体来看，这些案例表明工业AI正从单点仿真加速走向覆盖设计、制造、运维和机器人部署的智能体化与数字孪生体系，通过减少物理试验、缩短校准和设计迭代时间、降低运营成本，提升欧洲工业的效率和创新能力。

items.title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations
items.description: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.  Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. items.content: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs. Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. As designs become more complex, simulations take longer to run, increasing computing demands and limiting the number of ideas teams can test. NVIDIA cuDSS accelerates solving large sparse systems — the math-heavy step that repeats throughout engineering and scientific simulations and often limits how many designs a team can test — by tapping into GPUs. This lets applications reduce time to results and increase simulation throughput, enabling end users to explore larger more realistic models, more accurate representations and a wider design space at a reduced cost. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Industry leaders are already integrating NVIDIA cuDSS into their tools to transform workflows for their end customers: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability. COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours. Cadence: Uses cuDSS in its Celsius software to accelerate simulations of heat, structural stress and warpage in advanced chips and 3D chip designs, helping customers including Nokia analyze complex designs faster. Dassault Systèmes: Dassault Systèmes reports an 8-10x speedup using cuDSS within its Abaqus structural and computer simulation technology electromagnetic solvers for performance-critical simulations across industries. Siemens: Siemens uses cuDSS in Simcenter STAR-CCM+ to accelerate simulations of structures in fluid-structure interaction workflows. Synopsys: Synopsys uses cuDSS in its Sentaurus Device simulator tool to accelerate simulations of advanced logic, memory and power chips, helping Infineon model increasingly complex devices faster. Accelerated Simulation at Scale As simulation workloads grow in size and complexity, cuDSS can scale out of the box from individual workstations to large computing clusters. Developers can integrate cuDSS into existing engineering, scientific and optimization software offerings, bringing GPU acceleration to tools already used by engineers and researchers. They can use cuDSS through C, C++, Python and Fortran interfaces. Learn more about cuDSS by visiting the NVIDIA demo booth and Dassault Systèmes booth at GTC Berlin. items.titleZh: NVIDIA cuDSS 现已正式发布，加速工程与科学仿真
items.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 宣布其 CUDA-X 库 cuDSS 正式全面可用（general availability）。该库的核心目标是把工程与科学仿真中一个关键且计算密集的环节——大型稀疏系统求解——迁移到 GPU 上执行。复杂工程产品，从先进芯片、飞机到工业系统，在制造前都依赖仿真预测设计性能。随着设计复杂度提升，仿真运行时间变长、计算需求增加，团队能够验证和测试的设计想法数量受到限制。cuDSS 正是针对这一瓶颈：大型稀疏系统求解在工程和科学仿真中反复出现，通常是数学计算最繁重、也最容易限制设计探索规模的步骤。通过利用 GPU 加速该步骤，应用可以缩短获得结果的时间、提高仿真吞吐量，使最终用户能够以更低成本探索更大、更接近真实的模型，更准确的表示以及更宽的设计空间。

从技术定位看，cuDSS 是 NVIDIA CUDA-X 库的一部分，面向稀疏系统求解提供 GPU 加速能力。其创新点在于将仿真工作流中反复出现、传统上常由 CPU 承担且耗时较大的稀疏求解环节卸载到 GPU，并允许开发者将其集成到现有工程、科学和优化软件中。cuDSS 提供 C、C++、Python 和 Fortran 接口，便于不同技术栈的仿真软件接入。随着仿真负载规模和复杂度增长，cuDSS 还可开箱即用地从单台工作站扩展到大型计算集群，帮助现有工具在不完全重构工作流的情况下获得 GPU 加速。

产业落地方面，多家行业领导者已将 cuDSS 集成到其工具中。Applied Materials 在其基于物理、以缺陷为中心的仿真平台 Ginestra 中使用 cuDSS，将稀疏求解相比纯 CPU 方案加速最高 10 倍，加快半导体材料和器件可靠性探索。COMSOL 在 NVIDIA 加速计算上使用 COMSOL Multiphysics 与 cuDSS，ZEISS SMT 在一个 EUV 光刻等离子体仿真基准中测得 4 倍加速，完整仿真在 6 天 14 小时内完成。Cadence 在 Celsius 软件中使用 cuDSS，加速先进芯片和 3D 芯片设计中的热、结构应力和翘曲仿真，帮助包括 Nokia 在内的客户更快分析复杂设计。Dassault Systèmes 报告在其 Abaqus 结构求解器和 CST 电磁求解器中使用 cuDSS，在跨行业性能关键仿真中实现 8—10 倍加速。Siemens 在 Simcenter STAR-CCM+ 中使用 cuDSS，加速流体—结构相互作用工作流中的结构仿真。Synopsys 在 Sentaurus Device 仿真器中使用 cuDSS，加速先进逻辑、存储和功率芯片仿真，帮助 Infineon 更快地对日益复杂的器件建模。

总体而言，cuDSS 通过 GPU 加速大型稀疏系统求解，把仿真中重复且耗时的数学核心步骤转化为更高吞吐的计算流程，可能显著缩短工程仿真周期并扩大可探索设计空间。其应用场景覆盖半导体材料与器件可靠性、EUV 光刻等离子体仿真、芯片热/应力/翘曲分析、结构仿真、电磁仿真、流体—结构相互作用以及先进逻辑、存储和功率器件建模等。开发者可通过 C、C++、Python 和 Fortran 接口将 cuDSS 集成进现有工程、科学和优化软件，并从工作站扩展到大型集群。NVIDIA 还提示可在 GTC Berlin 的 NVIDIA 演示展台和 Dassault Systèmes 展台进一步了解 cuDSS。

items.title: HPE says it will run the first supercomputer benchmarks on the Moon
items.description: HPE’s Spaceborne Computer-4 will ride Astrolab’s FLIP rover to the Moon’s south pole to run HPL, HPCG, and AI tests.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A fanless compute module will head to the Moon for supercomputer benchmarking, AI testing, and additional experimentation by NASA and Deloitte, as detailed in a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) release. The company’s Spaceborne Computer-4 will run what HPE calls “the first high performance computing (HPC) benchmarks on the surface of the Moon,” riding on an Astrolab FLIP rover to the lunar south pole. The launch is slated for late 2026 under NASA’s Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative for a Moon Base program mission, in conjunction with a Voyager Technologies Griffin-1 lander.Named benchmarks include High Performance Conjugate Gradients (HPCG), a supercomputing metric that complements High Performance LINPACK (HPL). AI testing will involve large language model (LLM) retrieval-augmented generation, vision inference, LiDAR processing, and an AI services container for AI app deployment. The LLMs “will deliver insights, analyze visual data, and support autonomous monitoring,” while the LiDAR processing involves mapping, navigation, terrain analysis, and infrastructure development.Scott Wiest, HPE’s vice president, fellow and global sales chief technologist, said, “The next chapter of lunar exploration will depend on the ability to turn data into insights at the point of discovery.” HPE says “no other company or organization” has conducted such benchmarks on the Moon, with a presumption that no other parties’ planned HPC missions will get there first. HPE also assembled a software suite that handles the link to Earth-side systems and the secure delivery of results.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: HPE’s “lightweight, self-contained, and fanless” advanced compute module is “built for space environments,” bringing AI and HPC “to the lunar edge,” as Wiest put it, or the “far-edge,” as HPE calls it. The computer blade is about 10 inches long and about 4 inches wide, about the size of a typical graphics card, and is made from two component cards, as HPE senior director Norm Follett explained on the company’s Technology Now podcast last year.It includes 1TB of Kioxia storage, a low-power CPU, and a small GPU. The chassis is designed to shed heat into a rover plate, and the overall design is made for the Moon rather than being an off-the-shelf solution like International Space Station (ISS) units. Currently, HPE’s description of the unit lacks hard details on performance targets, power budgets, or chip vendors, but the eventual benchmark results will yield some information. You may like Google's orbital AI data center test packs four TPUs and 1,000W of solar power China launches 'Supercomputing-1' AI satellite as orbital data centers gather momentum AMD attempts to get ahead of expected RTX Spark launch with Gorgon Halo benchmarks The original Spaceborne Computer launched in August 2017 on SpaceX’s CRS-12 to the ISS. It also ran HPL with HPCG, surpassing one teraflop, according to HPE. It was rack-installed and water-cooled; the fanless Computer-4 is quite miniaturized in comparison to the 124-pound original Spaceborne Computer. Spaceborne Computer-2, also on the ISS, is made of HPE Edgeline and ProLiant systems with Kioxia SSDs. (Image credit: NASA)NASA will use the opportunity to run its Federated Learning for Unbounded and Intelligent Decentralization (FLUID) AI neural network, trained on data from the Earth, the Moon, and the ISS, coordinating three distinct models. The agency will also test a tuned LLM for semantic processing for handling onboard documents. Deloitte, for its part, will test its Silent Shield, “a new system to detect cyber intrusions” with near-real-time predictive analytics. Testing ideally occurs onboard, as the link to Earth is slow with low levels of bandwidth, Follett explained.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe launch is planned for the fourth quarter of 2026, using a SpaceX Falcon Heavy launch vehicle, SpacePolicyOnline reports. It will take several days for the lander to reach the Moon and its surface. The FLIP rover is designed to operate for one lunar day, or about 14 Earth days, before attempting to survive the night via hibernation, Follett said, making for a relatively tight benchmarking window.
