items.titleZh: HPE称将在月球上运行首个超级计算机基准测试
items.descriptionZh:
HPE宣布，其Spaceborne Computer-4（太空计算机4号）将随Astrolab的FLIP漫游车前往月球南极，在月面开展高性能计算（HPC）基准测试、AI实验及其他科学试验。该任务计划于2026年底发射，属于NASA商业月球有效载荷服务（CLPS）计划下的Moon Base项目任务，并与Voyager Technologies的Griffin-1着陆器配合。HPE称，这将是“首次在月球表面运行HPC基准测试”，并表示尚无其他公司或组织在月球上开展此类测试，同时推测其他计划中的HPC任务不会更早抵达。

此次测试的核心包括HPCG（High Performance Conjugate Gradients）基准。HPCG是与HPL（High Performance LINPACK）互补的超级计算指标，用于更全面地评估系统性能。AI测试则涵盖大语言模型检索增强生成（RAG）、视觉推理、LiDAR处理，以及用于部署AI应用的AI服务容器。按照HPE的说法，大语言模型将用于提供洞察、分析视觉数据并支持自主监测；LiDAR处理则服务于测绘、导航、地形分析和基础设施建设。HPE还配套了一套软件套件，用于管理与地球侧系统的连接并安全交付测试结果。

硬件方面，Spaceborne Computer-4是一个“轻量、自包含、无风扇”的高级计算模块，专为太空环境设计，目标是把AI和HPC能力带到“月球边缘”或HPE所称的“远边缘”。该计算刀片长约10英寸、宽约4英寸，大小接近典型显卡，由两块组件卡构成。HPE高管此前透露，模块包含1TB Kioxia存储、低功耗CPU和小型GPU；机箱设计可将热量传导至漫游车安装板。与基于国际空间站（ISS）现成方案不同，该模块是针对月球环境专门设计的。目前HPE尚未披露性能目标、功耗预算和芯片供应商等硬性细节，但实际基准结果将提供相关信息。

从历史对比看，HPE首代Spaceborne Computer于2017年8月由SpaceX CRS-12送往ISS，采用机架安装和水冷设计，重达124磅，曾运行HPL和HPCG并突破1 teraflop。相比之下，无风扇的Spaceborne Computer-4在体积和形态上大幅小型化。第二代Spaceborne Computer-2同样部署在ISS，由HPE Edgeline和ProLiant系统及Kioxia SSD构成。

NASA将利用此次机会运行其FLUID（Federated Learning for Unbounded and Intelligent Decentralization）AI神经网络。该网络使用来自地球、月球和ISS的数据训练，并协调三个不同模型；NASA还将测试一个经过调优的大语言模型，用于处理机载文档的语义任务。Deloitte则将测试其Silent Shield系统，这是一种通过近实时预测分析检测网络入侵的新系统。HPE指出，由于地月通信链路速度慢、带宽低，理想情况下测试应在月球本地完成。

发射计划定于2026年第四季度，使用SpaceX Falcon Heavy火箭。着陆器需数天抵达月球表面。FLIP漫游车设计运行一个月球日，约相当于14个地球日，之后将尝试通过休眠模式度过月夜，因此基准测试窗口相对紧张。总体来看，该项目旨在验证月面边缘环境中的HPC与AI计算能力，为未来月球基地、自主探测和深空任务中“在发现点将数据转化为洞察”的能力奠定基础。

items.title: NVIDIA Open Models Advance Europe’s Sovereign Intelligence Across Industries
items.description: NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries The portfolio includes the new NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt models; new NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models for embedding, reranking […]
items.content: NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries The portfolio includes the new NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt models; new NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models for embedding, reranking and document parsing; the new NVIDIA Kumo family open weight foundation models and libraries for structured business data; NVIDIA Cosmos 3.5 world models; NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge for autonomous vehicles; NVIDIA BioNeMo for healthcare and scientific discovery; and NVIDIA Ising for quantum computing. The open models give organizations a foundation they can customize with local data and deploy on infrastructure they control. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA Nemotron Powers Post-Training Across Industries NVIDIA Nemotron brings open language models, datasets and recipes to developers building agents. The models support text and images, helping agents orchestrate workflows, reason through complex problems and complete specialized tasks at a lower cost. Nemotron models are built with data, research and expertise from the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition, including European partners Black Forest Labs, H-Company and Mistral. Nemotron provides a foundation for enterprises to build applications based on their own knowledge and expertise. Dassault Systèmes, Domyn, Dream, Palantir’s customers, Salesforce, SAP, Shopify, Synopsys and WPP, as well as professional services providers like Accenture and EY, are working with Nemotron models and datasets to create custom models and build domain-specific agents. A broad ecosystem of post-training partners, including AfterQuery, AgileRL, AI21, Alice, Applied Compute, Baseten, CoreWeave, Distil Labs, EON, Fastino, Fireworks, Google Cloud, Mercor, Multiverse Computing, Nebius, Handshake AI, Plurai, Prime Intellect, River.AI, Scale AI, Trajectory and TNG, is helping enterprises customize Nemotron for domain-specific workloads. NVIDIA Kumo Speeds Agents’ Work With Structured Enterprise Data NVIDIA Kumo open foundation models, libraries and tools help agents and applications forecast outcomes, score fraud risk and recommend actions from structured business data. Part of NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation, Kumo shortens time to prediction and reduces the cost and complexity of building a separate machine learning pipeline for every task. Developers can use pretrained Kumo models to bring predictions to more applications quickly, then fine-tune them using proprietary data when higher performance is critical. The portfolio includes NVIDIA Kumo Structured, with models for relational and tabular prediction, forecasting and anomaly detection, and NVIDIA Kumo Engine, an open library stack for developing and deploying structured data foundation models. Cognite, Coinbase, Databricks, DoorDash, Revolut and Tubi are among the first to work with Kumo models to accelerate development. Snowflake customers are already using Kumo models to accelerate AI development in industries including advertising, energy, financial services and retail. NVIDIA Cosmos Accelerates Robotics Training and Simulation NVIDIA Cosmos is a family of open world foundation models that helps developers build robots, autonomous vehicles and vision agents that understand and interact with the physical world. NVIDIA is introducing new Cosmos post-training and optimization tools to help developers improve world models using less compute, along with simulation checkpoints for evaluating behavior in interactive driving and robotic manipulation scenarios before real-world testing. NVIDIA is also introducing Cosmos Data Factory — comprising blueprints and core agent skills — to help developers curate, label, generate and evaluate training data for driving scenarios, product defects, image augmentation and event generation. Developers can use complete workflows or individual capabilities with agents coordinating the process. Porsche with Voxel51, ANYbotics with Encord, Zalando and CEVA Logistics with Sereact, and Siemens are using Cosmos Data Factory to create high-quality, diverse training datasets and improve model precision. NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Brings Real-Time Reasoning to Autonomous Vehicles NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge is a compact reasoning model that brings real-time scene understanding and motion planning directly into autonomous vehicles. Built on NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge’s Nemotron-based foundation and optimized for the NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor platform, it helps developers bring advanced driving capabilities into vehicles with lower computing requirements. NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina Advances Protein Design NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina is an open protein design model from NVIDIA and the Baker Lab at the University of Washington’s Institute for Protein Design. The model generates protein sequences and 3D structures to help researchers design proteins that bind to difficult targets, assemble into complex structures and bind to small molecules. NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina delivers leading performance across more than 10 protein design tasks and generates designs about 13x faster than RFdiffusion3 in a benchmark of 200 amino acid proteins. Researchers can use the model through agents to generate and evaluate candidates against design goals and molecular constraints, then choose which designs to test in the lab. NVIDIA Ising Accelerates Quantum Development The NVIDIA Ising family of open models provides a common, extensible foundation to speed the breakthroughs needed to develop useful quantum supercomputers, from real-time hardware calibration to error correction, across different qubit modalities and tailored to individual hardware needs. IQM Quantum Computers is using Ising to calibrate its quantum processors, showcasing how specialized open calibration models outperform large general-purpose models. SEEQC is combining the NVIDIA NVQLink platform and Ising with its unique Digital Link to meet the low-latency requirements needed for real-time quantum error correction. AWS is making NVIDIA Ising readily available to researchers by integrating the model family into AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS). While decoding is typically performed on classical hardware colocated with the quantum processor due to latency requirements, the AWS PCS integration lets researchers build on Ising prior to deployment. Availability NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is available on Hugging Face, ModelScope, OpenRouter and build.nvidia.com as an NVIDIA NIM microservice, as well as through NVIDIA cloud, post-training and inference partners. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is expected to be available on Friday, Oct. 23. NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever open models are available on Hugging Face, various partner platforms, and as an NVIDIA NIM microservice on build.nvidia.com. NVIDIA Kumo open models are available on Hugging Face and optimized and packaged as an NVIDIA NIM microservice for production inference on build.nvidia.com. NVIDIA Cosmos is now openly available on Hugging Face and GitHub, and through select inference partners. NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge will be available for download on GitHub and Hugging Face later this month. The NVIDIA BioNeMo open model RFD4-Proteina is available on build.nvidia.com and as an NVIDIA NIM microservice, as well as on GitHub, Hugging Face and through select inference partners. NVIDIA Ising is available on GitHub, Hugging Face and build.nvidia.com. See notice regarding software product information. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

items.titleZh: NVIDIA 开放模型推动欧洲各行业主权智能发展
items.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 正在扩展其开放模型家族，覆盖语言、机器人、生物科学和量子计算等领域，目标是让开发者、研究人员和企业能够利用本地语言和行业数据定制应用，并部署在自身可控的基础设施上。此次发布包括新一代 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 和 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 模型，面向嵌入、重排序和文档解析的 Nemotron Retriever 模型，面向结构化商业数据的 Kumo 开放权重基础模型与库，Cosmos 3.5 世界模型，面向自动驾驶的 Alpamayo 2 Edge，面向医疗健康和科学发现的 BioNeMo，以及面向量子计算的 Ising。整体思路是提供可定制、可自主部署的开放基础模型，降低企业和研究机构构建行业专用 AI 应用的门槛。

在语言模型方面，NVIDIA Nemotron 提供开放语言模型、数据集和训练配方，主要服务正在构建智能体的开发者。模型支持文本和图像输入，可帮助智能体编排工作流、进行复杂问题推理，并以更低成本完成专门任务。Nemotron 模型整合了 NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition 的数据、研究和专业知识，欧洲合作伙伴包括 Black Forest Labs、H-Company 和 Mistral。企业可以基于自身知识和专业能力，在 Nemotron 基础上构建定制应用。Dassault Systèmes、Domyn、Dream、Palantir 的客户、Salesforce、SAP、Shopify、Synopsys、WPP，以及 Accenture、EY 等专业服务提供商，正在利用 Nemotron 模型和数据集创建定制模型和领域智能体。AfterQuery、AgileRL、AI21、Alice、Applied Compute、Baseten、CoreWeave、Distil Labs、EON、Fastino、Fireworks、Google Cloud、Mercor、Multiverse Computing、Nebius、Handshake AI、Plurai、Prime Intellect、River.AI、Scale AI、Trajectory、TNG 等后训练合作伙伴生态，则帮助企业针对特定工作负载定制 Nemotron。

Kumo 系列则聚焦结构化企业数据。NVIDIA Kumo 开放基础模型、库和工具可帮助智能体和应用基于结构化商业数据进行结果预测、欺诈风险评分和行动推荐。作为 NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation 的一部分，Kumo 的核心创新在于缩短获得预测结果的时间，并降低为每个任务单独构建机器学习流水线所带来的成本和复杂性。开发者可先用预训练 Kumo 模型快速把预测能力引入更多应用，再在性能要求更高时使用专有数据微调。该产品组合包括 NVIDIA Kumo Structured，提供关系型和表格数据预测、时间序列预测及异常检测模型；以及 NVIDIA Kumo Engine，一个用于开发和部署结构化数据基础模型的开放库栈。Cognite、Coinbase、Databricks、DoorDash、Revolut 和 Tubi 是首批使用 Kumo 模型加速开发的企业之一，Snowflake 客户也已在广告、能源、金融服务和零售等行业使用 Kumo 模型加速 AI 开发。

在机器人和物理世界 AI 方面，NVIDIA Cosmos 是一组开放世界基础模型，帮助开发者构建能够理解和交互物理世界的机器人、自动驾驶车辆和视觉智能体。NVIDIA 推出新的 Cosmos 后训练与优化工具，使开发者能够用更少算力改进世界模型，并提供仿真检查点，用于在真实世界测试前评估交互式驾驶和机器人操作场景中的行为。Cosmos Data Factory 由蓝图和核心智能体技能组成，帮助开发者整理、标注、生成和评估训练数据，覆盖驾驶场景、产品缺陷、图像增强和事件生成等任务。开发者既可以使用完整工作流，也可以调用单项能力，由智能体协调流程。Porsche 与 Voxel51、ANYbotics 与 Encord、Zalando 和 CEVA Logistics 与 Sereact，以及 Siemens 正在使用 Cosmos Data Factory 创建高质量、多样化的训练数据集并提升模型精度。

面向自动驾驶，NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge 是一个紧凑型推理模型，将实时场景理解和运动规划直接带入自动驾驶车辆。它基于 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge 的 Nemotron 基础构建，并针对 NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor 平台优化，帮助开发者在较低算力需求下把高级驾驶能力引入车辆。

在生物科学领域，NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina 是 NVIDIA 与华盛顿大学蛋白设计研究所 Baker Lab 合作推出的开放蛋白质设计模型。该模型可生成蛋白质序列和三维结构，帮助研究人员设计与困难靶点结合的蛋白质、组装成复杂结构以及结合小分子。NVIDIA 表示，该模型在 10 多项蛋白质设计任务中表现领先，并在 200 个氨基酸蛋白质基准测试中，设计生成速度比 RFdiffusion3 快约 13 倍。研究人员可通过智能体使用该模型，根据设计目标和分子约束生成并评估候选方案，再选择哪些设计进入实验室测试。

在量子计算方面，NVIDIA Ising 是一组开放模型，提供通用、可扩展的基础，以加速开发实用量子超级计算机所需的突破，覆盖从实时硬件校准到量子纠错的环节，并可跨不同量子比特模态、针对具体硬件需求进行适配。IQM Quantum Computers 正在使用 Ising 校准其量子处理器，展示专用开放校准模型可优于大型通用模型。SEEQC 将 NVIDIA NVQLink 平台与 Ising 及其 Digital Link 结合，以满足实时量子纠错所需的低延迟要求。AWS 则将 Ising 集成到 AWS Parallel Computing Service（AWS PCS）中，使研究人员更容易使用该模型家族。由于延迟要求，量子解码通常在与量子处理器同址的经典硬件上执行，而 AWS PCS 集成可让研究人员在部署前基于 Ising 开展构建。

可用性方面，NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 已在 Hugging Face、ModelScope、OpenRouter 和 build.nvidia.com 上以 NVIDIA NIM 微服务形式提供，也可通过 NVIDIA 云、后训练和推理合作伙伴获取；Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 预计于 10 月 23 日周五推出。Nemotron Retriever 开放模型已在 Hugging Face、多个合作伙伴平台以及 build.nvidia.com 的 NIM 微服务上提供。Kumo 开放模型已在 Hugging Face 提供，并经过优化和打包为 NVIDIA NIM 微服务，用于 build.nvidia.com 上的生产推理。Cosmos 现已在 Hugging Face 和 GitHub 以及部分推理合作伙伴处开放。Alpamayo 2 Edge 将于本月晚些时候在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 提供下载。BioNeMo 开放模型 RFD4-Proteina 已在 build.nvidia.com 以 NIM 微服务形式提供，同时也可在 GitHub、Hugging Face 和部分推理合作伙伴处获取。Ising 已在 GitHub、Hugging Face 和 build.nvidia.com 提供。

items.title: Four workers killed after fall at TSMC’s 2nm fab construction site
items.description: Four contract workers died after a fall at TSMC’s Fab 22 construction site in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Recent updates Update - October 21, 11:20 am ET: In an update, local media reports that all four TSMC workers involved in an accident at its 2nm Fab 22 site in Kaohsiung have died. Reports indicate the accident was caused by a broken connecting plate bolt. TSMC has suspended all steel structure work at the site and all of its new plants in Taiwan while it investigates the cause of the accident. The rest of the story remains below as first published. Three contract workers died, and one more is in intensive care after an accident at the construction site for TSMC’s 2nm Fab 22 in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, reports Taiwan’s Central News Agency. The Southern Taiwan Science Park (STSP) Bureau suspects the cause was a broken bolt on a steel connection plate that sent the workers and steel components tumbling. Steel hoisting on the project has been halted, and the STSP has sent labor inspectors to investigate. The accident is not the first of its kind but rather follows at least a half dozen others since September 2024 at TSMC construction sites in Taiwan, according to local reports. Each of those earlier accidents killed one worker.Local police said that the men were welding a steel beam on an upper floor and fell with it, while the STSP said the workers were performing steel-structure hoisting and installation when a third-floor connection-plate bolt apparently broke.10 emergency vehicles were sent to the site with 22 personnel, and all four men involved in the incident were taken to the hospital. On-site medical staff gave first aid, but three of the workers died despite resuscitation efforts, and the fourth was moved to intensive care. The workers were employed by a contractor working on the fourth phase of the complex’s construction, and TSMC said the area was within that contractor’s scope of work.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: According to the report, TSMC stopped the related construction work on its own and is working with authorities and supervising the subcontractor’s follow-up.Go deeper with TH Premium: Chipmaking (Image credit: tsmc)Analyzing TSMC's fab expansion roadmap — multi-fab N2 ramp, CoWoS, SoIC, and uncorking bottlenecksLeading-edge foundry roadmaps for TSMC, Intel, and SamsungASML's roadmap for chipmaking lithography tools examinedChinese chipmaking tool roadmaps examinedThe Fab 22 complex, located in Kaohsiung’s Nanzi District, is part of the science park and is being built to accelerate 2nm manufacturing. TSMC entered high-volume 2nm, or N2, manufacturing in the fourth quarter of 2025, including at Fab 22. The complex has five phases planned, with a total investment TSMC puts at more than NT$1.5 trillion, or about $46 billion. The accident happened on the construction side, not in a producing fab. Kaohsiung’s deputy mayor said construction on Phase 4 began in August 2025, with operations expected in the fourth quarter of 2027. You may like Two killed, one seriously hurt in explosion at Intel’s chip plant in Israel Samsung's fab roadmaps examined TSMC fab equipment demand nearly doubles in six months Business Today reports that TSMC fab construction has increased, from four fabs a year in 2017–2024 to nine a year in 2025 and 2026. The deaths come as the company plans for 13 new leading-edge and advanced-packaging fabs in Taiwan, with company-wide capex of $60 billion to $64 billion this year.The faster pace has encouraged the addition of a contractor’s safety record as a weight in selection and a plan for a Taiwan Semiconductor Construction Engineering Safety Association with construction partners. TSMC Chairman C.C. Wei said at last year’s shareholders meeting that safety cannot be compromised, and the company’s 2025 annual report said it will keep investing in fabs across several locations in Taiwan “with a strong emphasis on construction site safety.”Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsCliff Hou, TSMC senior vice president and deputy co-COO, told Business Today that increased worker count and overlapping construction have raised the risk, requiring careful supervision, and that TSMC’s contractor lost-time injury rate had fallen about 42% from last year’s high as of late May, when the publication toured the Nanzi site to see the overhaul. It’s too early to call the program a failure, with the cause as yet unknown.The accident comes less than a week after an explosion killed two people at Intel’s chip plant in Israel, though that was an operating fab rather than a construction site. Both accidents come as chipmakers race to meet demand, with global chip sales passing $1 trillion through August, according to the Semiconductor Industry Association.The STSP’s findings will determine what penalties, if any, will fall under Taiwan’s Occupational Safety and Health Act, while it assists the victims’ families. No date has been given at this time for that or for the Phase 4 steel hoisting restart. Nor has TSMC commented on any schedule impact. items.titleZh: 台积电2纳米晶圆厂施工现场发生坠落事故，四名工人死亡
items.descriptionZh:
台积电高雄楠梓Fab 22（2nm）第四期工地发生重大施工事故。最初报道称，三名承包商工人死亡、一人重伤送入重症监护；10月21日更新显示，四名送医工人均已不治。当地警方称，工人在上层焊接钢梁时随钢梁坠落；南部科学园区管理局初步怀疑，三楼钢连接板螺栓断裂导致工人和钢构件坠落。10辆急救车、22名人员到场，四人送医，现场急救后三人死亡，第四人转ICU，后更新为死亡。项目钢构吊装已暂停，劳动检查人员介入调查。台积电自主停止相关工程，配合当局并监督分包商后续整改；更新称公司已暂停该厂区所有钢结构施工，以及台湾所有新厂的钢结构工作，以调查事故原因。

背景方面，Fab 22位于高雄楠梓区，是南部科学园区的一部分，规划五期，总投资超过1.5万亿新台币，约合460亿美元，目标是加速2nm制造。按原文，台积电在2025年第四季度进入N2高量产阶段，包括Fab 22；第四期于2025年8月动工，预计2027年第四季度营运。此次事故发生在施工区域，而非正在生产的晶圆厂，因此不直接涉及N2制程运行；但Fab 22扩产关系台积电下一代领先逻辑制程产能爬坡，面向高性能计算、AI、手机等先进芯片需求。原文未披露N2具体晶体管或性能参数，核心信息是产能建设与施工安全管理。

安全与扩产对比上，自2024年9月以来，台积电台湾工地至少发生六起类似事故，每起造成一名工人死亡，本次更为严重。台积电建厂速度已从2017—2024年的每年4座，提升到2025—2026年的每年9座；公司计划在台湾新建13座领先制程和先进封装厂，全年资本开支为600亿至640亿美元。台积电称已将承包商安全纪录纳入遴选权重，并计划与建设伙伴筹组台湾半导体营造工程安全协会；董事长魏哲家此前表示安全不能妥协，2025年年报也强调工地安全。资深副总侯永清表示，工人数量增加和重叠施工提高了风险，需要严格监督；截至5月底，承包商损失工时工伤率较去年高点下降约42%。

行业影响方面，此次事故距英特尔以色列芯片厂爆炸致两人死亡不到一周，但后者发生在运营中的工厂，而非施工工地。两起事故都发生在芯片厂商竞相扩产、满足需求的背景下；美国半导体行业协会数据显示，截至今年8月全球芯片销售额已超过1万亿美元。南部科学园区管理局的调查将决定是否依据台湾职业安全卫生法处罚，并协助遇难者家属；第四期钢结构吊装重启时间以及是否影响工期尚无日期，台积电也未评论进度影响。整体看，事故不改变2nm技术路线，但凸显先进制程扩产竞赛下工地安全与监管压力，可能促使台积电及供应链进一步加强施工安全管理和工期安排。

items.title: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote

items.content: Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake, Huang explained. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory, which generates tokens and digital intelligence from the models that run on it, which are then integrated into every application. “Long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist,” he said, highlighting how, similarly, the internet first needed networking, and electricity first required the grid. “To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI,” Huang said. “We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.” The AI Factory Gets a New Form Factor Huang framed NVIDIA’s full-stack AI factory — spanning hardware, system software, CUDA-X libraries and models — as a broad platform for building and operating AI infrastructure. “This now represents the breadth of technology necessary to create the AI factory,” Huang said. “This is what NVIDIA builds today, and this is the foundation by which we can enable Europe to be part of the AI ecosystem, the AI economy.” He said Vera Rubin, in full production, extends NVIDIA’s computing platform beyond models and large language models to process the entire AI agent. He also showed several of NVIDIA’s latest rack-scale hardware offerings. Next, Huang announced NVIDIA DSX POD, a reference design for complete NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI factories built by partners inside modular containers, integrated and validated before delivery. With DSX POD, onsite deployment can shrink from six months to just 14 days once site utilities are ready. “This is a complete transformation of the world supply chain,” Huang said. “This will change the way that people install and build data centers, and hopefully, as a result, velocity goes up.” The NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform enables companies to reduce water consumption for cooling by up to 100% and generate the same AI output with up to 30% less power. Agents Are the New Computing Platform — and Safety Is an Engineering Problem Huang said agents think, reason, iterate and use tools, driving token consumption as they become more useful. He described an agent as comprising five elements: a model, a harness that orchestrates its work and memory, a sandbox that isolates the harness, knowledge and tools. In that framing, an agent is more than a model answering questions; it can draw on knowledge and act through tools. “The most important thing is to make sure the agent is secure,” Huang said. The autonomous agent can access files, resources, networks and tools, so its privileges should be minimal and it should be monitored. NVIDIA’s answer is the new NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents, a full-stack design built on NVIDIA OpenShell — an open source, policy-controlled runtime with kernel-level sandboxing that sits between an agent and the systems it can affect. That means privileges, policy enforcement and monitoring must adapt dynamically. “Every single time an agent is launched, the privileges are different,” Huang said. Open Models Turn Expertise Into an Advantage Huang presented NVIDIA’s open models as a starting point for building AI tailored to specific needs. NVIDIA’s frontier, open models are available for use across industries: Nemotron for language, Cosmos for world foundation models, GR00T for humanoid robotics, Alpamayo for autonomous vehicles, Ising for quantum-classical computing and Earth-2 for physics AI. “We are the frontier,” Huang said. “So in all of these different areas, we offer you all of the models, and we’re continuously working on it. We’ve been working on it for a decade, and we’ll continue to work on this forever.” NVIDIA provides the models, data and scripts to reproduce them, and companies can post-train a model on their own data for a particular use case — turning proprietary data into what he called “sovereign intelligence.” “You could start with an open model, something that’s incredibly good like Nemotron, and with your own data, post-train it for your use case and achieve, of course, super intelligence,” Huang said. “That is a very sensible thing to do, and all the technology exists today.” NVIDIA Gives Agents a Knowledge Layer Huang then introduced the NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation as a set of models and libraries for connecting agents to enterprise data, whether it’s unstructured information in documents or structured data in databases. He highlighted Nemotron tools for parsing documents, embedding queries and reranking relevant information, along with new NVIDIA Kumo models for making predictions from structured data. “Ultimately, what turns these super agents, these agents into super agents, is that you give them access to your company’s knowledge,” Huang said. NVIDIA CUDA-X — Accelerated Tools for Agents Huang then described NVIDIA CUDA-X as a collection of accelerated libraries used across science, engineering, research and creative work. NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform has more than 11 million developers building on it. Huang said those libraries can accelerate simulators, solvers and data-processing engines — the kinds of tools agents may draw on to do useful work. “CUDA-X tools are what gives agents the tools of the trade,” Huang said. Agents Go to Work in Labs, Factories and Engineering A video showcased NVIDIA Agent Toolkit bringing company knowledge, models and tools together in three industry examples: At Lila Sciences, agents help design a potential B-cell lymphoma therapy, using virtual experiments to guide work in an automated lab. At Siemens’ Erlangen factory, agents help prepare new products for production, testing plans in a digital twin before changes reach the factory floor. And at Dassault Systèmes, engineering agents adapt vehicle design, using simulation to identify a problem and refine the design. “And [all this] knowledge and tools belong to you,” Huang said after the video rolled. “That’s your expertise, and so all of this is now possible to do.” Telcos as Distributed AI Infrastructure Huang said AI is transforming telecommunications, improving spectrum efficiency and turning cell towers into distributed AI infrastructure. He cited 100,000 sites and about 100 gigawatts of distributed data centers, and said NVIDIA has made its first commercial phone call on T-Mobile’s network with Nokia after nearly eight years of work. “Now CUDA makes phone calls,” Huang said. “AI will revolutionize the way we do telecommunications. It will enhance our spectrum efficiency tremendously.” AI Moves Into the Treatment Room Healthcare and life sciences leaders are building on NVIDIA technologies to advance drug discovery and expand patient care. For example, NVIDIA and Siemens Healthineers are developing AI-enabled radiation therapy. Nemotron agents coordinate treatment planning, the Isaac for Healthcare platform and Omniverse libraries create a digital twin of the device and patient anatomy to simulate tumor targeting. Holoscan with IGX Thor connects live imaging and sensor data to enable real-time adaptive delivery as the patient moves. Huang described adaptive radiotherapy as a physical-AI application: as the patient’s body and tumor change during treatment, the system must track the changes and adjust the radiation targeting. “The tumor is changing in shape. The physical body is changing while you’re in therapy,” Huang said. “The robot, this radio adaptive radiotherapy system, has to perceive the changing environment, understand where the tumor is, segment it just perfectly and direct the radiotherapy accordingly.” The Road Ahead: Mobility Leaders Join NVIDIA’s Automotive Ecosystem Huang said the NVIDIA Hyperion computing platform is being designed into more vehicle fleets, with autonomous-driving software connecting robotaxis to ride-hailing services. Bolt with Lucid, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles and Einride are showcasing selected autonomous-mobility use cases on the NVIDIA Hyperion computing platform, demonstrating potential applications for level 3 and level 4 vehicles as well as future robotaxi fleets. In addition, Volvo Cars is adopting Hyperion and NVIDIA Alpamayo Stack software for safe automated driving. NVIDIA also introduced new AI and safety technologies to help developers build, validate and deploy autonomous vehicles at scale. Volkswagen’s van, JLR, Volvo and Mercedes-Benz’s next-generation vehicles will be Hyperion-compatible, Huang announced, saying, “Welcome to Hyperion.” A Reference Humanoid for Robotics Researchers Huang then announced Agile ONE SN, a reference humanoid built on Isaac GR00T — a 31-degree-of-freedom body, expected to be available next year, designed to cut researcher setup time from weeks to days. The platform is modular: researchers can use the full workflow or pull in selected components. “This is a great starting point,” Huang said. It builds on NVIDIA’s open physical AI stack — Isaac Capture for data collection, GR00T models for robot intelligence, Isaac Lab for simulation-based training, Isaac OS for runtime — and NVIDIA’s open physical AI dataset. Partners including Agility Robotics, Figure, KUKA and NEURA Robotics are already building on the same platform. Personal AI Gets a New Machine Huang closed by discussing RTX Spark laptops, which launched last week, bringing together RTX graphics and NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform in slim, premium Windows PCs for accelerated creation, immersive gaming and powerful local AI. He compared its 1 petaflop of performance and 128GB of memory with the DGX-1 he delivered to OpenAI in 2016 — then made the difference in size the punchline: “In the year 2016, I delivered 1 petaflop and 128GB … to a small company called OpenAI,” Huang said, holding up the compact machine in front of the audience. “This is 1 petaflop and 128GB. The only difference, of course, is that I can hold this like this, and DGX-1 took two people to carry upstairs.” Huang then showed a video of an agent helping train Hugging Face’s Microduck: it set up a course and simulated the robot in Isaac Sim, sent training jobs to the cloud, then brought the learned policy back to RTX Spark for evaluation before deploying it to the physical robot. A flock of four Microducks joined Huang onstage, sitting down, standing up and even taking a nap on cue. He explained that they were created on RTX Spark, trained in the cloud and learned their skills in simulation. “You were created on RTX Spark … [we] trained you in the cloud on a whole bunch of NVIDIA supercomputers, and you learned your skills right here on RTX Spark and the digital twin,” Huang told them. The Full Lineup With the Microducks gathered around him, Huang recapped the keynote: Europe is building its AI economy, AI factories are evolving to run agents and physical AI is the next frontier. “So that’s it,” Huang said. “Everybody can build agents. Every company in Europe will become an AI company … and we’re going to have a thriving AI economy here in Europe.” To close, Huang had one more surprise: a Eurovision-style musical send-off that turned the keynote’s themes into a comic recap. The lyrics raced from OpenShell’s guardrails — “No credentials. Access dismissed” and “Sentry on BlueField never clocks off” — to physical AI, where robot training was likened to “college for robots without student loans.” The punchline: “You can’t spell fungible without fun.” A saxophone solo led into a rousing “We are Europa” chorus. “Let’s work together to build Europe’s AI economy and put AI to work,” Huang said, closing out his talk. “Have a great GTC.” Explore NVIDIA GTC Berlin blogs and press releases in the online press kit. items.titleZh: GTC 柏林 2026：NVIDIA CEO 黄仁勋主题演讲实时更新
items.descriptionZh:
在柏林GTC主题演讲中，NVIDIA创始人兼CEO黄仁勋系统阐述了欧洲AI经济建设、AI工厂形态演进、智能体安全与开放模型、物理AI和机器人的最新布局。此次GTC Berlin为期三天，在STATION-Berlin举行，包含100多场关于智能体AI、机器人、物理AI、开放模型和加速计算的会议；主会场则汇聚记者、分析师和合作伙伴，聆听黄仁勋主题演讲。黄仁勋开场指出，欧莱雅、Revolut、Spotify、默克、沃达丰、Zara、保时捷、雀巢和汇丰等欧洲企业都在与NVIDIA合作推进AI。此前NVIDIA用一周时间走访巴黎、伦敦、斯德哥尔摩和都柏林，并宣布向欧洲技术生态投入近100亿美元，与超过1.2万家合作伙伴协作。他表示，计算机行业数十年发展后，世界正处在新一轮工业革命的起点。

黄仁勋用“五层蛋糕”解释AI：能源支撑先进计算机，先进计算机构成AI工厂，AI工厂运行模型并生成token和数字智能，这些智能再融入各类应用。他强调，AI模型出现之前基础设施必须先行，就像互联网需要网络、电力需要电网。要参与AI经济，不能只消费AI，还要生产AI；欧洲完全具备条件，而且已经开始。NVIDIA的全栈AI工厂覆盖硬件、系统软件、CUDA-X库和模型，是构建和运营AI基础设施的广泛平台。黄仁勋称，已全面量产的Vera Rubin把NVIDIA计算平台从模型和大语言模型扩展到处理完整AI智能体，并展示了多款最新机架级硬件。他发布NVIDIA DSX POD参考设计：合作伙伴在模块化容器中构建完整Vera Rubin AI工厂，交付前完成集成和验证，现场公用设施就绪后部署时间可从六个月缩短到14天。黄仁勋称这将改变数据中心安装建设方式并提升速度。NVIDIA DSX AI Factory平台还可将冷却水耗最多减少100%，并以最多降低30%的功耗生成同等AI输出。

在智能体方面，黄仁勋认为智能体会思考、推理、迭代和使用工具，随着能力增强将推高token消耗。他把智能体拆成五个要素：模型、负责编排工作和记忆的harness、隔离harness的沙箱、知识以及工具。因此智能体不只是回答问题的模型，还能调用知识并通过工具行动。他强调最重要的是保证智能体安全：自主智能体可访问文件、资源、网络和工具，权限应最小化并接受监控。NVIDIA推出面向安全AI智能体的OpenShell参考架构，基于开源、策略控制的OpenShell运行时，在内核级沙箱中位于智能体与其可影响系统之间，使权限、策略执行和监控可动态调整；每次启动智能体时权限都可能不同。

开放模型方面，黄仁勋把NVIDIA开放模型定位为构建定制AI的起点，覆盖多个领域：Nemotron用于语言，Cosmos用于世界基础模型，GR00T用于人形机器人，Alpamayo用于自动驾驶，Ising用于量子—经典计算，Earth-2用于物理AI。NVIDIA提供模型、数据和复现脚本，企业可用自有数据针对特定用例后训练，把专有数据转化为“主权智能”。他还发布NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation，用模型和库把智能体连接至企业数据，包括文档中的非结构化信息和数据库中的结构化数据；Nemotron工具负责文档解析、查询嵌入和相关信息重排序，新的Kumo模型用于从结构化数据做预测。黄仁勋称，让智能体成为“超级智能体”的关键，是让其访问企业知识。CUDA-X则是一组跨科学、工程、研究和创意工作的加速库，NVIDIA加速计算平台拥有超过1100万开发者；这些库可加速模拟器、求解器和数据处理引擎，为智能体提供“行业工具”。

行业应用上，NVIDIA Agent Toolkit把企业知识、模型和工具结合：在Lila Sciences，智能体帮助设计潜在B细胞淋巴瘤疗法，用虚拟实验指导自动化实验室工作；在西门子埃尔兰根工厂，智能体帮助新产品准备生产，先在数字孪生中测试计划再进入车间；在达索系统，工程智能体用仿真识别问题并改进车辆设计。电信领域，黄仁勋称AI正提高频谱效率，把基站变为分布式AI基础设施，涉及10万个站点和约100吉瓦分布式数据中心；NVIDIA与诺基亚在T-Mobile网络上完成首个商业电话，历时近八年，“现在CUDA可以打电话了”。医疗领域，NVIDIA与Siemens Healthineers开发AI放疗：Nemotron智能体协调治疗计划，Isaac for Healthcare平台和Omniverse库创建设备与患者解剖数字孪生以模拟肿瘤靶向，Holoscan与IGX Thor连接实时成像和传感器数据，在患者移动时实现实时自适应照射。黄仁勋称自适应放疗是物理AI应用，系统必须感知变化中的身体和肿瘤、理解肿瘤位置、精准分割并相应引导放疗。

汽车领域，NVIDIA Hyperion计算平台正进入更多车队，自动驾驶软件连接robotaxi与网约车服务。Bolt with Lucid、梅赛德斯-奔驰、大众商用车和Einride在Hyperion上展示部分自动驾驶出行用例，覆盖L3、L4车辆及未来robotaxi车队；沃尔沃汽车采用Hyperion和NVIDIA Alpamayo Stack软件实现安全自动驾驶。NVIDIA还推出新的AI与安全技术，帮助开发者大规模构建、验证和部署自动驾驶汽车；大众厢式车、JLR、沃尔沃和梅赛德斯-奔驰下一代车型将兼容Hyperion。机器人方面，黄仁勋发布基于Isaac GR00T的参考人形机器人Agile ONE SN，拥有31个自由度，预计明年上市，目标把研究人员搭建时间从数周缩短到数天；平台模块化，可用完整工作流或选用部分组件。它建立在NVIDIA开放物理AI栈之上，包括Isaac Capture数据采集、GR00T机器人智能模型、Isaac Lab仿真训练、Isaac OS运行时，以及开放物理AI数据集；Agility Robotics、Figure、KUKA和NEURA Robotics等伙伴已在同一平台开发。

个人AI方面，黄仁勋最后介绍上周发布的RTX Spark笔记本电脑，把RTX图形与NVIDIA全栈AI平台结合在轻薄高端Windows PC中，用于加速创作、沉浸式游戏和强大本地AI。其性能为1 petaflop、128GB内存，与2016年交付给OpenAI的DGX-1相同，但体积已小到可手持；DGX-1当年需要两人抬上楼。他还展示智能体帮助训练Hugging Face的Microduck：在Isaac Sim中搭建课程并仿真机器人，把训练任务发送到云端，再把学习到的策略带回RTX Spark评估并部署到实体机器人；四只Microduck上台按指令坐下、站起甚至小睡。黄仁勋总结称，欧洲正在建设自己的AI经济，AI工厂正演进为运行智能体的平台，物理AI是下一前沿；每家公司都能构建智能体，欧洲每家公司都将成为AI公司。演讲以欧歌赛风格音乐收尾，把OpenShell护栏、物理AI等主题编成幽默 recap，并呼吁共同建设欧洲AI经济、让AI投入工作。

history.content: Walmart will soon let AI agents shop on its website for you. Next month, the retail giant will allow you to connect your own AI agent to the site, with systems in place to let you approve and review purchases and set spending limits.The embrace of AI agents stands in stark contrast to Amazon, which blocked Perplexity’s shopping agent and Meta’s Muse AI assistant. But Walmart is opening its doors to AI shoppers — as long as they follow the retailer’s rules. It has outlined a set of terms for agents, saying that “agents must not take actions beyond what the shopper intends” and cannot change a customer’s payment method. Agents also can only access information needed to complete their task. Walmart says it will block agents that don’t follow these terms.Your AI agent will get its own profile within your Walmart account. Image: WalmartRelatedWebsites are closing their doors to AI agentsAgents will connect to new “Agent Profiles” within Walmart. By default, Walmart will require approval for all AI agent purchases, but you can also let it shop within a certain budget, such as up to $100. You’ll also be able to review your agent’s purchases separately from your own in Agent Profiles, as well as turn off the agent at any time.The retailer has built an “Agent Gateway” that connects AI agents through the Model Context Protocol, an open standard that allows AI agents to plug into different services on the web. Walmart says this not only enables AI agents to shop without running into hiccups that they might encounter when navigating a browser, but also prevents them from accessing your shopping history and personal information.“For example, if a customer tends to buy sourdough bread or a particular brand of milk, Walmart will help the agent find those usual items for the customer without sharing the customer’s broader shopping history with the agent,” Walmart says. The company will let users shop with AI agents on Sam’s Club as well.
history.author: Emma Roth
history.titleZh: 沃尔玛邀请AI智能体替你购物
history.descriptionZh:
沃尔玛计划于下个月向第三方AI购物代理开放其网站，允许用户将自己的人工智能代理接入沃尔玛账户，代为完成购物。这一举措与亚马逊形成鲜明对比：亚马逊此前阻止了Perplexity的购物代理和Meta的Muse AI助手，而沃尔玛选择在设定明确规则的前提下向AI代理开放。当前，不少网站正在收紧对AI代理的访问，沃尔玛则试图通过可控机制率先探索“代理式电商”。

在机制上，沃尔玛为AI代理设置了独立的“代理档案”（Agent Profiles），与用户本人的购物行为分开管理。默认情况下，AI代理的所有购买都需要用户批准；用户也可以为代理设置预算上限，例如最高100美元，并单独审查代理完成的订单，还可随时关闭代理功能。沃尔玛还规定，代理不得执行超出购物者意图的操作，不得更改客户的支付方式，只能访问完成任务所需的信息；违反规则的代理将被平台阻止。

技术层面，沃尔玛构建了“代理网关”（Agent Gateway），通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）连接AI代理。MCP是一种开放标准，可让AI代理接入网络上的不同服务。沃尔玛表示，这一方式不仅能减少AI代理在浏览器中操作时可能遇到的障碍，还能防止代理访问用户的购物历史和个人信息。例如，如果客户经常购买酸面包或某个特定品牌的牛奶，沃尔玛可以帮助代理找到这些常购商品，但不会向代理分享客户更广泛的购物历史。

从影响和应用场景看，沃尔玛的方案试图在自动化便利、用户控制和隐私保护之间取得平衡。AI代理可代表用户完成重复性、常规性采购，同时通过审批、预算和权限隔离降低误购和隐私泄露风险。该服务也将扩展至沃尔玛旗下的Sam’s Club。整体来看，沃尔玛没有像部分平台那样简单封堵AI代理，而是尝试建立一套可审核、可限制、可追溯的代理接入规则，为AI代理参与电商购物提供了一种受控落地路径。

history.content: After introducing its Gemini AI assistant to Android Auto last year, Google is now bringing it to Apple CarPlay users. The conversational Gemini in navigation is available today for US drivers, with “rollout happening globally too,” according to Google (we’ve asked for specific regional availability details).It’s taken almost 12 months for Google to bring this to CarPlay users, but now they can talk to the voice assistant in Google Maps to get some hands-free help while driving. That includes asking it multi-step questions, such as recommendations on places to visit and then prompting it to direct you there while avoiding toll roads. Users can activate the feature by tapping the Gemini icon in Google Maps on their Car’s infotainment display.Google describes this CarPlay support update as a conversational way to report traffic disruptions and find information about stops and places on-the-go. There’s no mention of any of the Personal Intelligence features that were announced yesterday for Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in, however, which enable the voice assistant to access user information from Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search. We’ve asked Google if CarPlay users will also receive the personalization update and will update if we hear back.
history.author: Jess Weatherbed
history.titleZh: 对话式 Gemini 导航登陆 Apple CarPlay
history.descriptionZh:
Google 去年已把 Gemini AI 助手引入 Android Auto，如今又将这一能力扩展到 Apple CarPlay 用户。根据 Google 的说法，面向导航场景的对话式 Gemini 已于当天面向美国司机开放，并且“全球推广也在进行中”；不过，Google 尚未公布具体的区域可用性细节，相关询问仍在等待回复。这意味着 CarPlay 用户经过近 12 个月等待后，终于可以在 Google Maps 中通过语音与助手交互，在驾驶过程中获得免手操作帮助。

从功能看，用户可在车载信息娱乐显示屏的 Google Maps 中点击 Gemini 图标激活该助手，并以自然语言提出多步骤问题。例如，先询问目的地推荐，再要求助手把用户导航到该地点并避开收费道路。Google 将此次 CarPlay 支持更新描述为一种“对话式”方式，用于报告交通中断、查找途中停靠点和地点信息。其核心创新在于把对话式 AI 与地图导航任务串联起来，使驾驶场景下的信息查询和路线操作更连贯，减少手动操作。

原文没有给出量化性能参数或直接对比数据，因此无法评估响应速度、识别准确率等指标。可确认的对比信息主要是平台与功能范围：该功能先落地 Android Auto，近 12 个月后才进入 CarPlay；美国市场先行，全球推广正在进行但区域细节未明。同时，Google 此次未提及前一天为 Android Auto 以及内置 Google 的汽车 announced 的 Personal Intelligence 功能。该功能允许语音助手访问用户在 Gmail、Calendar、Maps、Photos、YouTube 和 Search 等 Google 应用中的个人信息，从而实现个性化服务。CarPlay 用户是否会同步获得这一个性化更新尚不确定，Google 表示收到回复后会更新。

应用场景上，该功能主要面向驾驶中的免手交互，包括途中寻找停靠点、获取地点信息、报告路况异常、规划避开收费道路的路线等。对 CarPlay 用户而言，这提升了 Google Maps 在车载场景中的语音助手能力；但当前版本更偏向导航与地点信息对话，尚未确认具备 Android Auto 和内置 Google 汽车上宣布的跨应用个人化能力。

history.title: Trump announces mandate forcing AI data centers to pay energy dividends to the local community
history.description: Trump's latest post on Truth Social announces his plans to make data centers more popular among local communities.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter President Donald Trump has issued a call for data center builders and AI hyperscalers to pay communities a dividend in order to overcome energy-related price hikes, or even to reduce prices, in order to make data centers more palatable to local communities. In a post on Truth Social post, he warned that data centers would be mandated not only to make their own electricity, as he has previously stated, but also to give or sell excess energy back to the local community.Local communities all over the United States have protested against AI data centers, often owing to their outsized impact on local communities. Rising electricity costs, noise pollution, water shortages, air pollution, deforestation, and more are the things that small communities have to deal with because of these companies.To ease the pain of local communities, Trump is demanding that these large companies provide the communities they affect with something that will hopefully make their presence more acceptable. The Trump Administration is keen to stay ahead of China in the AI arms race and is looking for solutions to win back some favor by making the data centers pay something back to the affected communities; how that will practically transpire is yet to be seen. Considering the electricity-focused post, the dividend might be in the form of partially paying rising electricity costs to alleviate a pain point that directly affects many homes within the vicinity of data centers. The Trump Administration had ordered these companies to make their own electricity, as we’ve covered previously. Excess electricity from their generation could be used to further lower the electricity cost for the locals, including a recently passed act that orders data centers to shoulder the cost for grid upgrades to avoid taking it from the taxes of local communities.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: “Data Centers that were highly unpopular in a certain area have become extremely popular when a financial deal is struck.” Trump further says in his post, aiming to have more data centers built, “MAKE DEALS, and get them built!!!," the President said in closing.Whether the dividends will be enough to win over communities is yet to be known, as the economic aspect is only one facet of the problem. There are still plenty of problems to face; enormous water consumption, ecological damage, and pollution are still major challenges that make AI data centers a hard sell anywhere they’re located. history.titleZh: 特朗普宣布强制令，要求AI数据中心向当地社区支付能源红利
history.descriptionZh: 美国总统特朗普近日在Truth Social上发文，要求数据中心建设商和AI超大规模云厂商向受影响的社区支付“股息”或回馈，以缓解数据中心带来的能源价格上涨，甚至降低当地电价，从而提升数据中心在地方社区中的可接受度。特朗普警告称，数据中心不仅将被要求像此前所说的那样自行发电，还必须将多余电力赠送或出售给当地社区。这一表态的背景是，美国多地社区持续抗议AI数据中心，原因包括电价上涨、噪音污染、水资源短缺、空气污染和森林砍伐等。小型社区尤其承受着这些大型设施带来的外部成本，因此特朗普要求相关大公司向受影响社区提供回报，希望以此换取社区对数据中心建设的支持。特朗普政府希望在对华AI竞赛中保持领先，同时寻找办法为数据中心争取地方支持；但“社区股息”具体如何实施、金额和形式如何，目前尚不明确。从特朗普以电力为重点的表述看，股息可能表现为部分承担上涨的电费，从而直接缓解数据中心周边家庭的能源成本压力。此前，特朗普政府已要求这类公司自行发电；其多余发电量可用于进一步降低当地居民电价。文章还提到，近期通过的一项法案要求数据中心承担电网升级成本，避免将相关费用转嫁给当地社区税收。特朗普在帖文中称，“在某些地区极不受欢迎的数据中心，一旦达成财务协议，就会变得极受欢迎”，并呼吁“达成协议，把它们建起来”。不过，经济补偿能否真正赢得社区支持仍不确定，因为电价只是问题的一个方面。巨大的水资源消耗、生态破坏和污染仍是AI数据中心在各地选址和运营面临的主要挑战。文章关联报道还显示，弗吉尼亚州在AI数据中心导致电价严重上涨76%后，已要求企业承担所有专用上游电力基础设施费用；特朗普政府也将AI数据中心“费率payer保护承诺”扩展至州长和公用事业公司。总体来看，这一政策设想的核心创新在于把数据中心从单纯的电力消费者和社区成本来源，转变为自发电、余电回馈、电网升级成本分担和社区财务补偿的参与者，以“社会许可”换取建设空间。其潜在影响涉及AI数据中心选址、电力基础设施投资、地方电价和社区关系，但实际效果取决于补偿机制能否覆盖电力之外的水资源、生态和污染等外部性。目前尚无具体股息比例、执行时间表或强制性立法细节，政策落地仍待观察。

history.title: Qualcomm to cut jobs globally in "performance-based" layoffs, as company pivots to AI data center and edge computing markets
history.description: Qualcomm will begin performance-based layoffs worldwide in November as the chipmaker reallocates resources toward AI infrastructure, data centers, automotive, PCs, and edge computing, amid weaker consumer electronics demand.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Qualcomm has told employees it will cut jobs worldwide after its annual performance reviews, and it expects to begin informing affected employees in November. According to a Reuters report, CEO Cristiano Amon framed the move as a “performance-focused reduction” intended to build a “stronger performance culture,” stating that the company will consider organizational needs, business priorities, and employees’ skills and expertise when determining affected positions.“The reduction will address employees who have consistently fallen short of expectations,” said Amon. The memo did not specify which departments would be affected or how many jobs would be cut. The company had roughly 52,000 employees at the end of its 2025 fiscal year, typically in late September.Qualcomm, one of the world’s largest smartphone chip manufacturers with customers including Apple, Xiaomi, and Samsung, has been hit by an industry-wide decline in consumer electronics sales as rising memory costs reduce demand. Its shares have risen just 1.5% in 2026, compared to gains of almost 60% for the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: As a result, Qualcomm is strategically pivoting to AI infrastructure and edge computing, following a broadening trend across the semiconductor industry. The company unveiled its AI200 and AI250 AI inference accelerators in October 2025. After its latest earnings report projected lower quarterly profits than initially estimated, the company said that growth in its data center business would offset any lost revenue by fiscal year 2027.Qualcomm’s layoff decision comes as it tries to position itself for future growth. While mobile chips remain its core business, its best future opportunities might lie in data center silicon, automotive platforms, personal computing, and edge computing, and all those fields require specialized engineering talent. A performance-based reduction could let the company retain its most valuable employees in those fields while cutting duplicated roles, lower-performing teams, and positions that no longer fit its strategy. "We must have the right ​people in the right roles so they can perform at their best and the company can continue ​to succeed." The move comes on the back of Q3 2026 financial results that included a 4% year-on-year decline in revenue and 25% lower net income. The core handset business recorded a 20% decline in revenue on the year, too. The company reportedly recorded $97 million in severance-related restructuring charges in the first nine months of its fiscal year.Qualcomm’s move is part of a larger industry transition, largely driven by AI. After several years of aggressive hiring, many tech companies are now trimming their workforce to fund AI ambitions. Meta announced plans to cut 8,000 jobs to fund AI infrastructure. Even as companies are cutting jobs that don’t fit their AI roadmap, they're fiercely competing for process engineers, chip designers, and AI software developers. history.titleZh: 高通将在全球裁员，实施“基于绩效”的裁员，公司转向AI数据中心与边缘计算市场
history.descriptionZh:
高通已向员工表示，将在年度绩效评估后启动全球裁员，并预计从11月开始通知受影响员工。CEO克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙将此举定性为“以绩效为重点的缩减”，目的是建立“更强的绩效文化”。公司称，在确定受影响岗位时会综合考虑组织需求、业务优先级以及员工的技能和专长，裁员主要针对“长期未达到预期”的员工。不过，内部备忘录没有披露哪些部门会受影响，也没有说明具体裁员人数。截至2025财年末（通常在9月底），高通约有5.2万名员工。

高通是全球最大的智能手机芯片制造商之一，客户包括苹果、小米和三星。当前，消费电子行业整体销售下滑，内存成本上升又进一步抑制需求，高通业务受到冲击。2026年以来，高通股价仅上涨1.5%，而费城半导体指数同期涨幅接近60%。财务表现方面，高通2026财年第三季度收入同比下降4%，净利润下降25%；核心手机业务收入同比下滑20%。公司还披露，本财年前九个月录得9700万美元与遣散相关的重组费用。最新财报预计季度利润低于最初估计后，高通表示，到2027财年，数据中心业务的增长将抵消可能损失的收入。

在此背景下，高通正战略转向AI基础设施和边缘计算，这与半导体行业更广泛的趋势一致。2025年10月，高通发布了AI200和AI250 AI推理加速器，面向数据中心AI推理负载。原文未披露这两款产品的具体架构、制程、算力或能效参数，因此无法展开更细的技术原理；但从产品定位看，这标志着高通试图把在移动SoC、低功耗计算和终端侧AI上的积累，延伸到数据中心推理加速和边缘AI场景。AI推理是指运行已经训练好的模型来完成预测、生成或决策任务，随着大模型应用落地，推理需求快速增长；边缘计算则强调在终端或靠近数据源的位置处理AI任务，以降低延迟、节省带宽并提升隐私性。对高通而言，这些领域与其手机、PC、汽车和物联网业务存在协同空间。

此次裁员也反映出高通为未来增长重新配置人才的意图。移动芯片仍是其核心业务，但公司认为未来更好的机会可能来自数据中心芯片、汽车平台、个人计算和边缘计算，而这些领域都需要专业工程人才。以绩效为基础的缩减，可以帮助高通保留上述关键领域的高价值员工，同时削减重复岗位、低绩效团队以及不再符合公司战略的职位。阿蒙在备忘录中写道：“随着我们扩展业务，我们所需的能力和技能也在扩展。我们必须把合适的人放在合适的岗位上，让他们发挥最佳水平，公司才能继续成功。”

高通的调整也是AI驱动下科技行业转型的一部分。在多年积极招聘后，许多科技公司正在削减人力，为AI雄心提供资金。Meta已宣布计划裁减8000个岗位，以资助AI基础设施。与此同时，企业虽然裁撤不符合AI路线图的岗位，却在激烈争夺工艺工程师、芯片设计师和AI软件开发者。麦肯锡和SEMI基金会估计，到2030年，美国可能面临多达15.7万名半导体工人短缺，73%的芯片公司报告难以填补工程岗位。对高通来说，此次全球裁员既是应对手机芯片需求疲软和财务压力的短期措施，也是其向AI推理、数据中心、汽车、PC和边缘计算等新增长引擎转型的人才重组步骤。

history.title: AMD and Intel will work together to create a single PyTorch code path for AI inference on CPUs
history.description: AMD and Intel are working together to bring CPU inference optimizations for PyTorch under the unified oneDNN library.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel and AMD are integrating their CPU optimizations for PyTorch into a unified library, offering tuning for both AMD and Intel chips through the oneDNN library. AMD has maintained a downstream version of oneDNN called ZenDNN, which is now moving into the open-source oneDNN, published by the UXL Foundation and driven by Intel. AMD also announced it's joining the UXL Foundation as a "steering member," which "influences the future of the UXL Foundation" in exchange for a contribution of $20,000 per year.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleAMD says the move to unify these efforts under oneDNN was recommended by the x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group (EAG), which is a joint initiative that primarily exists between Intel and AMD and was established in 2024. The two companies have collaborated through the EAG previously, such as with the ACE extensions for x86 that we learned about earlier this year.The oneDNN backend is used for CPU inference, and it's built to accelerate that workload for the latest Intel (and now AMD) chips in frameworks like PyTorch. When oneDNN was added to PyTorch as a backend in late 2023, it showed a 1.24x improvement with the Float32 data type, and 2.21x for the BFloat16 data type.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: From the oneDNN GitHub, the library "detects hardware features at runtime" to generate optimized kernels for the platform, as well as provides low-precision data types. It also features optimized instructions for common AI and machine learning operations, such as matrix multiplication and convolution.For developers, the move simplifies working with PyTorch across different systems, ensuring a single backend provides the proper optimizations for whatever hardware you're running. Although the news here is focused on the x86 guard, oneDNN is a cross-platform library that works on Arm and RISC-V architectures as well. history.titleZh: AMD 与英特尔将合作打造统一的 PyTorch 代码路径，用于 CPU 上的 AI 推理
history.descriptionZh:
Intel与AMD正在把各自面向PyTorch的CPU优化整合到统一的oneDNN库中，使同一套oneDNN后端能够同时为AMD和Intel处理器提供调优支持。此前，AMD维护着oneDNN的下游定制版本ZenDNN；现在，ZenDNN的相关工作将并入由UXL基金会发布、Intel主导的开源oneDNN主线。AMD同时宣布以“指导成员”（steering member）身份加入UXL基金会，从而获得影响该基金会未来方向的权利，对应每年2万美元的会费贡献。

这一整合的背景是数据中心CPU需求上升，AI代理等负载推动CPU在AI推理中的重要性提升；同时，AMD称将相关努力统一到oneDNN，是由x86生态系统咨询小组（EAG）建议的。EAG是Intel与AMD主导的联合机制，成立于2024年，两家公司此前已通过该机制合作，例如今年早些时候公布的x86 ACE扩展。oneDNN最初由Intel开发，建立在更早的深度学习库之上，后来被纳入UXL基金会；Intel也是UXL基金会的创始成员之一，其他创始成员还包括Arm、高通、Google Cloud等。

从技术原理看，oneDNN是面向CPU推理的加速后端，目标是在PyTorch等框架中为最新Intel以及现在的AMD芯片加速相关负载。其GitHub说明显示，该库会在运行时检测硬件特性，据此生成针对当前平台优化的内核，并提供低精度数据类型；同时，它针对矩阵乘法、卷积等常见AI和机器学习操作提供优化指令。对开发者而言，这次整合简化了跨不同系统使用PyTorch的流程：不再需要为不同厂商CPU分别选择后端，单一oneDNN后端即可根据实际运行硬件提供相应优化。虽然此次新闻主要聚焦x86阵营，但oneDNN本身是跨平台库，也可在Arm和RISC-V架构上工作。

性能方面，文章回顾了oneDNN在2023年底作为PyTorch后端加入时的数据：Float32数据类型下带来1.24倍提升，BFloat16数据类型下带来2.21倍提升。这些数据说明，统一后端能够在CPU推理路径上带来实际加速，尤其低精度格式对AI推理更重要。此次AMD将ZenDNN并入oneDNN主线，核心创新不在于单一硬件参数，而在于软件栈和生态层面的收敛：减少AMD与Intel在PyTorch CPU优化上的重复建设和碎片化，把AMD的调优经验带入上游开源项目，并借助UXL基金会的治理机制形成更统一的x86及跨架构AI软件基础。

影响和应用场景上，这一举措将主要利好使用PyTorch进行CPU推理的开发者和数据中心用户，包括需要在一混合Intel/AMD服务器环境中部署AI模型的场景，以及矩阵运算、卷积等常见深度学习负载。对AMD而言，从下游维护ZenDNN转向参与上游oneDNN，有助于降低长期维护成本并提升软件栈可见度；对Intel和UXL基金会而言，则扩大了oneDNN作为统一CPU AI加速库的覆盖范围。更广泛地看，这也反映出AI推理需求上升后，CPU厂商正从各自优化转向在开源框架和标准组织内协同，以改善跨平台开发体验和部署效率。

history.title: Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading Chinese factories to produce advanced RAM chips as AI data center competition ramps up
history.description: Samsung and SK Hynix are reportedly upgrading their factories to produce more advanced RAM chips designed for AI data centers in an attempt to fend off competition from Chinese companies.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The two biggest NAND flash memory manufacturers on the planet, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, are reportedly working to upgrade their Chinese factories to produce more advanced chips for use in AI data centers, Reuters reports. The move comes as the two companies continue to fight off competition from the fast-growing Chinese memory makers like CXMT. Fierce competition in the lucrative AI RAM market has already seen manufacturers slash consumer-focused production to allow them to increase production capacity for the more advanced — and money-spinning — components.Go deeper with TH Premium: Memory (Image credit: SK Hynix)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplySamsung debuts three next-generation memory technologies for AI data centersThe future of DRAM: From DDR5 to future ICsHigh-bandwidth memory roadmapInside the history of DRAM price-fixing lawsuitsCiting four people familiar with the companies' plans, the report claims that Samsung Electronics aims to switch its Xian plant to the production of 286-layer flash chips by the end of the year. SK Hynix has its sights set a little lower, targeting chips with 240 or more layers at its Dalian facility. That factory was taken over back in 2021, but a timescale for the new upgrades isn't clear.However, while Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are well placed to deal with the growing threat from Chinese chipmakers, both are faced with additional complications in the form of U.S. regulations. Export controls on chipmaking equipment were applied in 2022, with the aim of slowing China's technological progress. Both companies, based in South Korea, must now get licenses in order to install U.S.-built hardware in Chinese factories. The report points to this as a reason for the recent growth of Chinese firms like Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. (YMTC). The company told investors at a recent IPO preparation meeting that it aims to become the world's largest NAND flash producer by the end of 2027.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While both Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix say that they are working in consultation with the U.S. authorities, there's little doubt that this extra step has hampered the companies' ability to upgrade their factories to better meet the new AI memory demand.It's impossible to overstate just how key Samsung and SK Hynix are to NAND supply. Samsung's Xian factory produces around 40% of the company's global output. It currently produces chips that have around 200 layers, but Samsung's plans aim to boost that to 286 layers for V9 NAND chips. For its part, SK Hynix's Dalian plant currently produces chips with 192 layers, with the company's aim for 240-layer chips reportedly confirmed by three people familiar with the plans. A report from September 2026 noted that it was eyeing production of 3D NAND memory for use in solid-state storage (SSD) products. The country's largest DRAM producer, CXMT, posted $22.41 billion in revenue and $11.57 billion in net profit in the first half of 2026 after years of losing money. But despite this purple patch, the company is still much smaller than the likes of Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron. history.titleZh: 三星与SK海力士正升级其在中国的工厂以生产先进的内存芯片，随着AI数据中心竞争加剧。
history.descriptionZh:
据路透社报道，全球最大的两家NAND闪存制造商三星电子和SK海力士正在升级其中国工厂，以生产更先进的闪存芯片，供应AI数据中心。此举一方面是为了抓住AI带来的高利润存储需求，另一方面也是为应对中国存储厂商快速崛起带来的竞争压力。当前，AI数据中心正大量消耗全球内存与存储供应，厂商纷纷削减消费级产品产能，把资源转向更先进、利润更高的组件。

从具体计划看，三星电子计划在年底前将其西安工厂切换为生产286层闪存芯片。西安工厂约占三星全球NAND产量的40%，目前主要生产约200层芯片，升级后将用于V9 NAND产品。SK海力士则计划在其大连工厂生产240层或更高层数的芯片；该工厂于2021年接手，目前生产192层芯片，但新升级的时间表尚不明确。就层数对比而言，三星从约200层提升至286层，SK海力士从192层提升至240层以上，均体现3D NAND通过垂直堆叠更多层数来提高存储密度和单芯片容量的技术路线。层数增加有助于在相同或更小面积内提供更高容量，并面向AI数据中心所需的大容量、高密度企业级SSD等应用。

不过，两家韩国公司在中国工厂推进先进制程仍面临美国出口管制带来的复杂因素。2022年美国对芯片制造设备实施出口管制，旨在减缓中国技术进步。三星和SK海力士若要在中国工厂安装美国制造的设备，需要获得许可证。报道认为，这一限制也是中国长江存储等企业近期增长的原因之一。长江存储在此前IPO准备会议上曾向投资者表示，目标是到2027年底成为全球最大NAND闪存生产商。三星和SK海力士均表示正与美国当局协商，但这一额外审批环节无疑影响了它们升级工厂、更好满足AI存储需求的能力。

与此同时，中国厂商也在扩展产品线。中国主要芯片制造商CXMT正寻求从DRAM生产向3D NAND延伸，2026年9月的报道称其考虑生产用于固态硬盘的3D NAND。作为中国最大DRAM生产商，CXMT在经历多年亏损后，2026年上半年实现224.1亿美元营收和115.7亿美元净利润，但规模仍远小于三星、SK海力士和美光。整体来看，三星和SK海力士升级中国工厂，是在AI数据中心存储需求激增、中国厂商加速追赶以及美国设备出口管制多重因素交织下作出的产能与技术布局调整，其进展将影响全球NAND供应格局和AI存储组件的产能分配。

history.title: Bringing the Spark to Europe: Local Intelligence Powers Next Wave of Agents

history.content: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing its full lineup of local AI hardware. RTX Spark, which launched last week, powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December. Announcements include: Underdog Desktop Agent now available for RTX Spark DGX Spark 64GB available on Friday, Oct. 23 NVIDIA Sync to support eight DGX Sparks and add Model Launcher this month October DGX Spark software update adds Wi-Fi Assistant and updates DGX Spark Skills DGX Station improves manageability with seven new integrations DGX Station for Windows launches in December with support for many manufacturing apps and agent harnesses Three new open source reference workflows for robotics on DGX Station NVIDIA Cloud Functions is coming in early access to DGX Station Recursive Flint, a new local coding model, is now available for NVIDIA local hardware Day-0 support for new Nemotron, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax and FLUX.3 AI models New accelerations for llama.cpp and vLLM inference engines and a new collection of checkpoints optimized for local AI hardware. Learn more about these local AI announcements below, and check out the demos and sessions at GTC Berlin. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements RTX Spark Brings Personal Agents to the Windows PC RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — running personal agents, accelerated content creation and 1440p 100 frames-per-second gaming with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. Here’s what early reviewers are saying about the platform since its October 16 release: “A dream machine for serious creators … ” — CGMag “Designed for the future of AI … ” — The Verge “An extremely capable, surprisingly portable and efficient machine … ” — PCMag Underdog, a new desktop agent app built for fully local, private AI, is also bringing its experience to RTX Spark. Powered by its Husky model-specific inference engine, Underdog runs models entirely on device, so personal agents can get work done without user data ever leaving the PC. Underdog is available now for download. To better enable developers and enthusiasts to build and customize local agents, many RTX Spark laptops come with an unlocked bootloader. During the GTC keynote, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang showed off how AI agents running on RTX Spark can be used to train Hugging Face’s Microduck robot using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Hermes Agent and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B. ASUS, Dell Technologies, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI laptops are available today, with Acer coming soon. Learn more about RTX Spark, and get started with the latest RTX Spark playbooks. DGX Spark Gives Developers Room to Build New DGX Spark 64GB systems — that can run models including Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B 24GB, Qwen3.8 27B and Gemma 4 26B-A4B — start rolling out from partners on Friday, Oct. 23. When workloads require more capacity, developers can connect multiple DGX Spark systems via built-in NVIDIA ConnectX-7 networking and NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant. This allows users to run advanced coding models like Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, DeepSeek v4 Flash 0731 and GLM 5.3 Flash. Now, DGX Spark supports clusters of up to eight units in manual configuration, enabling larger models, longer contexts, concurrent agents and distributed development. Ideal for small teams sharing a single cluster as a backend, with each developer running concurrent sessions against the same model, it delivers 1TB of unified memory — enough to run frontier-class models like GLM 5.3. Get started with the DGX Spark cluster playbook. NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher will also be available later this month. It simplifies access to local AI on a single DGX Spark or a cluster. With a few clicks, Model Launcher downloads a model and container suited to the configuration and connects the model to OpenCode. It automatically loads DGX Spark Skills for troubleshooting, device maintenance, access to official documentation and other workflow guidance. The October DGX Spark software update brings a new Wi-Fi Assistant that lets users switch networks when DGX Spark is running in appliance mode. Plus, DGX Spark Skills provide workflow-focused guidance in troubleshooting and device maintenance directly into NVIDIA Sync via OpenCode. DGX Spark systems are available directly from Acer, ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, Lenovo, MSI and NVIDIA. DGX Station Puts Frontier Intelligence at the Desk For larger teams, DGX Station offers 748GB of coherent memory and up to 20 petaflops of AI performance, enabling developers to run advanced models like GLM 5.3 and serve 30+ users at speeds comparable to those provided by cloud models. Adding scale, NVIDIA Sync now supports DGX Station, simplifying connections between two Linux-based systems. New integrations with Absolute Security, Splunk by Cisco, Fleet Device Management, Microsoft Intune, Perforce Puppet, Progress Software Chef and Tanium let IT teams manage DGX Station systems through enterprise setup, management and conformity processes, helping accelerate approvals and reduce deployment risk while minimizing time to first token. With the upcoming Windows-based systems, developers can build workflows that harness professional applications, run on NVIDIA RTX PRO GPUs and operate from agents that run their large language models (LLMs) on NVIDIA GB300 systems — all in one machine. DGX Station for Windows, expected from system manufacturer partners in December, extends local AI into the applications and operating environment enterprises already use. Engineers can run local models and agents in Windows-native software with access to AI models, tools and agents on the same system. DGX Station for Windows will feature support for manufacturing applications from nTop, Dassault Systèmes, Keysight Technologies, MathWorks, Rockwell Automation, Siemens, Synopsys, Unity and Altera for AI-guided design, simulation, validation and engineering automation. Users will be able to run agents using Hermes Agent, Perplexity or Aible on premises for agentic control in enterprise environments. The same local, controlled computing model extends to robotics. DGX Station gives robotics teams dedicated compute for post-training, simulation and evaluation, shortening iteration cycles without waiting for shared infrastructure. NVIDIA released three open source reference workflows that bring GPT-6 Astra, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Lab-Arena and Cosmos to NVIDIA DGX Station. Developers can use them to refine GR00T 1.7 models with reinforcement learning, train dexterous manipulation skills and post-train Cosmos world models for synthetic data generation. NVIDIA Cloud Functions is coming in early access to Linux-based DGX Station. Teams can register local model endpoints in a shared catalog and access them through one OpenAI-compatible entry point. Developers can upgrade the model behind an endpoint without changing application code, while teammates can use shared models without direct machine access. This turns a DGX Station into a locally controlled inference service for a team. DGX Station brings local iteration to AI factory development. On the show floor at GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is previewing DSX OS running on DGX Station to simulate AI factory operations before full infrastructure is available. Another demo will showcase DGX Station systems powering a local token factory for more than 30 software developers. DGX Station systems are shipping today from ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, MSI, Supermicro and Exxact. DGX Station for Windows systems are expected to begin shipping later this year from ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, MSI and Supermicro. Introducing Recursive Flint — A New Local Coding Model Optimized for RTX Spark Today, frontier AI lab Recursive Superintelligence released Recursive Flint, a local LLM built for fast, accurate coding. A 40-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 2.5 billion active parameters, Recursive Flint delivers fast inference and performs well in agentic coding benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro v2, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench verified. Recursive Flint was built using Recursive’s Eureka Machine, a system for large-scale automated AI research. It automates the full research loop: proposes ideas, implements them, runs experiments to validate ideas and uses the results to decide what to try next — creating specialized kernels that boosted Flint’s generation speed on RTX Spark by 55% without changing the model’s weights. Developers can download the open weights on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license and run the model on RTX Spark and DGX Spark systems, as well as GeForce RTX and RTX PRO GPUs. Developers can also post-train the model with NeMo Automodel for supervised fine-tuning and low-rank adaptation, or LoRa, as well as NeMo RL for group relative policy optimization. New Models With Day-Zero Support NVIDIA is also adding day-zero model support for NVIDIA Nemotron Bolt E4B 4B, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, Liquid AI’s LFM2.5-24B-A2B, plus the FLUX.3 Klein diffusion model. Nemotron Bolt E4B 4GB packs natural conversation and multi-turn agentic skills into as little as 4GB of memory, powering fast local voice assistants, interactive game characters and embedded interfaces on NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs, NVIDIA Jetson devices, and RTX and DGX Spark. Bolt E4B 4GB releases on Friday, Oct. 23. Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6-billion-parameter open weights image model for generation and editing. NVIDIA-optimized builds let it run on GeForce RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM and create a 1-megapixel image in about four seconds on an RTX 5090 GPU. MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a new open model built for NVIDIA DGX Station and DGX Spark, bringing long-context AI to the desktop. Liquid AI’s LFM2.5-24B-A2B is an open weights reasoning model that activates just 2 billion of its 24 billion parameters per token, making it fast enough to run private, tool-calling AI agents directly on PCs. Plus, NVIDIA has released a new collection of model checkpoints optimized for RAM efficiency on local AI hardware, enabling frontier-class open models to run with sufficient memory left over for KV cache. Each checkpoint is quantized while staying close to full-precision accuracy, starting with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local on a single DGX Spark 128GB or RTX PRO 6000 and GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local on two systems. Developers can post-train on day zero with NeMo AutoModel on both DGX Spark and RTX Spark, with example recipes for Nemotron Bolt E4B, Flux 3 Image Klein and more. Accelerated AI Inference NVIDIA continues to work with the llama.cpp and vLLM open source communities to accelerate agentic workloads on local hardware. In llama.cpp, new speculative decoding support with MTP for Qwen 3.8 Flash Next makes end-to-end agentic tasks up to 1.4x faster on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. In vLLM, faster speculative decoding and new FlashInfer prefill kernels for Qwen’s linear-attention layers make agentic tasks with Qwen3.8 27B up to 1.3x faster on DGX Spark. On DGX Station, GLM 5.3 Flash gets up to 1.2x higher throughput. Check out NVIDIA’s local AI inference recipes to try these latest optimizations. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. See notice regarding software product information. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

history.titleZh: 将 Spark 引入欧洲：本地智能驱动下一波智能体
history.descriptionZh:
在柏林GTC大会上，NVIDIA展示了其完整的本地AI硬件产品线，包括面向Windows PC个人代理的RTX Spark、面向Linux开发者的DGX Spark，以及面向企业团队运行前沿工作负载的DGX Station（Windows版本将于12月推出）。

RTX Spark于10月16日发布，配备最高128GB统一内存和1 petaflop AI算力，可运行个人代理、加速内容创作，并支持1440p 100帧/秒游戏。早期评测将其称为“面向严肃创作者的梦想机器”（CGMag）、“为AI未来而设计”（The Verge）以及“性能极强、便携性出人意料且高效的机器”（PCMag）。专为完全本地、私密AI打造的新桌面代理应用Underdog同步登陆RTX Spark，其基于Husky模型专用推理引擎，所有模型均在设备端运行，用户数据不会离开PC。许多RTX Spark笔记本还提供解锁的bootloader，方便开发者构建和定制本地代理。在GTC主题演讲中，黄仁勋演示了RTX Spark上的AI代理如何使用NVIDIA Isaac Lab、Hermes Agent和Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B训练Hugging Face的Microduck机器人。华硕、戴尔、惠普、联想、微软和微星笔记本现已上市，宏碁即将跟进。

DGX Spark 64GB系统将于10月23日（周五）起通过合作伙伴陆续推出，可运行Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B 24GB、Qwen3.8 27B和Gemma 4 26B-A4B等模型。当工作负载需要更大容量时，开发者可通过内置NVIDIA ConnectX-7网络和NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant连接多台DGX Spark，运行Qwen 3.8 Flash Next、DeepSeek v4 Flash 0731和GLM 5.3 Flash等高级编码模型。目前DGX Spark支持手动配置最多8台集群，提供1TB统一内存，足以运行GLM 5.3等前沿级模型，适合小团队共享单一集群作为后端、每位开发者对同一模型运行并发会话。NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher将于本月晚些时候推出，简化单台或集群DGX Spark上本地AI的访问——只需几次点击即可下载适配配置的模型和容器并连接至OpenCode，同时自动加载DGX Spark Skills用于故障排除、设备维护和官方文档访问。10月DGX Spark软件更新新增Wi-Fi Assistant，支持设备在设备模式下切换网络。DGX Spark系统可直接从宏碁、华硕、戴尔、技嘉、惠普、联想、微星和NVIDIA购买。

面向更大团队的DGX Station提供748GB一致内存和最高20 petaflops AI性能，可运行GLM 5.3等高级模型并以媲美云模型的速度服务30名以上用户。NVIDIA Sync现已支持DGX Station，简化两台Linux系统之间的连接。与Absolute Security、Cisco旗下Splunk、Fleet Device Management、Microsoft Intune、Perforce Puppet、Progress Software Chef和Tanium的新集成，使IT团队能够通过企业级设置、管理和合规流程管理DGX Station系统，加速审批并降低部署风险。即将推出的Windows版DGX Station预计12月由系统制造商合作伙伴推出，将本地AI扩展至企业已在使用的应用和操作系统环境。工程师可在Windows原生软件中运行本地模型和代理，同时访问同一系统上的AI模型、工具和代理。该版本将支持nTop、达索系统、是德科技、MathWorks、罗克韦尔自动化、西门子、新思科技、Unity和Altera的制造应用，用于AI引导的设计、仿真、验证和工程自动化；用户还可使用Hermes Agent、Perplexity或Aible在本地运行代理，实现企业环境中的代理控制。

同样的本地受控计算模式也延伸至机器人领域。DGX Station为机器人团队提供专用算力用于后训练、仿真和评估，缩短迭代周期而无需等待共享基础设施。NVIDIA发布了三个开源参考工作流，将GPT-6 Astra、NVIDIA Isaac Lab、Isaac Lab-Arena和Cosmos引入DGX Station，开发者可用其通过强化学习精炼GR00T 1.7模型、训练灵巧操作技能，以及后训练Cosmos世界模型用于合成数据生成。NVIDIA Cloud Functions即将以早期访问形式登陆Linux版DGX Station，团队可在共享目录中注册本地模型端点，并通过一个OpenAI兼容入口访问；开发者可在不更改应用代码的情况下升级端点背后的模型，队友无需直接访问机器即可使用共享模型，从而将DGX Station转变为团队本地控制的推理服务。在柏林GTC展台上，NVIDIA还预览了在DGX Station上运行DSX OS以在完整基础设施可用前模拟AI工厂运营，另一演示展示了DGX Station系统为30多名软件开发者提供本地令牌工厂支持。DGX Station系统现由华硕、戴尔、技嘉、惠普、微星、Supermicro和Exxact发货；Windows版预计今年晚些时候由华硕、戴尔、技嘉、惠普、微星和Supermicro开始发货。

前沿AI实验室Recursive Superintelligence发布了Recursive Flint，这是一款为快速、准确编码而构建的本地大语言模型。该模型为400亿参数混合专家模型，每token激活25亿参数，推理速度快，在SWE-Bench Pro v2、Terminal-Bench 2.1和SWE-bench verified等代理编码基准中表现良好。Recursive Flint使用Recursive的Eureka Machine构建——这是一个大规模自动化AI研究系统，可自动完成提出想法、实现、运行实验验证并据此决定下一步的完整研究循环，其创建的专业内核在不改变模型权重的情况下将Flint在RTX Spark上的生成速度提升了55%。开发者可在Hugging Face上以Apache 2.0许可证下载开放权重，并在RTX Spark、DGX Spark以及GeForce RTX和RTX PRO GPU上运行该模型，还可使用NeMo Automodel进行监督微调和LoRA后训练，或使用NeMo RL进行组相对策略优化。

NVIDIA还新增了对多款模型的day-zero支持，包括NVIDIA Nemotron Bolt E4B 4B、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、MiniMax、Liquid AI的LFM2.5-24B-A2B，以及FLUX.3 Klein扩散模型。Nemotron Bolt E4B 4GB仅需4GB内存即可提供自然对话和多轮代理技能，在GeForce RTX GPU、NVIDIA Jetson设备以及RTX和DGX Spark上驱动快速本地语音助手、互动游戏角色和嵌入式界面，将于10月23日发布。Black Forest Labs的FLUX 3 Image Klein是56亿参数开放权重图像生成与编辑模型，NVIDIA优化版本可在仅8GB显存的GeForce RTX GPU上运行，在RTX 5090上约4秒生成100万像素图像。MiniMax M3.1 Flash是为DGX Station和DGX Spark构建的新开放模型，将长上下文AI带入桌面。Liquid AI的LFM2.5-24B-A2B是开放权重推理模型，每token仅激活240亿参数中的20亿，速度足以在PC上直接运行私密工具调用AI代理。此外，NVIDIA发布了针对本地AI硬件RAM效率优化的新模型检查点集合，使前沿级开放模型运行时留有足够内存用于KV缓存；每个检查点在量化的同时保持接近全精度准确率，首批包括可在单台DGX Spark 128GB或RTX PRO 6000上运行的Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local，以及需两台系统的GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local。开发者可在DGX Spark和RTX Spark上使用NeMo AutoModel进行day-zero后训练，并获得Nemotron Bolt E4B、Flux 3 Image Klein等模型的示例配方。

在推理加速方面，NVIDIA持续与llama.cpp和vLLM开源社区合作加速本地硬件上的代理工作负载。在llama.cpp中，针对Qwen 3.8 Flash Next的新MTP推测解码支持使NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell上的端到端代理任务提速最高1.4倍。在vLLM中，更快的推测解码和针对Qwen线性注意力层的新FlashInfer预填充内核使DGX Spark上Qwen3.8 27B的代理任务提速最高1.3倍；在DGX Station上，GLM 5.3 Flash吞吐量提升最高1.2倍。

history.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
history.description: General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding […]
history.content: General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence, a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Learning through interaction requires a continuous cycle of generating experience, evaluating outcomes and updating models, requiring infrastructure that can support the entire process at scale. A5X brings Vera Rubin into Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer as an integrated system, combining compute, networking and storage to support experience-driven learning at scale. “We’re building superlearners that continually improve through their own experience,” said David Silver, founder and CEO of Ineffable Intelligence. “That demands both substantial compute and a tight connection between generating experience and training on it, so each improvement in the agent can quickly shape its next experience. Vera Rubin’s combination of compute performance and high-bandwidth connectivity, between the Vera CPU and Rubin GPUs and between the Rubin GPUs within the rack, allow us to push the scale and ambition of our reinforcement learning research further.” WPP, a London-based marketing and communications company, has also demonstrated its creative agent reference architecture on NVIDIA Vera Rubin-based A5X instances using NVIDIA Nemotron models and NVIDIA OpenShell, part of the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for safe AI agents. The agents turn conversational requests into multistep creative workflows, such as video generation, upscaling and restyling, with human approval before execution. OpenShell provides governed sandboxes for agent execution, helping control access to sensitive brand assets and creative tools. In WPP’s initial tests, workloads that typically required a multi-node cluster ran on a single A5X instance. As organizations deploy agentic systems, they need to protect the proprietary models and sensitive data that power these systems — even when running on infrastructure they don’t own. Google Cloud will be among the first cloud providers to offer NVIDIA Confidential Computing at rack scale on bare metal instances such as A4X Max instances powered by NVIDIA GB300 NVL72. Additionally, Google Cloud is making Confidential Computing generally available on G4 VMs powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, offering a flexible platform for confidential inference and fine-tuning. Customers including Vertebrae, Polaris Cloud and Confidential Core AI are using Confidential G4 for conversational privacy, verifiable agent execution and policy-governed enterprise intelligence. To support energy-efficient deployment at scale, Google Cloud and NVIDIA are exploring NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS capabilities for Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to help optimize performance per watt and expand capacity within available data-center power budgets. Learn more about NVIDIA Vera Rubin and Google Cloud A5X instances. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements
