history.descriptionZh:
Google Cloud 宣布，基于 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 的 A5X 实例将于下月正式可用，并计划把可用范围扩展到欧洲，为云客户提供集训练、推理和大规模强化学习于一体的集成平台。A5X 将 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72、NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs、Google Cloud Virgo 网络以及 Google Cloud 第四代先进液冷技术整合在一起，面向大规模智能体推理和强化学习等 demanding 工作负载。Google Cloud 还计划把基于 Vera Rubin 的基础设施跨多个站点扩展到最多 96 万块 Rubin GPU，体现出其面向大规模 AI 训练与经验驱动学习的部署规模。

从技术架构看，A5X 并非单一算力实例，而是把计算、网络和存储整合进 Google Cloud 的 AI Hypercomputer，以支持“生成经验—评估结果—更新模型”的持续循环。强化学习和智能体系统需要不断通过交互产生新经验，并快速把经验用于训练和模型更新，因此对算力规模以及经验生成与训练之间的连接效率提出很高要求。Vera Rubin 平台提供 Vera CPU 与 Rubin GPU 之间、以及机架内 Rubin GPU 之间的高带宽连接，旨在缩短这一闭环链路，使智能体的一次改进能够更快影响下一次经验生成。NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs 和 Google Cloud Virgo 网络则承担高速网络互连，第四代液冷技术用于支撑高密度部署和能效管理。

首批客户方面，由 AlphaGo 创造者 David Silver 创立的伦敦技术公司 Ineffable Intelligence 成为首家访问 A5X 的客户，正在利用该平台推进大规模强化学习和“超学习器”系统。所谓超学习器，是能够持续从自身经验中学习并不断改进的系统。David Silver 表示，这类系统既需要大量算力，也需要在经验生成与基于经验训练之间建立紧密连接，使智能体的每次改进都能快速塑造其下一次经验；Vera Rubin 的计算性能和高带宽连接能力，使其能够进一步扩大强化学习研究的规模和目标。

应用层面，伦敦营销与传播公司 WPP 已在基于 Vera Rubin 的 A5X 实例上演示其创意智能体参考架构，使用 NVIDIA Nemotron 模型和 NVIDIA OpenShell。该架构可把对话式请求转化为多步骤创意工作流，例如视频生成、图像放大和风格重塑，并在执行前引入人工批准。OpenShell 为智能体执行提供受治理的沙箱，帮助控制对敏感品牌资产和创意工具的访问。在 WPP 的初期测试中，过去通常需要多节点集群运行的工作负载，可以在单个 A5X 实例上运行，显示出集成平台在特定创意智能体工作负载上的资源集约能力。

安全和隐私也是该新闻的重点。随着企业部署智能体系统，即使运行在非自有基础设施上，也需要保护专有模型和敏感数据。Google Cloud 将成为首批在裸金属实例上提供机架级 NVIDIA Confidential Computing 的云提供商之一，例如基于 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 的 A4X Max 实例。同时，Google Cloud 正在基于 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU 的 G4 VM 上正式提供 Confidential Computing，为机密推理和微调提供更灵活的平台。Vertebrae、Polaris Cloud 和 Confidential Core AI 等客户正使用 Confidential G4 支持对话隐私、可验证的智能体执行以及受策略治理的企业智能。为支持规模化且节能的部署，Google Cloud 与 NVIDIA 还在探索 NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS 能力在 Vera Rubin 基础设施上的应用，以优化每瓦性能，并在可用数据中心功耗预算内扩展容量。总体来看，A5X 的核心意义在于把训练、推理和大规模强化学习所需算力、网络、存储、液冷与安全能力整合为云上系统，服务持续学习型智能体和复杂创意工作流等新一代 AI 应用。

history.title: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents
history.description: Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design.  NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for […]
history.content: Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign: AI Clouds Building European AI Infrastructure Europe is home to world-class research, engineering talent, industrial expertise, data, the next generation of models and applications that requires large-scale computing close to where that knowledge resides. Regional AI clouds provide the infrastructure foundation on which model builders, enterprises and entire industries can grow. As AI factories scale, power becomes a constraint which makes it critical for every watt to produce more intelligence. Nscale is using the NVIDIA DSX Platform to coordinate power allocation with workload requirements. In tests using NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems, Nscale demonstrated that NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS enabled 37% more GPUs and nearly 50% higher aggregate inference throughput within the same provisioned power budget. Nscale also plans to deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure for frontier-model training and production workloads to support leading model and application builders using its full-stack, vertically integrated platform with expansion across five European markets. Crusoe is developing Spark, its liquid-cooled modular AI factories designed for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, to bring Crusoe Cloud capacity closer to users for low-latency AI inference. Crusoe Cloud serves leading model and application builders across EMEA, including Base44, Gradium, LTX and Wonderful. Aleria, Cassava Technologies, Firebird, G42, Radiant, SWI Compute and Vultr are also developing and expanding NVIDIA-powered AI infrastructure across Europe, the Nordics, Africa and Central Asia. Regional capacity from AI clouds combines the full-stack NVIDIA DSX AI Factory platform, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin, NVIDIA BlueField and NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, giving customers greater choice and control over where workloads and data reside while advancing sovereign computing services and economic growth. Open: Models and Libraries, From Training to Inference Across the ecosystem, AI clouds are expanding NVIDIA-powered infrastructure and services for developers to build applications with open models and libraries. This new capacity supports model training, fine-tuning for specialized tasks and inference at scale, including applications deployed at the edge. For production inference, Nebius has adopted NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX, using Spectrum-X Ethernet networking to integrate it with Vera Rubin NVL72 on Nebius Token Factory. The combination will bring faster token generation to latency-sensitive applications and agentic systems through the platform’s managed serverless and dedicated endpoints and familiar application programming interfaces. For robotics and physical AI, Nebius offers a purpose-built AI cloud solution that includes its full-stack Physical AI Workbench. Robotics companies including Rhoda AI, RoboForce and Sereact are building on the platform. The company also launched three NVIDIA retail agent blueprints — covering inventory, store operations, and fine-tuning —- into early access on Nebius infrastructure. Nebius is expanding its cloud services widely across the continent with its Physical AI Living Lab, and in Germany as a computer supplier for the Next Frontier Challenge of SPRIND, the Federal Agency for Breakthrough Innovation. Baseten has developed a specialized model for code-review routing with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning used by CodeRabbit. Through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, CodeRabbit improved routing agreement from 75.8% to 80.7% while reducing estimated inference costs by 50% for the evaluated workload. The results demonstrate how AI developers can customize NVIDIA open models for specialized tasks while improving accuracy and inference efficiency. Fireworks and Era4 are partnering to bring open models to enterprises across the U.K. and Europe. The collaboration combines Fireworks’ model training and inference platform with direct liquid-cooled capacity powered by NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs at Era4’s Chesterfield facility, supporting plans for enterprise AI solutions in financial services, insurance and life sciences. Mistral is expanding its NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure to support model training, customization and inference. The expansion includes NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure planned for delivery in 2027. Trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral-operated European data centers, Mistral Large 4 is the company’s latest frontier multimodal model, advancing capabilities across coding, agentic workflows and multimodal understanding. Verda plans to deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin, continuing to promote open weight models with NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Cosmos already in production, and using the NVIDIA Dynamo open source framework for inference optimization. Safe: Secure Boundaries for AI Agents, From Silicon to Software As developers connect models to tools and business systems, they also need controls over what agents can access and do. Announced at GTC Berlin, the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture with support from AI cloud ecosystem partners. Built on the foundation of NVIDIA OpenShell secure runtime software, the architecture is designed to give organizations full-stack control to deploy AI agents with clear boundaries around what agents can access and do. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 for model inference, NVIDIA Vera CPUs with OpenShell for agent harnesses and tool use, and NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs running NVIDIA Sentry for in-silicon enforcement. Each play a distinct role in delivering that control, working together so agents can achieve what they’re meant to do without moving beyond the boundaries people set for them. Partners including Aleria, Baseten, Cassava, CoreWeave, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, Firebird, Fireworks, Firmus, G42, GMI Cloud, IREN, Lambda, Lightning AI, Nebius, Nscale, Radiant Verda and Vultr are supporting the OpenShell Reference Architecture to enable secure agentic deployments for their customers. Together, European AI clouds are connecting regional infrastructure investment with the work of building and deploying AI. Expanded capacity gives builders more places to run workloads. Model and inference services help them put that capacity to use. Agent controls address what applications are allowed to do as they move into production. Explore NVIDIA Cloud Partners for infrastructure and services, and the OpenShell Reference Architecture for agent deployment controls. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

history.titleZh: NVIDIA 云合作伙伴在欧洲规模化扩张——主权、开放，专为安全的 AI 智能体打造
history.descriptionZh:
在欧洲，AI原生企业和开发者对算力的需求正加速推动区域AI云生态发展。开发者希望获得更靠近数据源的算力、可定制并能大规模服务的开放模型，以及从设计之初就强调安全的全栈基础设施。在此背景下，NVIDIA Cloud Partners正在欧洲、北欧、非洲和中亚扩展面向模型训练与推理的区域算力，帮助开发者构建智能体AI（agentic AI）和物理AI应用，并为智能体可访问和可执行的范围建立边界。这一生态正把欧洲的能源、数据、研究和工业专长转化为“生产性智能”，支持新模型、新应用、新组织和新岗位，同时让用户对AI开发与部署的地点和方式拥有更多控制权。

在主权AI云和基础设施方面，区域AI云被视为模型构建者、企业和行业增长的基础设施底座。随着AI工厂规模扩大，电力成为关键约束，提高每瓦所产出的智能变得尤为重要。Nscale使用NVIDIA DSX平台协调电力分配与工作负载需求；在基于NVIDIA GB300 NVL72系统的测试中，DSX MaxLPS使同一供电预算内可部署的GPU数量增加37%，聚合推理吞吐提高近50%。Nscale还计划部署NVIDIA Vera Rubin基础设施，用于前沿模型训练和生产负载，并通过其全栈垂直整合平台扩展至五个欧洲市场。Crusoe正在开发面向Vera Rubin平台的液冷模块化AI工厂Spark，以把Crusoe Cloud容量更靠近用户，支持低延迟AI推理；其Crusoe Cloud服务EMEA地区的模型和应用构建者，包括Base44、Gradium、LTX和Wonderful。Aleria、Cassava Technologies、Firebird、G42、Radiant、SWI Compute和Vultr也在欧洲、北欧、非洲和中亚扩展NVIDIA驱动的AI基础设施。区域AI云能力结合NVIDIA DSX AI Factory全栈平台，包括Vera Rubin、BlueField和Spectrum-X以太网网络，使客户能更好地选择和控制工作负载与数据所在位置，并推进主权计算服务和经济增长。

在开放模型、库和推理服务方面，AI云正在扩展NVIDIA驱动的基础设施和服务，支持开发者使用开放模型和库构建应用。新增容量覆盖模型训练、面向专门任务的微调和大规模推理，包括边缘部署应用。Nebius在生产推理中采用NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX，并通过Spectrum-X以太网将其与Vera Rubin NVL72集成到Nebius Token Factory，借助托管无服务器和专用端点及熟悉的API，为延迟敏感应用和智能体系统带来更快的token生成。面向机器人和物理AI，Nebius提供包含全栈Physical AI Workbench的专用AI云方案，Rhoda AI、RoboForce和Sereact等机器人公司正在该平台构建应用；Nebius还将三个NVIDIA零售智能体蓝图（库存、门店运营和微调）引入其基础设施的早期访问，并通过Physical AI Living Lab扩展欧洲云服务，同时在德国作为SPRIND“Next Frontier Challenge”的计算机供应商。Baseten使用Nemotron 3.5 Lightning开发了代码审查路由专用模型，CodeRabbit采用后通过监督微调和强化学习，将路由一致性从75.8%提升至80.7%，并在评估工作负载中把估计推理成本降低50%，展示了企业如何针对专门任务定制NVIDIA开放模型，同时提升准确性和推理效率。Fireworks与Era4合作，将开放模型带给英国和欧洲企业，结合Fireworks的模型训练与推理平台和Era4 Chesterfield设施中由NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU驱动的直接液冷容量，支持金融服务、保险和生命科学领域的企业AI方案。Mistral正在扩展NVIDIA加速计算基础设施，以支持模型训练、定制和推理，其中包括计划于2027年交付的Vera Rubin基础设施；其最新前沿多模态模型Mistral Large 4在Mistral运营的欧洲数据中心使用3800块NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU训练，提升了编码、智能体工作流和多模态理解能力。Verda计划部署Vera Rubin，并继续推广开放权重模型，NVIDIA Nemotron和NVIDIA Cosmos已投入生产，同时使用NVIDIA Dynamo开源框架优化推理。

在智能体安全边界方面，随着开发者把模型连接到工具和业务系统，他们需要控制智能体可访问和可执行的内容。NVIDIA在GTC Berlin发布NVIDIA OpenShell参考架构，并获得AI云生态伙伴支持。该架构基于OpenShell安全运行时软件，旨在让组织获得全栈控制能力，在部署AI智能体时明确其访问和行动边界。其中，NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72用于模型推理，NVIDIA Vera CPU配合OpenShell用于智能体运行框架和工具使用，NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU运行NVIDIA Sentry实现芯片级执行。三者协同，使智能体能够完成预期任务，同时不越过人类设定的边界。Aleria、Baseten、Cassava、CoreWeave、Crusoe、DigitalOcean、Firebird、Fireworks、Firmus、G42、GMI Cloud、IREN、Lambda、Lightning AI、Nebius、Nscale、Radiant、Verda和Vultr等伙伴正在支持该参考架构，为客户提供安全的智能体部署能力。

总体来看，欧洲AI云正把区域基础设施投资与AI构建和部署连接起来：扩展的容量为开发者提供更多运行工作负载的地点，模型和推理服务帮助利用这些容量，智能体控制则解决应用进入生产后可执行行为的边界问题。这一生态有望提升欧洲在主权计算、数据驻留、能效和行业AI应用方面的能力，并推动金融、保险、生命科学、零售、机器人、代码开发和多模态应用等场景落地。

history.title: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA
history.description: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries, as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle.  Bringing those capabilities together on the factory floor, the NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) is now available in […]
history.content: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries, as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle. Bringing those capabilities together on the factory floor, the NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) is now available in early access on GitHub, providing a path for developers to build and deploy always-on factory manager agents that coordinate work across machines, and specialist agents focused on use cases such as visual inspection, root cause analysis, report generation and fleet management. These agents can connect to frontier models, including NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron, and foundational knowledge including computer-aided design, product lifecycle management, simulation software, and IT and operational technology systems. Building on the FOX blueprint enables the ecosystem to build industrial agents that monitor factory operations in real time, correlate visual findings and machine logs to investigate problems, and coordinate responses. With Cosmos in-context learning, these agents can adapt using examples and documentation, without fine-tuning. Siemens is integrating agents built using FOX into Intelligence Center X, its agentic enterprise system, to help identify root causes and coordinate factory operations, for estimated cost savings of 20%. Siemens’ Process Preparation X agents use NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory tools and skills to generate defect images for circuit-board inspection. At its Erlangen electronics factory, Siemens used this approach to reduce calibration time of inspection processes by 40%. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Accelerating Engineering From the First Design NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries accelerate simulation, giving engineers faster feedback to explore design alternatives before committing to physical prototypes. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is releasing cuDSS for general availability, accelerating the demanding calculations behind the complex simulations of structural stress, fluid flow, electromagnetic fields and semiconductor device behavior. Mercedes-Benz uses Siemens’ Simcenter STAR-CCM+ running on NVIDIA GPUs to compare vehicle designs through faster aerodynamic simulations. In factories, the company applies NVIDIA Cosmos 3 and the Metropolis VSS blueprint to build agents for vehicle inspection and windshield assembly verification, detecting deviations and ensuring consistently high quality. Cadence is benchmarking automotive fluid-dynamics workloads on NVIDIA GPUs to assess opportunities for faster design iteration, while Autodesk brings the NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo and Warp frameworks into NavPack, integrated with Autodesk Alias, to help designers like those at Bentley’s predict vehicle performance and iterate faster using simulation-trained AI. imec and Infineon are accelerating semiconductor simulation with Synopsys software and NVIDIA accelerated computing. Benchmarks of S-Litho on imec’s model show up to 40x speedup, while Infineon uses Sentaurus Device with NVIDIA CUDA libraries to achieve a 12x speedup in 3D breakdown simulation for next-generation power devices. Leonardo is working with Neural Concept on AI-driven aircraft design, tapping NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to bring aircraft geometry and aerodynamic simulation results together. Video courtesy of Neural Concept and Leonardo. Car manufacturers use Dassault Systèmes’ LEO & AURA Virtual Companions, powered by NVIDIA Nemotron, and orchestrating CATIA AI Agents & SIMULIA AI Agents with SIMULIA solvers, accelerated by NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, to rapidly design and virtually test vehicle doors before building physical prototypes. UniversalAGI is working with Saab to protect sailors from life-threatending wave impacts at sea, using UniversalAGI’s Latent Interaction Field Transformer physics AI foundation models with accelerated processing by NVIDIA Warp to evaluate thousands of wave conditions and headings in real time instead of days. These capabilities enable vessels to anticipate dangerous motion and autonomously select safer routes to avoid putting sailors at risk, while NVIDIA Omniverse libraries help visualize vessel behavior at sea. PhysicsX is working with GB1, Britain’s America’s Cup team, on AI-powered yacht design, using NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to visualize hull geometry and pressure fields, while Fermioniq’s Sofia agent helps Deltares and Dutch ministries model river flow by translating natural-language requests into simulation solvers built on NVIDIA Warp. Mistral plans to use CUDA-X, Warp and Omniverse libraries to accelerate physics simulation and generate training data for engineering AI models. Testing Factories and Robots Virtually NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac libraries enable digital twins and robotics simulation, helping manufacturers evaluate production systems and robot behavior before making changes on the factory floor. Video courtesy of Agile Robots, Audi and Dassault Systèmes. Audi uses a battery-production digital twin built with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to test production concepts before physical equipment is available. The company is also working with Dassault Systèmes and Agile Robots to simulate and validate mobile humanoid robots and logistics processes in DELMIA virtual twins built with Omniverse libraries. Schaeffler is integrating digital twins of its humanoid actuators — components that move robot joints — with NVIDIA Isaac simulation frameworks, helping its robotics partners evaluate component behavior in simulation and reduce physical testing. At Volkswagen Sachsen’s Transparent Factory, Wandelbots uses NOVA with Isaac Sim, built on Omniverse and OpenUSD, to validate assembly workflows digitally and prepare applications for physical robots. Falkor, a KONGSBERG company, is integrating agents and NVIDIA Omniverse libraries into its platform. With Microsoft Azure NCv6 virtual machines powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, agents with spatial intelligence combine engineering data, operating information and 3D equipment geometry to see, simulate and reason over industrial facilities, supporting inspection and maintenance use cases across the process and energy industries. Video courtesy of Falkor, a KONGSBERG company. The same simulation approach extends to AI infrastructure. Schneider Electric, together with AVEVA, is developing an AI factory digital twin built for Nscale with Omniverse libraries to help engineers compare power, cooling and equipment configurations before making physical changes. history.titleZh: 欧洲工业领军企业借助NVIDIA重塑工程与制造
history.descriptionZh:
在欧洲工业界，NVIDIA正以CUDA-X、Omniverse、Cosmos和Nemotron开放模型为核心，推动工程设计与制造全生命周期的智能化。其目标是提高生产率、加速创新并创造新的经济增长机会。NVIDIA在GTC Berlin期间集中展示了这些能力在欧洲汽车、半导体、航空、能源、机器人和工业软件企业中的落地进展，并推出NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint（FOX）的GitHub早期访问版本。FOX为开发者提供构建和部署“常驻工厂经理智能体”的路径，这类智能体可协调机器之间的工作，也可衍生出视觉检测、根因分析、报告生成和车队管理等专用智能体。它们能连接Cosmos、Nemotron等前沿模型，并接入计算机辅助设计、产品生命周期管理、仿真软件以及IT和运营技术系统等基础知识源。借助Cosmos的上下文学习能力，智能体可通过示例和文档适配新任务，而无需微调。生态伙伴可基于FOX构建工业智能体，实时监控工厂运营，将视觉发现与机器日志关联以调查问题，并协调响应。

西门子正将基于FOX构建的智能体集成到其智能体化企业系统Intelligence Center X中，用于识别根因和协调工厂运营，预计可节省20%成本。西门子Process Preparation X智能体利用NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory工具与技能生成电路板检测所需的缺陷图像；在埃尔朗根电子工厂，这一方法将检测流程的校准时间缩短了40%。在工程设计中，CUDA-X库加速仿真，使工程师在投入物理原型前更快获得反馈并探索设计方案。NVIDIA在GTC Berlin宣布cuDSS正式可用，可加速结构应力、流体流动、电磁场和半导体器件行为等复杂仿真背后的高要求计算。梅赛德斯-奔驰使用运行在NVIDIA GPU上的西门子Simcenter STAR-CCM+，通过更快的空气动力学仿真比较车辆设计；在工厂中则应用NVIDIA Cosmos 3和Metropolis VSS蓝图构建车辆检测与挡风玻璃装配验证智能体，检测偏差并确保质量稳定。Cadence正在NVIDIA GPU上对汽车流体动力学工作负载进行基准测试，评估加快设计迭代的机会；Autodesk将NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo和Warp框架引入NavPack并与Autodesk Alias集成，帮助宾利等设计师利用仿真训练的人工智能预测车辆性能并更快迭代。imec和英飞凌使用新思科技软件与NVIDIA加速计算加速半导体仿真：S-Litho在imec模型上的基准显示最高40倍加速；英飞凌使用Sentaurus Device与NVIDIA CUDA库，在下一代功率器件的3D击穿仿真中实现12倍加速。莱昂纳多与Neural Concept合作开展AI驱动飞机设计，利用Omniverse库整合飞机几何与气动仿真结果。汽车制造商还使用达索系统由Nemotron驱动的LEO & AURA虚拟伴侣，编排CATIA AI Agents、SIMULIA AI Agents与SIMULIA求解器，并通过CUDA-X库加速，在制造物理原型前快速设计和虚拟测试车门。

在更广泛的工程与安全应用中，UniversalAGI与萨博合作，利用Latent Interaction Field Transformer物理AI基础模型和NVIDIA Warp加速处理，实时评估数千种海浪条件和航向，而非耗时数天，从而帮助船舶预测危险运动并自主选择更安全航线，Omniverse库则用于可视化船舶海上行为。PhysicsX与英国美洲杯船队GB1合作开展AI驱动游艇设计，使用Omniverse库可视化船体几何和压力场；Fermioniq的Sofia智能体帮助Deltares和荷兰政府部门进行河流流动建模，将自然语言请求转换为基于NVIDIA Warp的仿真求解器。Mistral计划使用CUDA-X、Warp和Omniverse库加速物理仿真，并为工程AI模型生成训练数据。在工厂和机器人虚拟测试方面，Omniverse与Isaac库支持数字孪生和机器人仿真，帮助制造商在改变工厂现场之前评估生产系统和机器人行为。奥迪使用基于Omniverse库构建的电池生产数字孪生，在物理设备到位前测试生产概念；还与达索系统和Agile Robots合作，在基于Omniverse的DELMIA虚拟孪生中模拟和验证移动人形机器人及物流流程。舍弗勒将人形执行器——即驱动机器人关节的部件——的数字孪生与NVIDIA Isaac仿真框架集成，帮助机器人合作伙伴在仿真中评估部件行为并减少物理测试。在大众萨克森透明工厂，Wandelbots使用基于Omniverse和OpenUSD的NOVA与Isaac Sim，数字化验证装配工作流并为物理机器人准备应用。KONGSBERG旗下Falkor将智能体和Omniverse库集成到其平台；借助由NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU驱动的Microsoft Azure NCv6虚拟机，具备空间智能的智能体结合工程数据、运营信息和3D设备几何，对工业设施进行观察、仿真和推理，支持流程与能源行业的巡检和维护。施耐德电气与AVEVA正为Nscale开发基于Omniverse库的AI工厂数字孪生，帮助工程师在物理变更前比较电力、冷却和设备配置。整体来看，这些案例表明工业AI正从单点仿真加速走向覆盖设计、制造、运维和机器人部署的智能体化与数字孪生体系，通过减少物理试验、缩短校准和设计迭代时间、降低运营成本，提升欧洲工业的效率和创新能力。

history.title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations
history.description: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.  Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. history.content: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs. Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. As designs become more complex, simulations take longer to run, increasing computing demands and limiting the number of ideas teams can test. NVIDIA cuDSS accelerates solving large sparse systems — the math-heavy step that repeats throughout engineering and scientific simulations and often limits how many designs a team can test — by tapping into GPUs. This lets applications reduce time to results and increase simulation throughput, enabling end users to explore larger more realistic models, more accurate representations and a wider design space at a reduced cost. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Industry leaders are already integrating NVIDIA cuDSS into their tools to transform workflows for their end customers: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability. COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours. Cadence: Uses cuDSS in its Celsius software to accelerate simulations of heat, structural stress and warpage in advanced chips and 3D chip designs, helping customers including Nokia analyze complex designs faster. Dassault Systèmes: Dassault Systèmes reports an 8-10x speedup using cuDSS within its Abaqus structural and computer simulation technology electromagnetic solvers for performance-critical simulations across industries. Siemens: Siemens uses cuDSS in Simcenter STAR-CCM+ to accelerate simulations of structures in fluid-structure interaction workflows. Synopsys: Synopsys uses cuDSS in its Sentaurus Device simulator tool to accelerate simulations of advanced logic, memory and power chips, helping Infineon model increasingly complex devices faster. Accelerated Simulation at Scale As simulation workloads grow in size and complexity, cuDSS can scale out of the box from individual workstations to large computing clusters. Developers can integrate cuDSS into existing engineering, scientific and optimization software offerings, bringing GPU acceleration to tools already used by engineers and researchers. They can use cuDSS through C, C++, Python and Fortran interfaces. Learn more about cuDSS by visiting the NVIDIA demo booth and Dassault Systèmes booth at GTC Berlin. Featured image courtesy of Dassault Systèmes. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements
history.author: Timothy Costa
history.titleZh: NVIDIA cuDSS 现已正式发布，加速工程与科学仿真
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 宣布其 CUDA-X 库 cuDSS 正式全面可用（general availability）。该库的核心目标是把工程与科学仿真中一个关键且计算密集的环节——大型稀疏系统求解——迁移到 GPU 上执行。复杂工程产品，从先进芯片、飞机到工业系统，在制造前都依赖仿真预测设计性能。随着设计复杂度提升，仿真运行时间变长、计算需求增加，团队能够验证和测试的设计想法数量受到限制。cuDSS 正是针对这一瓶颈：大型稀疏系统求解在工程和科学仿真中反复出现，通常是数学计算最繁重、也最容易限制设计探索规模的步骤。通过利用 GPU 加速该步骤，应用可以缩短获得结果的时间、提高仿真吞吐量，使最终用户能够以更低成本探索更大、更接近真实的模型，更准确的表示以及更宽的设计空间。

从技术定位看，cuDSS 是 NVIDIA CUDA-X 库的一部分，面向稀疏系统求解提供 GPU 加速能力。其创新点在于将仿真工作流中反复出现、传统上常由 CPU 承担且耗时较大的稀疏求解环节卸载到 GPU，并允许开发者将其集成到现有工程、科学和优化软件中。cuDSS 提供 C、C++、Python 和 Fortran 接口，便于不同技术栈的仿真软件接入。随着仿真负载规模和复杂度增长，cuDSS 还可开箱即用地从单台工作站扩展到大型计算集群，帮助现有工具在不完全重构工作流的情况下获得 GPU 加速。

产业落地方面，多家行业领导者已将 cuDSS 集成到其工具中。Applied Materials 在其基于物理、以缺陷为中心的仿真平台 Ginestra 中使用 cuDSS，将稀疏求解相比纯 CPU 方案加速最高 10 倍，加快半导体材料和器件可靠性探索。COMSOL 在 NVIDIA 加速计算上使用 COMSOL Multiphysics 与 cuDSS，ZEISS SMT 在一个 EUV 光刻等离子体仿真基准中测得 4 倍加速，完整仿真在 6 天 14 小时内完成。Cadence 在 Celsius 软件中使用 cuDSS，加速先进芯片和 3D 芯片设计中的热、结构应力和翘曲仿真，帮助包括 Nokia 在内的客户更快分析复杂设计。Dassault Systèmes 报告在其 Abaqus 结构求解器和 CST 电磁求解器中使用 cuDSS，在跨行业性能关键仿真中实现 8—10 倍加速。Siemens 在 Simcenter STAR-CCM+ 中使用 cuDSS，加速流体—结构相互作用工作流中的结构仿真。Synopsys 在 Sentaurus Device 仿真器中使用 cuDSS，加速先进逻辑、存储和功率芯片仿真，帮助 Infineon 更快地对日益复杂的器件建模。

总体而言，cuDSS 通过 GPU 加速大型稀疏系统求解，把仿真中重复且耗时的数学核心步骤转化为更高吞吐的计算流程，可能显著缩短工程仿真周期并扩大可探索设计空间。其应用场景覆盖半导体材料与器件可靠性、EUV 光刻等离子体仿真、芯片热/应力/翘曲分析、结构仿真、电磁仿真、流体—结构相互作用以及先进逻辑、存储和功率器件建模等。开发者可通过 C、C++、Python 和 Fortran 接口将 cuDSS 集成进现有工程、科学和优化软件，并从工作站扩展到大型集群。NVIDIA 还提示可在 GTC Berlin 的 NVIDIA 演示展台和 Dassault Systèmes 展台进一步了解 cuDSS。

history.title: HPE says it will run the first supercomputer benchmarks on the Moon
history.description: HPE’s Spaceborne Computer-4 will ride Astrolab’s FLIP rover to the Moon’s south pole to run HPL, HPCG, and AI tests.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A fanless compute module will head to the Moon for supercomputer benchmarking, AI testing, and additional experimentation by NASA and Deloitte, as detailed in a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) release. The company’s Spaceborne Computer-4 will run what HPE calls “the first high performance computing (HPC) benchmarks on the surface of the Moon,” riding on an Astrolab FLIP rover to the lunar south pole. The launch is slated for late 2026 under NASA’s Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative for a Moon Base program mission, in conjunction with a Voyager Technologies Griffin-1 lander.Named benchmarks include High Performance Conjugate Gradients (HPCG), a supercomputing metric that complements High Performance LINPACK (HPL). AI testing will involve large language model (LLM) retrieval-augmented generation, vision inference, LiDAR processing, and an AI services container for AI app deployment. The LLMs “will deliver insights, analyze visual data, and support autonomous monitoring,” while the LiDAR processing involves mapping, navigation, terrain analysis, and infrastructure development.Scott Wiest, HPE’s vice president, fellow and global sales chief technologist, said, “The next chapter of lunar exploration will depend on the ability to turn data into insights at the point of discovery.” HPE says “no other company or organization” has conducted such benchmarks on the Moon, with a presumption that no other parties’ planned HPC missions will get there first. HPE also assembled a software suite that handles the link to Earth-side systems and the secure delivery of results.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: HPE’s “lightweight, self-contained, and fanless” advanced compute module is “built for space environments,” bringing AI and HPC “to the lunar edge,” as Wiest put it, or the “far-edge,” as HPE calls it. The computer blade is about 10 inches long and about 4 inches wide, about the size of a typical graphics card, and is made from two component cards, as HPE senior director Norm Follett explained on the company’s Technology Now podcast last year.It includes 1TB of Kioxia storage, a low-power CPU, and a small GPU. The chassis is designed to shed heat into a rover plate, and the overall design is made for the Moon rather than being an off-the-shelf solution like International Space Station (ISS) units. Currently, HPE’s description of the unit lacks hard details on performance targets, power budgets, or chip vendors, but the eventual benchmark results will yield some information. You may like Google's orbital AI data center test packs four TPUs and 1,000W of solar power China launches 'Supercomputing-1' AI satellite as orbital data centers gather momentum AMD attempts to get ahead of expected RTX Spark launch with Gorgon Halo benchmarks The original Spaceborne Computer launched in August 2017 on SpaceX’s CRS-12 to the ISS. It also ran HPL with HPCG, surpassing one teraflop, according to HPE. It was rack-installed and water-cooled; the fanless Computer-4 is quite miniaturized in comparison to the 124-pound original Spaceborne Computer. Spaceborne Computer-2, also on the ISS, is made of HPE Edgeline and ProLiant systems with Kioxia SSDs. (Image credit: NASA)NASA will use the opportunity to run its Federated Learning for Unbounded and Intelligent Decentralization (FLUID) AI neural network, trained on data from the Earth, the Moon, and the ISS, coordinating three distinct models. The agency will also test a tuned LLM for semantic processing for handling onboard documents. Deloitte, for its part, will test its Silent Shield, “a new system to detect cyber intrusions” with near-real-time predictive analytics. Testing ideally occurs onboard, as the link to Earth is slow with low levels of bandwidth, Follett explained.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe launch is planned for the fourth quarter of 2026, using a SpaceX Falcon Heavy launch vehicle, SpacePolicyOnline reports. It will take several days for the lander to reach the Moon and its surface. The FLIP rover is designed to operate for one lunar day, or about 14 Earth days, before attempting to survive the night via hibernation, Follett said, making for a relatively tight benchmarking window. history.author: Shane Downing
history.titleZh: HPE称将在月球上运行首个超级计算机基准测试
history.descriptionZh:
HPE宣布，其Spaceborne Computer-4（太空计算机4号）将随Astrolab的FLIP漫游车前往月球南极，在月面开展高性能计算（HPC）基准测试、AI实验及其他科学试验。该任务计划于2026年底发射，属于NASA商业月球有效载荷服务（CLPS）计划下的Moon Base项目任务，并与Voyager Technologies的Griffin-1着陆器配合。HPE称，这将是“首次在月球表面运行HPC基准测试”，并表示尚无其他公司或组织在月球上开展此类测试，同时推测其他计划中的HPC任务不会更早抵达。

此次测试的核心包括HPCG（High Performance Conjugate Gradients）基准。HPCG是与HPL（High Performance LINPACK）互补的超级计算指标，用于更全面地评估系统性能。AI测试则涵盖大语言模型检索增强生成（RAG）、视觉推理、LiDAR处理，以及用于部署AI应用的AI服务容器。按照HPE的说法，大语言模型将用于提供洞察、分析视觉数据并支持自主监测；LiDAR处理则服务于测绘、导航、地形分析和基础设施建设。HPE还配套了一套软件套件，用于管理与地球侧系统的连接并安全交付测试结果。

硬件方面，Spaceborne Computer-4是一个“轻量、自包含、无风扇”的高级计算模块，专为太空环境设计，目标是把AI和HPC能力带到“月球边缘”或HPE所称的“远边缘”。该计算刀片长约10英寸、宽约4英寸，大小接近典型显卡，由两块组件卡构成。HPE高管此前透露，模块包含1TB Kioxia存储、低功耗CPU和小型GPU；机箱设计可将热量传导至漫游车安装板。与基于国际空间站（ISS）现成方案不同，该模块是针对月球环境专门设计的。目前HPE尚未披露性能目标、功耗预算和芯片供应商等硬性细节，但实际基准结果将提供相关信息。

从历史对比看，HPE首代Spaceborne Computer于2017年8月由SpaceX CRS-12送往ISS，采用机架安装和水冷设计，重达124磅，曾运行HPL和HPCG并突破1 teraflop。相比之下，无风扇的Spaceborne Computer-4在体积和形态上大幅小型化。第二代Spaceborne Computer-2同样部署在ISS，由HPE Edgeline和ProLiant系统及Kioxia SSD构成。

NASA将利用此次机会运行其FLUID（Federated Learning for Unbounded and Intelligent Decentralization）AI神经网络。该网络使用来自地球、月球和ISS的数据训练，并协调三个不同模型；NASA还将测试一个经过调优的大语言模型，用于处理机载文档的语义任务。Deloitte则将测试其Silent Shield系统，这是一种通过近实时预测分析检测网络入侵的新系统。HPE指出，由于地月通信链路速度慢、带宽低，理想情况下测试应在月球本地完成。

发射计划定于2026年第四季度，使用SpaceX Falcon Heavy火箭。着陆器需数天抵达月球表面。FLIP漫游车设计运行一个月球日，约相当于14个地球日，之后将尝试通过休眠模式度过月夜，因此基准测试窗口相对紧张。总体来看，该项目旨在验证月面边缘环境中的HPC与AI计算能力，为未来月球基地、自主探测和深空任务中“在发现点将数据转化为洞察”的能力奠定基础。

history.title: NVIDIA Open Models Advance Europe’s Sovereign Intelligence Across Industries
history.description: NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries The portfolio includes the new NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt models; new NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models for embedding, reranking […]
history.content: NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries The portfolio includes the new NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt models; new NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models for embedding, reranking and document parsing; the new NVIDIA Kumo family open weight foundation models and libraries for structured business data; NVIDIA Cosmos 3.5 world models; NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge for autonomous vehicles; NVIDIA BioNeMo for healthcare and scientific discovery; and NVIDIA Ising for quantum computing. The open models give organizations a foundation they can customize with local data and deploy on infrastructure they control. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA Nemotron Powers Post-Training Across Industries NVIDIA Nemotron brings open language models, datasets and recipes to developers building agents. The models support text and images, helping agents orchestrate workflows, reason through complex problems and complete specialized tasks at a lower cost. Nemotron models are built with data, research and expertise from the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition, including European partners Black Forest Labs, H-Company and Mistral. Nemotron provides a foundation for enterprises to build applications based on their own knowledge and expertise. Dassault Systèmes, Domyn, Dream, Palantir’s customers, Salesforce, SAP, Shopify, Synopsys and WPP, as well as professional services providers like Accenture and EY, are working with Nemotron models and datasets to create custom models and build domain-specific agents. A broad ecosystem of post-training partners, including AfterQuery, AgileRL, AI21, Alice, Applied Compute, Baseten, CoreWeave, Distil Labs, EON, Fastino, Fireworks, Google Cloud, Mercor, Multiverse Computing, Nebius, Handshake AI, Plurai, Prime Intellect, River.AI, Scale AI, Trajectory and TNG, is helping enterprises customize Nemotron for domain-specific workloads. NVIDIA Kumo Speeds Agents’ Work With Structured Enterprise Data NVIDIA Kumo open foundation models, libraries and tools help agents and applications forecast outcomes, score fraud risk and recommend actions from structured business data. Part of NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation, Kumo shortens time to prediction and reduces the cost and complexity of building a separate machine learning pipeline for every task. Developers can use pretrained Kumo models to bring predictions to more applications quickly, then fine-tune them using proprietary data when higher performance is critical. The portfolio includes NVIDIA Kumo Structured, with models for relational and tabular prediction, forecasting and anomaly detection, and NVIDIA Kumo Engine, an open library stack for developing and deploying structured data foundation models. Cognite, Coinbase, Databricks, DoorDash, Revolut and Tubi are among the first to work with Kumo models to accelerate development. Snowflake customers are already using Kumo models to accelerate AI development in industries including advertising, energy, financial services and retail. NVIDIA Cosmos Accelerates Robotics Training and Simulation NVIDIA Cosmos is a family of open world foundation models that helps developers build robots, autonomous vehicles and vision agents that understand and interact with the physical world. NVIDIA is introducing new Cosmos post-training and optimization tools to help developers improve world models using less compute, along with simulation checkpoints for evaluating behavior in interactive driving and robotic manipulation scenarios before real-world testing. NVIDIA is also introducing Cosmos Data Factory — comprising blueprints and core agent skills — to help developers curate, label, generate and evaluate training data for driving scenarios, product defects, image augmentation and event generation. Developers can use complete workflows or individual capabilities with agents coordinating the process. Porsche with Voxel51, ANYbotics with Encord, Zalando and CEVA Logistics with Sereact, and Siemens are using Cosmos Data Factory to create high-quality, diverse training datasets and improve model precision. NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Brings Real-Time Reasoning to Autonomous Vehicles NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge is a compact reasoning model that brings real-time scene understanding and motion planning directly into autonomous vehicles. Built on NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge’s Nemotron-based foundation and optimized for the NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor platform, it helps developers bring advanced driving capabilities into vehicles with lower computing requirements. NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina Advances Protein Design NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina is an open protein design model from NVIDIA and the Baker Lab at the University of Washington’s Institute for Protein Design. The model generates protein sequences and 3D structures to help researchers design proteins that bind to difficult targets, assemble into complex structures and bind to small molecules. NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina delivers leading performance across more than 10 protein design tasks and generates designs about 13x faster than RFdiffusion3 in a benchmark of 200 amino acid proteins. Researchers can use the model through agents to generate and evaluate candidates against design goals and molecular constraints, then choose which designs to test in the lab. NVIDIA Ising Accelerates Quantum Development The NVIDIA Ising family of open models provides a common, extensible foundation to speed the breakthroughs needed to develop useful quantum supercomputers, from real-time hardware calibration to error correction, across different qubit modalities and tailored to individual hardware needs. IQM Quantum Computers is using Ising to calibrate its quantum processors, showcasing how specialized open calibration models outperform large general-purpose models. SEEQC is combining the NVIDIA NVQLink platform and Ising with its unique Digital Link to meet the low-latency requirements needed for real-time quantum error correction. AWS is making NVIDIA Ising readily available to researchers by integrating the model family into AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS). While decoding is typically performed on classical hardware colocated with the quantum processor due to latency requirements, the AWS PCS integration lets researchers build on Ising prior to deployment. Availability NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is available on Hugging Face, ModelScope, OpenRouter and build.nvidia.com as an NVIDIA NIM microservice, as well as through NVIDIA cloud, post-training and inference partners. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is expected to be available on Friday, Oct. 23. NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever open models are available on Hugging Face, various partner platforms, and as an NVIDIA NIM microservice on build.nvidia.com. NVIDIA Kumo open models are available on Hugging Face and optimized and packaged as an NVIDIA NIM microservice for production inference on build.nvidia.com. NVIDIA Cosmos is now openly available on Hugging Face and GitHub, and through select inference partners. NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge will be available for download on GitHub and Hugging Face later this month. The NVIDIA BioNeMo open model RFD4-Proteina is available on build.nvidia.com and as an NVIDIA NIM microservice, as well as on GitHub, Hugging Face and through select inference partners. NVIDIA Ising is available on GitHub, Hugging Face and build.nvidia.com. See notice regarding software product information. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

history.titleZh: NVIDIA 开放模型推动欧洲各行业主权智能发展
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 正在扩展其开放模型家族，覆盖语言、机器人、生物科学和量子计算等领域，目标是让开发者、研究人员和企业能够利用本地语言和行业数据定制应用，并部署在自身可控的基础设施上。此次发布包括新一代 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 和 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 模型，面向嵌入、重排序和文档解析的 Nemotron Retriever 模型，面向结构化商业数据的 Kumo 开放权重基础模型与库，Cosmos 3.5 世界模型，面向自动驾驶的 Alpamayo 2 Edge，面向医疗健康和科学发现的 BioNeMo，以及面向量子计算的 Ising。整体思路是提供可定制、可自主部署的开放基础模型，降低企业和研究机构构建行业专用 AI 应用的门槛。

在语言模型方面，NVIDIA Nemotron 提供开放语言模型、数据集和训练配方，主要服务正在构建智能体的开发者。模型支持文本和图像输入，可帮助智能体编排工作流、进行复杂问题推理，并以更低成本完成专门任务。Nemotron 模型整合了 NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition 的数据、研究和专业知识，欧洲合作伙伴包括 Black Forest Labs、H-Company 和 Mistral。企业可以基于自身知识和专业能力，在 Nemotron 基础上构建定制应用。Dassault Systèmes、Domyn、Dream、Palantir 的客户、Salesforce、SAP、Shopify、Synopsys、WPP，以及 Accenture、EY 等专业服务提供商，正在利用 Nemotron 模型和数据集创建定制模型和领域智能体。AfterQuery、AgileRL、AI21、Alice、Applied Compute、Baseten、CoreWeave、Distil Labs、EON、Fastino、Fireworks、Google Cloud、Mercor、Multiverse Computing、Nebius、Handshake AI、Plurai、Prime Intellect、River.AI、Scale AI、Trajectory、TNG 等后训练合作伙伴生态，则帮助企业针对特定工作负载定制 Nemotron。

Kumo 系列则聚焦结构化企业数据。NVIDIA Kumo 开放基础模型、库和工具可帮助智能体和应用基于结构化商业数据进行结果预测、欺诈风险评分和行动推荐。作为 NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation 的一部分，Kumo 的核心创新在于缩短获得预测结果的时间，并降低为每个任务单独构建机器学习流水线所带来的成本和复杂性。开发者可先用预训练 Kumo 模型快速把预测能力引入更多应用，再在性能要求更高时使用专有数据微调。该产品组合包括 NVIDIA Kumo Structured，提供关系型和表格数据预测、时间序列预测及异常检测模型；以及 NVIDIA Kumo Engine，一个用于开发和部署结构化数据基础模型的开放库栈。Cognite、Coinbase、Databricks、DoorDash、Revolut 和 Tubi 是首批使用 Kumo 模型加速开发的企业之一，Snowflake 客户也已在广告、能源、金融服务和零售等行业使用 Kumo 模型加速 AI 开发。

在机器人和物理世界 AI 方面，NVIDIA Cosmos 是一组开放世界基础模型，帮助开发者构建能够理解和交互物理世界的机器人、自动驾驶车辆和视觉智能体。NVIDIA 推出新的 Cosmos 后训练与优化工具，使开发者能够用更少算力改进世界模型，并提供仿真检查点，用于在真实世界测试前评估交互式驾驶和机器人操作场景中的行为。Cosmos Data Factory 由蓝图和核心智能体技能组成，帮助开发者整理、标注、生成和评估训练数据，覆盖驾驶场景、产品缺陷、图像增强和事件生成等任务。开发者既可以使用完整工作流，也可以调用单项能力，由智能体协调流程。Porsche 与 Voxel51、ANYbotics 与 Encord、Zalando 和 CEVA Logistics 与 Sereact，以及 Siemens 正在使用 Cosmos Data Factory 创建高质量、多样化的训练数据集并提升模型精度。

面向自动驾驶，NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge 是一个紧凑型推理模型，将实时场景理解和运动规划直接带入自动驾驶车辆。它基于 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge 的 Nemotron 基础构建，并针对 NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor 平台优化，帮助开发者在较低算力需求下把高级驾驶能力引入车辆。

在生物科学领域，NVIDIA BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina 是 NVIDIA 与华盛顿大学蛋白设计研究所 Baker Lab 合作推出的开放蛋白质设计模型。该模型可生成蛋白质序列和三维结构，帮助研究人员设计与困难靶点结合的蛋白质、组装成复杂结构以及结合小分子。NVIDIA 表示，该模型在 10 多项蛋白质设计任务中表现领先，并在 200 个氨基酸蛋白质基准测试中，设计生成速度比 RFdiffusion3 快约 13 倍。研究人员可通过智能体使用该模型，根据设计目标和分子约束生成并评估候选方案，再选择哪些设计进入实验室测试。

在量子计算方面，NVIDIA Ising 是一组开放模型，提供通用、可扩展的基础，以加速开发实用量子超级计算机所需的突破，覆盖从实时硬件校准到量子纠错的环节，并可跨不同量子比特模态、针对具体硬件需求进行适配。IQM Quantum Computers 正在使用 Ising 校准其量子处理器，展示专用开放校准模型可优于大型通用模型。SEEQC 将 NVIDIA NVQLink 平台与 Ising 及其 Digital Link 结合，以满足实时量子纠错所需的低延迟要求。AWS 则将 Ising 集成到 AWS Parallel Computing Service（AWS PCS）中，使研究人员更容易使用该模型家族。由于延迟要求，量子解码通常在与量子处理器同址的经典硬件上执行，而 AWS PCS 集成可让研究人员在部署前基于 Ising 开展构建。

可用性方面，NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 已在 Hugging Face、ModelScope、OpenRouter 和 build.nvidia.com 上以 NVIDIA NIM 微服务形式提供，也可通过 NVIDIA 云、后训练和推理合作伙伴获取；Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 预计于 10 月 23 日周五推出。Nemotron Retriever 开放模型已在 Hugging Face、多个合作伙伴平台以及 build.nvidia.com 的 NIM 微服务上提供。Kumo 开放模型已在 Hugging Face 提供，并经过优化和打包为 NVIDIA NIM 微服务，用于 build.nvidia.com 上的生产推理。Cosmos 现已在 Hugging Face 和 GitHub 以及部分推理合作伙伴处开放。Alpamayo 2 Edge 将于本月晚些时候在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 提供下载。BioNeMo 开放模型 RFD4-Proteina 已在 build.nvidia.com 以 NIM 微服务形式提供，同时也可在 GitHub、Hugging Face 和部分推理合作伙伴处获取。Ising 已在 GitHub、Hugging Face 和 build.nvidia.com 提供。

history.title: Four workers killed after fall at TSMC’s 2nm fab construction site
history.description: Four contract workers died after a fall at TSMC’s Fab 22 construction site in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Recent updates Update - October 21, 11:20 am ET: In an update, local media reports that all four TSMC workers involved in an accident at its 2nm Fab 22 site in Kaohsiung have died. Reports indicate the accident was caused by a broken connecting plate bolt. TSMC has suspended all steel structure work at the site and all of its new plants in Taiwan while it investigates the cause of the accident. The rest of the story remains below as first published. Three contract workers died, and one more is in intensive care after an accident at the construction site for TSMC’s 2nm Fab 22 in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, reports Taiwan’s Central News Agency. The Southern Taiwan Science Park (STSP) Bureau suspects the cause was a broken bolt on a steel connection plate that sent the workers and steel components tumbling. Steel hoisting on the project has been halted, and the STSP has sent labor inspectors to investigate. The accident is not the first of its kind but rather follows at least a half dozen others since September 2024 at TSMC construction sites in Taiwan, according to local reports. Each of those earlier accidents killed one worker.Local police said that the men were welding a steel beam on an upper floor and fell with it, while the STSP said the workers were performing steel-structure hoisting and installation when a third-floor connection-plate bolt apparently broke.10 emergency vehicles were sent to the site with 22 personnel, and all four men involved in the incident were taken to the hospital. On-site medical staff gave first aid, but three of the workers died despite resuscitation efforts, and the fourth was moved to intensive care. The workers were employed by a contractor working on the fourth phase of the complex’s construction, and TSMC said the area was within that contractor’s scope of work.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: According to the report, TSMC stopped the related construction work on its own and is working with authorities and supervising the subcontractor’s follow-up.Go deeper with TH Premium: Chipmaking (Image credit: tsmc)Analyzing TSMC's fab expansion roadmap — multi-fab N2 ramp, CoWoS, SoIC, and uncorking bottlenecksLeading-edge foundry roadmaps for TSMC, Intel, and SamsungASML's roadmap for chipmaking lithography tools examinedChinese chipmaking tool roadmaps examinedThe Fab 22 complex, located in Kaohsiung’s Nanzi District, is part of the science park and is being built to accelerate 2nm manufacturing. TSMC entered high-volume 2nm, or N2, manufacturing in the fourth quarter of 2025, including at Fab 22. The complex has five phases planned, with a total investment TSMC puts at more than NT$1.5 trillion, or about $46 billion. The accident happened on the construction side, not in a producing fab. Kaohsiung’s deputy mayor said construction on Phase 4 began in August 2025, with operations expected in the fourth quarter of 2027. You may like Two killed, one seriously hurt in explosion at Intel’s chip plant in Israel Samsung's fab roadmaps examined TSMC fab equipment demand nearly doubles in six months Business Today reports that TSMC fab construction has increased, from four fabs a year in 2017–2024 to nine a year in 2025 and 2026. The deaths come as the company plans for 13 new leading-edge and advanced-packaging fabs in Taiwan, with company-wide capex of $60 billion to $64 billion this year.The faster pace has encouraged the addition of a contractor’s safety record as a weight in selection and a plan for a Taiwan Semiconductor Construction Engineering Safety Association with construction partners. TSMC Chairman C.C. Wei said at last year’s shareholders meeting that safety cannot be compromised, and the company’s 2025 annual report said it will keep investing in fabs across several locations in Taiwan “with a strong emphasis on construction site safety.”Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsCliff Hou, TSMC senior vice president and deputy co-COO, told Business Today that increased worker count and overlapping construction have raised the risk, requiring careful supervision, and that TSMC’s contractor lost-time injury rate had fallen about 42% from last year’s high as of late May, when the publication toured the Nanzi site to see the overhaul. It’s too early to call the program a failure, with the cause as yet unknown.The accident comes less than a week after an explosion killed two people at Intel’s chip plant in Israel, though that was an operating fab rather than a construction site. Both accidents come as chipmakers race to meet demand, with global chip sales passing $1 trillion through August, according to the Semiconductor Industry Association.The STSP’s findings will determine what penalties, if any, will fall under Taiwan’s Occupational Safety and Health Act, while it assists the victims’ families. No date has been given at this time for that or for the Phase 4 steel hoisting restart. Nor has TSMC commented on any schedule impact. history.titleZh: 台积电2纳米晶圆厂施工现场发生坠落事故，四名工人死亡
history.descriptionZh:
台积电高雄楠梓Fab 22（2nm）第四期工地发生重大施工事故。最初报道称，三名承包商工人死亡、一人重伤送入重症监护；10月21日更新显示，四名送医工人均已不治。当地警方称，工人在上层焊接钢梁时随钢梁坠落；南部科学园区管理局初步怀疑，三楼钢连接板螺栓断裂导致工人和钢构件坠落。10辆急救车、22名人员到场，四人送医，现场急救后三人死亡，第四人转ICU，后更新为死亡。项目钢构吊装已暂停，劳动检查人员介入调查。台积电自主停止相关工程，配合当局并监督分包商后续整改；更新称公司已暂停该厂区所有钢结构施工，以及台湾所有新厂的钢结构工作，以调查事故原因。

背景方面，Fab 22位于高雄楠梓区，是南部科学园区的一部分，规划五期，总投资超过1.5万亿新台币，约合460亿美元，目标是加速2nm制造。按原文，台积电在2025年第四季度进入N2高量产阶段，包括Fab 22；第四期于2025年8月动工，预计2027年第四季度营运。此次事故发生在施工区域，而非正在生产的晶圆厂，因此不直接涉及N2制程运行；但Fab 22扩产关系台积电下一代领先逻辑制程产能爬坡，面向高性能计算、AI、手机等先进芯片需求。原文未披露N2具体晶体管或性能参数，核心信息是产能建设与施工安全管理。

安全与扩产对比上，自2024年9月以来，台积电台湾工地至少发生六起类似事故，每起造成一名工人死亡，本次更为严重。台积电建厂速度已从2017—2024年的每年4座，提升到2025—2026年的每年9座；公司计划在台湾新建13座领先制程和先进封装厂，全年资本开支为600亿至640亿美元。台积电称已将承包商安全纪录纳入遴选权重，并计划与建设伙伴筹组台湾半导体营造工程安全协会；董事长魏哲家此前表示安全不能妥协，2025年年报也强调工地安全。资深副总侯永清表示，工人数量增加和重叠施工提高了风险，需要严格监督；截至5月底，承包商损失工时工伤率较去年高点下降约42%。

行业影响方面，此次事故距英特尔以色列芯片厂爆炸致两人死亡不到一周，但后者发生在运营中的工厂，而非施工工地。两起事故都发生在芯片厂商竞相扩产、满足需求的背景下；美国半导体行业协会数据显示，截至今年8月全球芯片销售额已超过1万亿美元。南部科学园区管理局的调查将决定是否依据台湾职业安全卫生法处罚，并协助遇难者家属；第四期钢结构吊装重启时间以及是否影响工期尚无日期，台积电也未评论进度影响。整体看，事故不改变2nm技术路线，但凸显先进制程扩产竞赛下工地安全与监管压力，可能促使台积电及供应链进一步加强施工安全管理和工期安排。

history.content: Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake, Huang explained. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory, which generates tokens and digital intelligence from the models that run on it, which are then integrated into every application. “Long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist,” he said, highlighting how, similarly, the internet first needed networking, and electricity first required the grid. “To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI,” Huang said. “We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.” The AI Factory Gets a New Form Factor Huang framed NVIDIA’s full-stack AI factory — spanning hardware, system software, CUDA-X libraries and models — as a broad platform for building and operating AI infrastructure. “This now represents the breadth of technology necessary to create the AI factory,” Huang said. “This is what NVIDIA builds today, and this is the foundation by which we can enable Europe to be part of the AI ecosystem, the AI economy.” He said Vera Rubin, in full production, extends NVIDIA’s computing platform beyond models and large language models to process the entire AI agent. He also showed several of NVIDIA’s latest rack-scale hardware offerings. Next, Huang announced NVIDIA DSX POD, a reference design for complete NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI factories built by partners inside modular containers, integrated and validated before delivery. With DSX POD, onsite deployment can shrink from six months to just 14 days once site utilities are ready. “This is a complete transformation of the world supply chain,” Huang said. “This will change the way that people install and build data centers, and hopefully, as a result, velocity goes up.” The NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform enables companies to reduce water consumption for cooling by up to 100% and generate the same AI output with up to 30% less power. Agents Are the New Computing Platform — and Safety Is an Engineering Problem Huang said agents think, reason, iterate and use tools, driving token consumption as they become more useful. He described an agent as comprising five elements: a model, a harness that orchestrates its work and memory, a sandbox that isolates the harness, knowledge and tools. In that framing, an agent is more than a model answering questions; it can draw on knowledge and act through tools. “The most important thing is to make sure the agent is secure,” Huang said. The autonomous agent can access files, resources, networks and tools, so its privileges should be minimal and it should be monitored. NVIDIA’s answer is the new NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents, a full-stack design built on NVIDIA OpenShell — an open source, policy-controlled runtime with kernel-level sandboxing that sits between an agent and the systems it can affect. That means privileges, policy enforcement and monitoring must adapt dynamically. “Every single time an agent is launched, the privileges are different,” Huang said. Open Models Turn Expertise Into an Advantage Huang presented NVIDIA’s open models as a starting point for building AI tailored to specific needs. NVIDIA’s frontier, open models are available for use across industries: Nemotron for language, Cosmos for world foundation models, GR00T for humanoid robotics, Alpamayo for autonomous vehicles, Ising for quantum-classical computing and Earth-2 for physics AI. “We are the frontier,” Huang said. “So in all of these different areas, we offer you all of the models, and we’re continuously working on it. We’ve been working on it for a decade, and we’ll continue to work on this forever.” NVIDIA provides the models, data and scripts to reproduce them, and companies can post-train a model on their own data for a particular use case — turning proprietary data into what he called “sovereign intelligence.” “You could start with an open model, something that’s incredibly good like Nemotron, and with your own data, post-train it for your use case and achieve, of course, super intelligence,” Huang said. “That is a very sensible thing to do, and all the technology exists today.” NVIDIA Gives Agents a Knowledge Layer Huang then introduced the NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation as a set of models and libraries for connecting agents to enterprise data, whether it’s unstructured information in documents or structured data in databases. He highlighted Nemotron tools for parsing documents, embedding queries and reranking relevant information, along with new NVIDIA Kumo models for making predictions from structured data. “Ultimately, what turns these super agents, these agents into super agents, is that you give them access to your company’s knowledge,” Huang said. NVIDIA CUDA-X — Accelerated Tools for Agents Huang then described NVIDIA CUDA-X as a collection of accelerated libraries used across science, engineering, research and creative work. NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform has more than 11 million developers building on it. Huang said those libraries can accelerate simulators, solvers and data-processing engines — the kinds of tools agents may draw on to do useful work. “CUDA-X tools are what gives agents the tools of the trade,” Huang said. Agents Go to Work in Labs, Factories and Engineering A video showcased NVIDIA Agent Toolkit bringing company knowledge, models and tools together in three industry examples: At Lila Sciences, agents help design a potential B-cell lymphoma therapy, using virtual experiments to guide work in an automated lab. At Siemens’ Erlangen factory, agents help prepare new products for production, testing plans in a digital twin before changes reach the factory floor. And at Dassault Systèmes, engineering agents adapt vehicle design, using simulation to identify a problem and refine the design. “And [all this] knowledge and tools belong to you,” Huang said after the video rolled. “That’s your expertise, and so all of this is now possible to do.” Telcos as Distributed AI Infrastructure Huang said AI is transforming telecommunications, improving spectrum efficiency and turning cell towers into distributed AI infrastructure. He cited 100,000 sites and about 100 gigawatts of distributed data centers, and said NVIDIA has made its first commercial phone call on T-Mobile’s network with Nokia after nearly eight years of work. “Now CUDA makes phone calls,” Huang said. “AI will revolutionize the way we do telecommunications. It will enhance our spectrum efficiency tremendously.” AI Moves Into the Treatment Room Healthcare and life sciences leaders are building on NVIDIA technologies to advance drug discovery and expand patient care. For example, NVIDIA and Siemens Healthineers are developing AI-enabled radiation therapy. Nemotron agents coordinate treatment planning, the Isaac for Healthcare platform and Omniverse libraries create a digital twin of the device and patient anatomy to simulate tumor targeting. Holoscan with IGX Thor connects live imaging and sensor data to enable real-time adaptive delivery as the patient moves. Huang described adaptive radiotherapy as a physical-AI application: as the patient’s body and tumor change during treatment, the system must track the changes and adjust the radiation targeting. “The tumor is changing in shape. The physical body is changing while you’re in therapy,” Huang said. “The robot, this radio adaptive radiotherapy system, has to perceive the changing environment, understand where the tumor is, segment it just perfectly and direct the radiotherapy accordingly.” The Road Ahead: Mobility Leaders Join NVIDIA’s Automotive Ecosystem Huang said the NVIDIA Hyperion computing platform is being designed into more vehicle fleets, with autonomous-driving software connecting robotaxis to ride-hailing services. Bolt with Lucid, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles and Einride are showcasing selected autonomous-mobility use cases on the NVIDIA Hyperion computing platform, demonstrating potential applications for level 3 and level 4 vehicles as well as future robotaxi fleets. In addition, Volvo Cars is adopting Hyperion and NVIDIA Alpamayo Stack software for safe automated driving. NVIDIA also introduced new AI and safety technologies to help developers build, validate and deploy autonomous vehicles at scale. Volkswagen’s van, JLR, Volvo and Mercedes-Benz’s next-generation vehicles will be Hyperion-compatible, Huang announced, saying, “Welcome to Hyperion.” A Reference Humanoid for Robotics Researchers Huang then announced Agile ONE SN, a reference humanoid built on Isaac GR00T — a 31-degree-of-freedom body, expected to be available next year, designed to cut researcher setup time from weeks to days. The platform is modular: researchers can use the full workflow or pull in selected components. “This is a great starting point,” Huang said. It builds on NVIDIA’s open physical AI stack — Isaac Capture for data collection, GR00T models for robot intelligence, Isaac Lab for simulation-based training, Isaac OS for runtime — and NVIDIA’s open physical AI dataset. Partners including Agility Robotics, Figure, KUKA and NEURA Robotics are already building on the same platform. Personal AI Gets a New Machine Huang closed by discussing RTX Spark laptops, which launched last week, bringing together RTX graphics and NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform in slim, premium Windows PCs for accelerated creation, immersive gaming and powerful local AI. He compared its 1 petaflop of performance and 128GB of memory with the DGX-1 he delivered to OpenAI in 2016 — then made the difference in size the punchline: “In the year 2016, I delivered 1 petaflop and 128GB … to a small company called OpenAI,” Huang said, holding up the compact machine in front of the audience. “This is 1 petaflop and 128GB. The only difference, of course, is that I can hold this like this, and DGX-1 took two people to carry upstairs.” Huang then showed a video of an agent helping train Hugging Face’s Microduck: it set up a course and simulated the robot in Isaac Sim, sent training jobs to the cloud, then brought the learned policy back to RTX Spark for evaluation before deploying it to the physical robot. A flock of four Microducks joined Huang onstage, sitting down, standing up and even taking a nap on cue. He explained that they were created on RTX Spark, trained in the cloud and learned their skills in simulation. “You were created on RTX Spark … [we] trained you in the cloud on a whole bunch of NVIDIA supercomputers, and you learned your skills right here on RTX Spark and the digital twin,” Huang told them. The Full Lineup With the Microducks gathered around him, Huang recapped the keynote: Europe is building its AI economy, AI factories are evolving to run agents and physical AI is the next frontier. “So that’s it,” Huang said. “Everybody can build agents. Every company in Europe will become an AI company … and we’re going to have a thriving AI economy here in Europe.” To close, Huang had one more surprise: a Eurovision-style musical send-off that turned the keynote’s themes into a comic recap. The lyrics raced from OpenShell’s guardrails — “No credentials. Access dismissed” and “Sentry on BlueField never clocks off” — to physical AI, where robot training was likened to “college for robots without student loans.” The punchline: “You can’t spell fungible without fun.” A saxophone solo led into a rousing “We are Europa” chorus. “Let’s work together to build Europe’s AI economy and put AI to work,” Huang said, closing out his talk. “Have a great GTC.” Explore NVIDIA GTC Berlin blogs and press releases in the online press kit. history.descriptionZh:
在柏林GTC主题演讲中，NVIDIA创始人兼CEO黄仁勋系统阐述了欧洲AI经济建设、AI工厂形态演进、智能体安全与开放模型、物理AI和机器人的最新布局。此次GTC Berlin为期三天，在STATION-Berlin举行，包含100多场关于智能体AI、机器人、物理AI、开放模型和加速计算的会议；主会场则汇聚记者、分析师和合作伙伴，聆听黄仁勋主题演讲。黄仁勋开场指出，欧莱雅、Revolut、Spotify、默克、沃达丰、Zara、保时捷、雀巢和汇丰等欧洲企业都在与NVIDIA合作推进AI。此前NVIDIA用一周时间走访巴黎、伦敦、斯德哥尔摩和都柏林，并宣布向欧洲技术生态投入近100亿美元，与超过1.2万家合作伙伴协作。他表示，计算机行业数十年发展后，世界正处在新一轮工业革命的起点。

黄仁勋用“五层蛋糕”解释AI：能源支撑先进计算机，先进计算机构成AI工厂，AI工厂运行模型并生成token和数字智能，这些智能再融入各类应用。他强调，AI模型出现之前基础设施必须先行，就像互联网需要网络、电力需要电网。要参与AI经济，不能只消费AI，还要生产AI；欧洲完全具备条件，而且已经开始。NVIDIA的全栈AI工厂覆盖硬件、系统软件、CUDA-X库和模型，是构建和运营AI基础设施的广泛平台。黄仁勋称，已全面量产的Vera Rubin把NVIDIA计算平台从模型和大语言模型扩展到处理完整AI智能体，并展示了多款最新机架级硬件。他发布NVIDIA DSX POD参考设计：合作伙伴在模块化容器中构建完整Vera Rubin AI工厂，交付前完成集成和验证，现场公用设施就绪后部署时间可从六个月缩短到14天。黄仁勋称这将改变数据中心安装建设方式并提升速度。NVIDIA DSX AI Factory平台还可将冷却水耗最多减少100%，并以最多降低30%的功耗生成同等AI输出。

在智能体方面，黄仁勋认为智能体会思考、推理、迭代和使用工具，随着能力增强将推高token消耗。他把智能体拆成五个要素：模型、负责编排工作和记忆的harness、隔离harness的沙箱、知识以及工具。因此智能体不只是回答问题的模型，还能调用知识并通过工具行动。他强调最重要的是保证智能体安全：自主智能体可访问文件、资源、网络和工具，权限应最小化并接受监控。NVIDIA推出面向安全AI智能体的OpenShell参考架构，基于开源、策略控制的OpenShell运行时，在内核级沙箱中位于智能体与其可影响系统之间，使权限、策略执行和监控可动态调整；每次启动智能体时权限都可能不同。

开放模型方面，黄仁勋把NVIDIA开放模型定位为构建定制AI的起点，覆盖多个领域：Nemotron用于语言，Cosmos用于世界基础模型，GR00T用于人形机器人，Alpamayo用于自动驾驶，Ising用于量子—经典计算，Earth-2用于物理AI。NVIDIA提供模型、数据和复现脚本，企业可用自有数据针对特定用例后训练，把专有数据转化为“主权智能”。他还发布NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation，用模型和库把智能体连接至企业数据，包括文档中的非结构化信息和数据库中的结构化数据；Nemotron工具负责文档解析、查询嵌入和相关信息重排序，新的Kumo模型用于从结构化数据做预测。黄仁勋称，让智能体成为“超级智能体”的关键，是让其访问企业知识。CUDA-X则是一组跨科学、工程、研究和创意工作的加速库，NVIDIA加速计算平台拥有超过1100万开发者；这些库可加速模拟器、求解器和数据处理引擎，为智能体提供“行业工具”。

行业应用上，NVIDIA Agent Toolkit把企业知识、模型和工具结合：在Lila Sciences，智能体帮助设计潜在B细胞淋巴瘤疗法，用虚拟实验指导自动化实验室工作；在西门子埃尔兰根工厂，智能体帮助新产品准备生产，先在数字孪生中测试计划再进入车间；在达索系统，工程智能体用仿真识别问题并改进车辆设计。电信领域，黄仁勋称AI正提高频谱效率，把基站变为分布式AI基础设施，涉及10万个站点和约100吉瓦分布式数据中心；NVIDIA与诺基亚在T-Mobile网络上完成首个商业电话，历时近八年，“现在CUDA可以打电话了”。医疗领域，NVIDIA与Siemens Healthineers开发AI放疗：Nemotron智能体协调治疗计划，Isaac for Healthcare平台和Omniverse库创建设备与患者解剖数字孪生以模拟肿瘤靶向，Holoscan与IGX Thor连接实时成像和传感器数据，在患者移动时实现实时自适应照射。黄仁勋称自适应放疗是物理AI应用，系统必须感知变化中的身体和肿瘤、理解肿瘤位置、精准分割并相应引导放疗。

汽车领域，NVIDIA Hyperion计算平台正进入更多车队，自动驾驶软件连接robotaxi与网约车服务。Bolt with Lucid、梅赛德斯-奔驰、大众商用车和Einride在Hyperion上展示部分自动驾驶出行用例，覆盖L3、L4车辆及未来robotaxi车队；沃尔沃汽车采用Hyperion和NVIDIA Alpamayo Stack软件实现安全自动驾驶。NVIDIA还推出新的AI与安全技术，帮助开发者大规模构建、验证和部署自动驾驶汽车；大众厢式车、JLR、沃尔沃和梅赛德斯-奔驰下一代车型将兼容Hyperion。机器人方面，黄仁勋发布基于Isaac GR00T的参考人形机器人Agile ONE SN，拥有31个自由度，预计明年上市，目标把研究人员搭建时间从数周缩短到数天；平台模块化，可用完整工作流或选用部分组件。它建立在NVIDIA开放物理AI栈之上，包括Isaac Capture数据采集、GR00T机器人智能模型、Isaac Lab仿真训练、Isaac OS运行时，以及开放物理AI数据集；Agility Robotics、Figure、KUKA和NEURA Robotics等伙伴已在同一平台开发。

个人AI方面，黄仁勋最后介绍上周发布的RTX Spark笔记本电脑，把RTX图形与NVIDIA全栈AI平台结合在轻薄高端Windows PC中，用于加速创作、沉浸式游戏和强大本地AI。其性能为1 petaflop、128GB内存，与2016年交付给OpenAI的DGX-1相同，但体积已小到可手持；DGX-1当年需要两人抬上楼。他还展示智能体帮助训练Hugging Face的Microduck：在Isaac Sim中搭建课程并仿真机器人，把训练任务发送到云端，再把学习到的策略带回RTX Spark评估并部署到实体机器人；四只Microduck上台按指令坐下、站起甚至小睡。黄仁勋总结称，欧洲正在建设自己的AI经济，AI工厂正演进为运行智能体的平台，物理AI是下一前沿；每家公司都能构建智能体，欧洲每家公司都将成为AI公司。演讲以欧歌赛风格音乐收尾，把OpenShell护栏、物理AI等主题编成幽默 recap，并呼吁共同建设欧洲AI经济、让AI投入工作。
